                // its ship-to location group whenever "All" is selected.
                if (truthyBit(lg.defaultflag)) {
                    userDefaultLG = { id: parseInt(lg.id), name: lg.name };
                }
            });
            debugLog('User LG access: ' + lgs.length + ' groups, default: ' + JSON.stringify(userDefaultLG), 'info');
        } catch (e) { console.error('Failed to load location groups:', e); }

        // A user with access but no flagged default still has to be able to raise a
        // PO, so fall back to their first accessible group rather than sending id 0.
        if (!userDefaultLG.id && userLocationGroups.length) {
            userDefaultLG = { id: userLocationGroups[0].id, name: userLocationGroups[0].name };
            debugLog('No default location group flagged for this user — falling back to ' +
                     userDefaultLG.name, 'warning');
        }

        var lgContainer = document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup').closest('.filter-field');
        if (!lgReorderEnabled) {
            // Company-wide reorder points — hide LG selector, force All
            lgContainer.style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup').value = '-1';
            debugLog('LG selector hidden — system uses company-wide reorder points; ' +
                     'location group stock detail still available', 'info');
        }

        try {
            var qbs = JSON.parse(runQuery("SELECT id, name FROM qbclass WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name"));
            var sel = document.getElementById('paramQBClass');
            qbs.forEach(function(qb) {
                var opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = qb.id;
                opt.textContent = qb.name;
                sel.appendChild(opt);
            });
        } catch (e) { /* QB Class table may not exist */ }

        // Read FY start month for date range options
        try {
            FY_START_MONTH = parseInt(getProperty('BI_FY_START_MONTH', '1')) || 1;
            // Hide FY option if FY == calendar year (Jan start)
            if (FY_START_MONTH === 1) {
                var fyOpts = document.querySelectorAll('.fy-option');
                for (var i = 0; i < fyOpts.length; i++) fyOpts[i].style.display = 'none';
            }
        } catch (e) {
            FY_START_MONTH = 1;
        }

        // Default to "All" — sets dates under the hood
        applyDateRange();
    }

    // ============================================
    // Usage period - Qty Sold, consumption and Days of Stock
    // ============================================
    // BACKWARD-looking, and deliberately independent of the Date Range filter, which
    // is the FORWARD demand window the Auto PO engine costs against. Conflating the
    // two would mean "Next 90 Days" silently decided how much history the
    // consumption rate was averaged over.
    //
    // Everything here comes from inventorylog, for two reasons that matter:
    //   * changeQty is the INVENTORY change, so it is already in the part's base
    //     UOM - the same UOM as On Hand - with no conversion to get wrong;
    //   * inventorylog.locationGroupId is always populated, so the figures scope to
    //     the selected location group exactly like every other quantity on the row.
    //
    // typeId / tableId are the same pair Inv_Reorder_Watchlist uses, verified
    // against inventorylogtype on demodb:
    //   20 / 1555030112   = "shp"  shipment  -> recordId is a SHIPITEM id
    //   50 / -355941248   = "csm"  consumed  -> recordId is a WOITEM id
    var USAGE_SHIP_TYPE  = 20,  USAGE_SHIP_TABLE = 1555030112;
    var USAGE_CSM_TYPE   = 50,  USAGE_CSM_TABLE  = -355941248;
    var ORDERTYPE_SO     = 20;

    // { partId: { sold, consumed, transferred, total, days, rate } }
    var usageMap = {};
    var usageWindow = { start: '', end: '', days: 0, lgId: -1 };

    function getUsageDates() {
        var sel = document.getElementById('paramUsageRange');
        var val = sel ? sel.value : '90';
        if (val === 'custom') {
            return {
                start: document.getElementById('paramUsageStart').value,
                end:   document.getElementById('paramUsageEnd').value
            };
        }
        var days = parseInt(val) || 90;
        return {
            start: moment().subtract(days, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
            end:   moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')
        };
    }

    // True when any column that depends on the usage window is visible. The query is
    // skipped entirely otherwise, so the default view pays nothing for this.
    function usageColumnsOn() {
        return _columns.some(function(c) {
            return (c.key === '_qtySold' || c.key === '_daysOfStock') && c.vis;
        });
    }

    function loadUsageData(locationGroupId) {
        usageMap = {};
        if (locationGroupId === undefined) locationGroupId = getSelectedLgId();
        if (!usageColumnsOn()) { usageWindow.days = 0; return; }

        var d = getUsageDates();
        if (!d.start || !d.end) { usageWindow.days = 0; return; }
        var days = Math.max(1, Math.round(
            (new Date(d.end) - new Date(d.start)) / 86400000));
        usageWindow = { start: d.start, end: d.end, days: days, lgId: locationGroupId };

        // Sold and consumed are separated in ONE pass. Sold is restricted to SALES
        // shipments (shipitem.orderTypeId = 20) - a transfer out is also a typeId-20
        // shipment, and counting a movement between your own warehouses as a sale
        // would overstate demand and, with a location group selected, double-count it
        // against the group it moved into.
        var sql =
            "SELECT il.partid AS part_id, " +
            "  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN il.typeid = " + USAGE_SHIP_TYPE +
            "                     AND si.ordertypeid = " + ORDERTYPE_SO +
            "                    THEN il.changeqty * -1 END), 0) AS qty_sold, " +
            "  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN il.typeid = " + USAGE_CSM_TYPE +
            "                    THEN il.changeqty * -1 END), 0) AS qty_consumed, " +
            "  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN il.typeid = " + USAGE_SHIP_TYPE +
            "                     AND COALESCE(si.ordertypeid, 0) <> " + ORDERTYPE_SO +
            "                    THEN il.changeqty * -1 END), 0) AS qty_transferred " +
            "FROM inventorylog il " +
            "LEFT JOIN shipitem si ON si.id = il.recordid " +
            "                     AND il.typeid = " + USAGE_SHIP_TYPE + " " +
            "WHERE il.changeqty < 0 " +
            "  AND ((il.typeid = " + USAGE_SHIP_TYPE + " AND il.tableid = " + USAGE_SHIP_TABLE + ") " +
            "    OR (il.typeid = " + USAGE_CSM_TYPE  + " AND il.tableid = " + USAGE_CSM_TABLE  + ")) " +
            "  AND il.eventdate >= '" + d.start + " 00:00:00' " +
            "  AND il.eventdate <= '" + d.end + " 23:59:59' ";
        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
            sql += "  AND il.locationgroupid = " + parseInt(locationGroupId) + " ";
        }
        sql += "GROUP BY il.partid";

        try {
            var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(sql) || '[]') || [];
            rows.forEach(function(r) {
                var sold     = parseFloat(r.qty_sold) || 0;
                var consumed = parseFloat(r.qty_consumed) || 0;
                var moved    = parseFloat(r.qty_transferred) || 0;
                // Days of Stock is driven by everything that LEAVES the shelf for
                // good, which is what Inv_Reorder_Watchlist means by consumption.
                // Transfers out are tracked but excluded: the stock is still yours,
                // so treating it as burn would make a busy transfer lane look like
                // demand to purchase for.
                var total = sold + consumed;
                usageMap[r.part_id] = {
                    sold: sold, consumed: consumed, transferred: moved,
                    total: total, days: days, rate: total / days
                };
            });
            debugLog('Usage window ' + d.start + ' to ' + d.end + ' (' + days + 'd' +
                     (locationGroupId > 0 ? ', LG ' + locationGroupId : ', company-wide') +
                     '): ' + rows.length + ' part(s) with movement', 'info');
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Usage query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
        }
    }

    // Re-query and repaint without reloading the whole report - the usage window
    // touches nothing the Auto PO engine computed.
    function applyUsageRange() {
        var sel = document.getElementById('paramUsageRange');
        var custom = document.getElementById('usageCustomInputs');
        var isCustom = sel && sel.value === 'custom';
        if (custom) custom.style.display = isCustom ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (isCustom) {
            var st = document.getElementById('paramUsageStart').value;
            var en = document.getElementById('paramUsageEnd').value;
            if (!st || !en) { persistUsagePrefs(); return; }
        }
        persistUsagePrefs();
        loadUsageData();
        renderTable();
    }

    function persistUsagePrefs() {
        try {
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('usageRange', document.getElementById('paramUsageRange').value);
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('usageStart', document.getElementById('paramUsageStart').value || '');
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('usageEnd',   document.getElementById('paramUsageEnd').value || '');
            FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (e) { /* the columns must work even if settings do not */ }
    }

    // The control only earns its space while a column that uses it is on.
    function syncUsageControlVisibility() {
        var on = usageColumnsOn();
        var field = document.getElementById('usageRangeField');
        if (field) field.style.display = on ? '' : 'none';
        var custom = document.getElementById('usageCustomInputs');
        var sel = document.getElementById('paramUsageRange');
        if (custom) custom.style.display = (on && sel && sel.value === 'custom') ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }

    function getSelectedLgId() {
        var el = document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup');
        var v = el ? parseInt(el.value) : -1;
        return isNaN(v) ? -1 : v;
    }

    // ============================================
    // Default stocking location
    // ============================================
    // defaultlocation is keyed (partId, locationGroupId) - a part can carry a
    // different default bin in every warehouse, and 54 of 111 stocked parts in demodb
    // do. So there is no single "the" default location; which one to SHOW depends on
    // what the user is looking at. { partId: [ {lgId, lgName, locName} ] }
    var defaultLocMap = {};

    function loadDefaultLocations() {
        defaultLocMap = {};
        try {
            var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                "SELECT dl.partid AS part_id, dl.locationgroupid AS lg_id, " +
                "       lg.name AS lg_name, l.name AS loc_name " +
                "FROM defaultlocation dl " +
                "INNER JOIN location l ON l.id = dl.locationid " +
                "INNER JOIN locationgroup lg ON lg.id = dl.locationgroupid " +
                "ORDER BY lg.name"
            ) || '[]') || [];
            rows.forEach(function(r) {
                var pid = parseInt(r.part_id);
                if (!defaultLocMap[pid]) defaultLocMap[pid] = [];
                defaultLocMap[pid].push({
                    lgId: parseInt(r.lg_id), lgName: r.lg_name || ('LG ' + r.lg_id),
                    locName: r.loc_name || ''
                });
            });
            debugLog('Default locations loaded for ' + Object.keys(defaultLocMap).length + ' part(s)', 'info');
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Default location query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
        }
    }

    // Which default location to show on the PART row.
    //   a location group is selected -> that group's, full stop;
    //   All                          -> the user's OWN default group, because that is
    //                                   the warehouse they are buying into; or the
    //                                   only entry when there is just one.
    // Returns { locName, lgName, others } or null.
    function defaultLocFor(row, lgId) {
        var list = defaultLocMap[parseInt(row.part_id)];
        if (!list || !list.length) return null;
        if (lgId > 0) {
            var exact = list.find(function(e) { return e.lgId === lgId; });
            return exact ? { locName: exact.locName, lgName: exact.lgName, others: [] } : null;
        }
        var pick = list.find(function(e) { return e.lgId === userDefaultLG.id; })
                || (list.length === 1 ? list[0] : null);
        // No default group of their own and several to choose from: naming one
        // arbitrarily would be a guess, so show none and offer them all on hover.
        if (!pick) return { locName: '', lgName: '', others: list };
        return { locName: pick.locName, lgName: pick.lgName,
                 others: list.filter(function(e) { return e !== pick; }) };
    }

    // The default location for ONE location group - used by the per-LG sub-rows,
    // where the group is unambiguous.
    function defaultLocForLg(row, lgId) {
        var list = defaultLocMap[parseInt(row.part_id)] || [];
        var hit = list.find(function(e) { return e.lgId === parseInt(lgId); });
        return hit ? hit.locName : '';
    }

    // ============================================
    // Date Range Helpers
    // ============================================
    var FY_START_MONTH = 1;

    function getQuarterDates(quartersFromNow) {
        var target = moment().add(quartersFromNow, 'quarters');
        return {
            start: moment(target).startOf('quarter').format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
            end: moment(target).endOf('quarter').format('YYYY-MM-DD')
        };
    }

    function getFYDates(yearsAgo) {
        var now = moment();
        var currentMonth = now.month() + 1;
        var currentYear = now.year();
        var fyStart = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, FY_START_MONTH));
        var fyStartYear = currentMonth >= fyStart ? currentYear : currentYear - 1;
        fyStartYear -= yearsAgo;
        var fyEndMonth, fyEndYear;
        if (fyStart === 1) {
            fyEndMonth = 12; fyEndYear = fyStartYear;
        } else {
            fyEndMonth = fyStart - 1; fyEndYear = fyStartYear + 1;
        }
        var endDate = moment([fyEndYear, fyEndMonth - 1, 1]).endOf('month');
        return {
            start: fyStartYear + '-' + String(fyStart).padStart(2, '0') + '-01',
            end: endDate.format('YYYY-MM-DD')
        };
    }

    function applyDateRange() {
        var rangeValue = document.getElementById('paramDateRange').value;
        var customContainer = document.getElementById('customDateRangeInputs');
        var startInput = document.getElementById('paramStartDate');
        var endInput = document.getElementById('paramEndDate');

        if (rangeValue === 'custom') {
            customContainer.style.display = 'flex';
            return;
        } else {
            customContainer.style.display = 'none';
        }

        var startDate, endDate;

        if (rangeValue === 'all') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = '2050-12-31';
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_30') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().add(30, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_60') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().add(60, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_90') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().add(90, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_quarter') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = getQuarterDates(1).end;
        } else if (rangeValue === 'this_quarter') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = getQuarterDates(0).end;
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_6mo') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().add(6, 'months').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        } else if (rangeValue === 'next_12mo') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().add(12, 'months').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        } else if (rangeValue === 'current_fy') {
            var fy = getFYDates(0);
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = fy.end;
        } else if (rangeValue === 'current_cy') {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = moment().year() + '-12-31';
        } else {
            startDate = '2000-01-01';
            endDate = '2050-12-31';
        }

        startInput.value = startDate;
        endInput.value = endDate;
    }

    // ============================================
    // Load Auto PO Data
    // ============================================
    // Both Load buttons (in-bar and the header one shown while the bar is collapsed) move together.
    function setLoadEnabled(on) {
        ['btnLoadData', 'hdrRunBtn'].forEach(function(id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.disabled = !on;
        });
    }

    function loadAutoPoData() {
        var vendorVal = document.getElementById('paramVendor').value;
        var locationGroupId = parseInt(document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup').value);
        var qbClassId = parseInt(document.getElementById('paramQBClass').value);
        var showVendorPN = document.getElementById('paramShowVendorPN').checked;
        var includeNoROP = document.getElementById('paramIncludeNoROP').checked;
        var includeMfg = document.getElementById('paramIncludeMfg').checked;
        var defaultVendorOnly = document.getElementById('paramDefaultVendorOnly').checked;
        var startDate = document.getElementById('paramStartDate').value;
        var endDate = document.getElementById('paramEndDate').value;

        if (!startDate || !endDate) {
            showStatus('Please select both start and end dates.', 'warning');
            return;
        }

        allResults = [];
        selectionState = {};
        qtyOverrides = {};
        defaultVendorMap = {};
        vendorCollapsed = {};

        setLoadEnabled(false);

        var _progressToast = null;
        function updateProgress(msg) {
            if (!_progressToast) {
                _progressToast = document.createElement('div');
                _progressToast.className = 'toast info';
                document.getElementById('toastContainer').appendChild(_progressToast);
            }
            _progressToast.textContent = msg;
        }
        function clearProgress() {
            if (_progressToast) {
                _progressToast.classList.add('fade-out');
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (_progressToast && _progressToast.parentNode) _progressToast.parentNode.removeChild(_progressToast);
                    _progressToast = null;
                }, 300);
            }
        }

        updateProgress('Loading Auto PO data…');

        try {
            debugLog('Loading Auto PO data — Vendor: ' + vendorVal + ', LG: ' + locationGroupId + ', QB: ' + qbClassId, 'info');

            // Container-capacity inputs. The UOM tables are static enough to cache, but the
            // dimension snapshot is refreshed on every load so edits in Fishbowl show up.
            loadUomEngine();
            updateProgress('Loading part dimensions…');
            loadPartDimensions();

            // Default locations and the usage window. Both are keyed by part id and
            // independent of the Auto PO engine, so they load once up front rather
            // than per vendor. loadUsageData() no-ops unless a column needs it.
            loadDefaultLocations();
            loadUsageData(locationGroupId);

            // Build vendorparts lookup for lastcost, leadtime, vendorPartNumber, and real FB part number
            vendorPartsLookup = {};
            try {
                var vpRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                    "SELECT vp.partid, vp.vendorid, vp.lastcost, vp.leadtime, vp.vendorPartNumber, vp.qtyMin, p.num AS partnum " +
                    "FROM vendorparts vp INNER JOIN part p ON p.id = vp.partid"
                ));
                vpRows.forEach(function(r) {
                    var vpKey = r.partid + '_' + r.vendorid;
                    var rawCost = r.lastcost;
                    var parsedCost = 0;
                    if (rawCost !== null && rawCost !== undefined && typeof rawCost !== 'object') {
                        parsedCost = parseFloat(rawCost) || 0;
                    }
                    vendorPartsLookup[vpKey] = {
                        lastcost: parsedCost,
                        leadtime: parseInt(r.leadtime) || 0,
                        vendorpartnumber: r.vendorPartNumber || r.vendorpartnumber || '',
                        fbpartnum: r.partnum || r.PARTNUM || '',
                        qtymin: parseFloat(r.qtyMin || r.qtymin) || 0
                    };
                });
                debugLog('Loaded vendorparts lookup: ' + vpRows.length + ' records', 'success');
                // Debug: log a sample record to check field types
                var sampleKeys = Object.keys(vendorPartsLookup);
                if (sampleKeys.length > 0) {
                    var s = vendorPartsLookup[sampleKeys[0]];
                    debugLog('Sample vendorpart: key=' + sampleKeys[0] + ' fbpartnum=' + s.fbpartnum + ' vendorpn=' + s.vendorpartnumber + ' lastcost=' + s.lastcost + ' (' + typeof s.lastcost + ') leadtime=' + s.leadtime, 'info');
                }
            } catch(e) {
                console.error('Failed to load vendorparts lookup:', e);
                debugLog('Failed to load vendorparts lookup: ' + e.message, 'error');
            }

            // Always build default vendor map (needed for smart auto-selection)
            try {
                var dvRows = JSON.parse(runQuery("SELECT partid, vendorid FROM vendorparts WHERE defaultflag = 1"));
                dvRows.forEach(function(r) { defaultVendorMap[r.partid] = r.vendorid; });
                debugLog('Default vendor map: ' + dvRows.length + ' entries', 'info');
            } catch(e) {
                console.error('Failed to load default vendor map:', e);
                debugLog('Failed to load default vendor map: ' + e.message, 'error');
            }

            // Check system property: UseMinQtyAutoGenPOs
            // When true, PO line item quantities must be at least vendorparts.qtyMin
            var useMinQtyProp = getProperty('UseMinQtyAutoGenPOs', 'false');
            var useMinQty = (useMinQtyProp === 'true' || useMinQtyProp === '1');
            debugLog('UseMinQtyAutoGenPOs: ' + useMinQtyProp + ' → enforcing=' + useMinQty, 'info');

            var vendorIds = [];
            if (vendorVal === 'all') {
                var vResult = JSON.parse(runQuery("SELECT DISTINCT v.id FROM vendor v INNER JOIN vendorparts vp ON v.id = vp.vendorid WHERE v.activeflag = 1 ORDER BY v.id"));
                vendorIds = vResult.map(function(v) { return v.id; });
                debugLog('Processing all vendors: ' + vendorIds.length + ' found', 'info');
            } else {
                vendorIds = [parseInt(vendorVal)];
                debugLog('Processing single vendor ID: ' + vendorVal, 'info');
            }

            var totalParts = 0;
            var vendorsWithData = 0;

            // A failed runQuery and a genuinely empty result both arrive here as
            // nothing, and callers treat the [] as a business fact ("no demand").
            // That is how the woitem column-name bug hid for so long, so say so
            // loudly rather than returning a silent empty set.
            function safeParseQuery(sql) {
                var raw = runQuery(sql);
                if (!raw || raw === 'null') {
                    debugLog('Query returned nothing — this is either no rows or a FAILED query, ' +
                             'and they are indistinguishable here: ' + String(sql).slice(0, 220), 'warning');
                    return [];
                }
                var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
            }

            function loadVendorAt(index) {
                if (index >= vendorIds.length) {
                    setTimeout(runPerLgScan, 0);
                    return;
                }
                updateProgress('Loading vendor ' + (index + 1) + ' of ' + vendorIds.length + '…');
                var vid = vendorIds[index];
                try {
                    var resultJson = getAutoPo(vid, locationGroupId, qbClassId, showVendorPN, includeNoROP, includeMfg, startDate, endDate);
                    var items = JSON.parse(resultJson);

                    if (items && items.length > 0) {
                        var addedForVendor = 0;
                        items.forEach(function(item) {
                            // Skip items without valid part_id or part_num
                            if (!item.part_id || !item.part_num) return;

                            // Default vendor filter: skip if this vendor is not the default for this part
                            if (defaultVendorOnly && defaultVendorMap[item.part_id] && defaultVendorMap[item.part_id] !== item.vendor_id) return;

                            // Merge vendorparts data (lastcost, leadtime, vendorPartNumber, FB part number)
                            var vpKey = item.part_id + '_' + item.vendor_id;
                            var vpData = vendorPartsLookup[vpKey];
                            if (vpData) {
                                item.last_cost = vpData.lastcost;
                                item.lead_time = vpData.leadtime;
                                item._vendorPartNum = vpData.vendorpartnumber;
                                item._fbPartNum = vpData.fbpartnum;
                            } else {
                                // Force numeric even if getAutoPo returned an object
                                item.last_cost = safeCost(item.last_cost);
                                item.lead_time = parseInt(item.lead_time) || 0;
                                item._vendorPartNum = '';
                                item._fbPartNum = '';
                            }

                            // If we couldn't get FB part number from vendorparts, try to extract from getAutoPo's part_num
                            if (!item._fbPartNum) {
                                item._fbPartNum = (item.part_num || '');
                            }

                            // Debug: log all keys on first item per vendor to see full engine output
                            if (addedForVendor === 0) {
                                debugLog('Sample item for vendor ' + vid + ': part_num=' + item.part_num + ' _fbPartNum=' + item._fbPartNum + ' _vendorPartNum=' + item._vendorPartNum + ' last_cost=' + item.last_cost + ' (' + typeof item.last_cost + ')', 'info');
                                try {
                                    debugLog('getAutoPo raw keys [' + vid + '/' + item.part_num + ']: ' + Object.keys(item).join(', '), 'info');
                                    debugLog('getAutoPo raw JSON [' + vid + '/' + item.part_num + ']: ' + JSON.stringify(item), 'info');
                                } catch(e) {}
                            }

                            // Log all inventory values returned by getAutoPo engine
                            debugLog('getAutoPo item [' + vid + '/' + item.part_num + ']: ' +
                                'onhand=' + item.qty_on_hand +
                                ' avail=' + item._available +
                                ' allocated=' + item.qty_allocated +
                                ' onorder=' + item.qty_on_order +
                                ' dropship=' + item.qty_on_drop_ship +
                                ' ROP=' + item.reorder_level +
                                ' OUL=' + item.target_level +
                                ' needed=' + item.qty_needed +
                                ' suggested=' + item.qty_suggested, 'info');

                            // === TRACE: tracked parts ===
                            if (isTracePart(item._fbPartNum || item.part_num)) {
                                var _tn = (item._fbPartNum || item.part_num);
                                debugLog('>>> ' + _tn + ' TRACE [vendor=' + vid + ']: RAW from engine: ' + JSON.stringify(item), 'warning');
                                debugLog('>>> ' + _tn + ' TRACE: vpKey=' + vpKey + ' vpData=' + JSON.stringify(vpData || null), 'warning');
                                debugLog('>>> ' + _tn + ' TRACE: defaultVendorOnly=' + defaultVendorOnly +
                                    ' defaultVendorMap[' + item.part_id + ']=' + (defaultVendorMap[item.part_id] || 'undefined') +
                                    ' item.vendor_id=' + item.vendor_id, 'warning');
                            }

                            // Enforce minimum order qty if UseMinQtyAutoGenPOs is enabled
                            if (useMinQty && vpData && vpData.qtymin > 0) {
                                var curSug = parseFloat(item.qty_suggested) || 0;
                                if (curSug > 0 && curSug < vpData.qtymin) {
                                    item.qty_suggested = vpData.qtymin;
                                    debugLog('MinQty enforced: ' + item.part_num + ' qty ' + curSug + ' → ' + vpData.qtymin, 'info');
                                }
                            }

                            // Mark as auto PO sourced
                            item._isAutoPo = true;
                            item._hasCompanyWideSuggestion = (parseFloat(item.qty_suggested) || 0) > 0;

                            allResults.push(item);
                            computePartStatus(item);
                            var key = item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id;
                            var sugQty = parseFloat(item.qty_suggested) || 0;
                            // Only auto-select if qty suggested > 0 AND this is the default vendor
                            // (or no default vendor is set for this part)
                            var isDefaultVendor = !defaultVendorMap[item.part_id] || defaultVendorMap[item.part_id] == item.vendor_id;
                            selectionState[key] = sugQty > 0 && isDefaultVendor;
                            addedForVendor++;
                        });
                        if (addedForVendor > 0) {
                            totalParts += addedForVendor;
                            vendorsWithData++;
                            debugLog('Vendor ' + vid + ': ' + addedForVendor + ' parts loaded', 'success');
                        }
                    }
                } catch (innerErr) {
                    console.error('getAutoPo failed for vendor ' + vid + ':', innerErr);
                    debugLog('getAutoPo failed for vendor ' + vid + ': ' + innerErr.message, 'error');
                }
                if (allResults.length > 0) {
                    document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('poSummaryBar').style.display = 'flex';
                    document.getElementById('tableWrap').style.display = 'block';
                    computeDerivedFields();
                    buildVendorIndex();
                    renderTable();
                }
                setTimeout(function() { loadVendorAt(index + 1); }, 0);
            }

            // ================================================================
            // Per-LG supplementary scan
            //
            // With per-location-group reorder points and "All" location groups
            // selected, the company-wide getAutoPo answer hides per-LG need:
            // aggregate stock can sit above the aggregate reorder point while an
            // individual location group is short. Fishbowl's own Auto PO wizard
            // finds that by running per location group, so this does the same —
            // getAutoPo(vendor, lg) once per LG. That is the SAME engine the
            // wizard uses, so the split agrees with it by construction.
            //
            // WHY IT IS NOT SQL ANY MORE. This used to be a hand-rolled query
            // that reimplemented one branch of the engine:
            //     available < ROP  ->  order (OUL - available)
            // with available = onhand - allocated - notavail + dropship. That
            // silently disagreed with the engine in three ways — it modelled no
            // demand (open SO / WO / TO), it ignored qty on order, and its
            // INNER JOIN partreorder ... AND lg.id = pr.locationgroupid dropped
            // any location group whose reorder settings are held company-wide
            // (locationgroupid IS NULL). Each one makes a location group with
            // real need vanish from the split AND from the PO modal's location
            // group dropdown, while selecting that same LG on its own reported
            // it correctly — because that path calls the engine. The SQL is kept
            // below purely as a last resort if the engine call throws, and when
            // it runs the result is marked INCOMPLETE so the PO modal re-scans
            // with the engine rather than trusting the cache.
            //
            // Cost: one engine call per location group. Passing a null vendor id
            // covers every vendor at once, so this is LGs calls, not LGs x
            // vendors — cheaper than the fallback it replaces.
            // ================================================================
            function runPerLgScan() {
            perLgScanComplete = false;
            if (!(lgReorderEnabled && locationGroupId === -1 && userLocationGroups.length > 0)) {
                setTimeout(finaliseLoad, 0);
                return;
            }

            // Index existing allResults by vendor_id + part_id for quick lookup.
            var existingMap = {};
            allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                existingMap[item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id] = item;
            });
            var perLgAdded = 0;
            var perLgUpdated = 0;

            // Merge one engine row for one location group into allResults.
            // Returns nothing; updates perLgAdded / perLgUpdated.
            function mergePerLgRow(lg, row, sugQty) {
                var mapKey = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
                var existing = existingMap[mapKey];

                // Full per-LG figures, so the table can show WHERE the need is
                // rather than only a company-wide total.
                var detail = {
                    lgId: parseInt(lg.id), lgName: lg.name,
                    suggested: sugQty,
                    needed:      parseFloat(row.qty_needed) || 0,
                    onHand:      parseFloat(row.qty_on_hand) || 0,
                    allocated:   parseFloat(row.qty_allocated) || 0,
                    onOrder:     parseFloat(row.qty_on_order) || 0,
                    dropShip:    parseFloat(row.qty_on_drop_ship) || 0,
                    available:   row._available == null ? null : (parseFloat(row._available) || 0),
                    rop:         parseFloat(row.reorder_level) || 0,
                    target:      parseFloat(row.target_level) || 0
                };

                if (isTracePart(row.part_num)) {
                    debugLog('>>> ' + row.part_num + ' PER-LG ENGINE [' + lg.name + ' id=' + lg.id + ']: ' +
                        JSON.stringify(detail) + ' existing=' + !!existing, 'warning');
                }

                if (existing) {
                    if (!existing._perLgQty)    existing._perLgQty = {};
                    if (!existing._perLgDetail) existing._perLgDetail = {};
                    existing._perLgQty[lg.id]    = sugQty;
                    existing._perLgDetail[lg.id] = detail;

                    // The company-wide pass found nothing for this part, so the
                    // per-LG shortfalls ARE the order quantity — accumulate them.
                    if (!existing._hasCompanyWideSuggestion) {
                        existing.qty_suggested = (parseFloat(existing.qty_suggested) || 0) + sugQty;
                        existing.qty_needed    = (parseFloat(existing.qty_needed) || 0) + detail.needed;
                        var k = existing.vendor_id + '_' + existing.part_id;
                        var isDef = !defaultVendorMap[existing.part_id] || defaultVendorMap[existing.part_id] == existing.vendor_id;
                        selectionState[k] = (parseFloat(existing.qty_suggested) || 0) > 0 && isDef;
                        perLgUpdated++;
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // Part not seen company-wide at all — add it from the per-LG answer.
                if (defaultVendorOnly && defaultVendorMap[row.part_id] && defaultVendorMap[row.part_id] !== row.vendor_id) return;

                var vpKey = row.part_id + '_' + row.vendor_id;
                var vpData = vendorPartsLookup[vpKey];
                if (vpData) {
                    row.last_cost = vpData.lastcost;
                    row.lead_time = vpData.leadtime;
                    row._vendorPartNum = vpData.vendorpartnumber;
                    row._fbPartNum = vpData.fbpartnum;
                } else {
                    row.last_cost = safeCost(row.last_cost);
                    row.lead_time = parseInt(row.lead_time) || 0;
                    row._vendorPartNum = '';
                    row._fbPartNum = '';
                }
                if (!row._fbPartNum) row._fbPartNum = row.part_num || '';
                if (useMinQty && vpData && vpData.qtymin > 0 && sugQty > 0 && sugQty < vpData.qtymin) {
                    row.qty_suggested = vpData.qtymin;
                }
                row._isAutoPo = true;
                row._perLgQty = {};    row._perLgQty[lg.id] = sugQty;
                row._perLgDetail = {}; row._perLgDetail[lg.id] = detail;

                allResults.push(row);
                existingMap[mapKey] = row;
                var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
                var isDefVendor = !defaultVendorMap[row.part_id] || defaultVendorMap[row.part_id] == row.vendor_id;
                selectionState[key] = sugQty > 0 && isDefVendor;
                perLgAdded++;
                totalParts++;
            }

            // A null vendor id asks the engine for every vendor in one call, which
            // is what makes this one call per LG instead of one per LG per vendor.
            var perLgVendorArg = (vendorVal === 'all') ? null : parseInt(vendorVal);
            var lgQueue  = userLocationGroups.slice();
            var lgAt     = 0;
            var lgFailed = [];

            debugLog('=== Per-LG engine scan: ' + lgQueue.length + ' location group(s), vendor=' +
                     (perLgVendorArg === null ? 'ALL' : perLgVendorArg) + ' ===', 'info');

            function scanNextLg() {
                if (lgAt >= lgQueue.length) { finishPerLgScan(); return; }
                var lg = lgQueue[lgAt++];
                updateProgress('Location group ' + lgAt + ' of ' + lgQueue.length + ' — ' + lg.name + '…');
                try {
                    var json = getAutoPo(perLgVendorArg, lg.id, qbClassId, showVendorPN,
                                         includeNoROP, includeMfg, startDate, endDate);
                    var rows = JSON.parse(json) || [];
                    var hits = 0;
                    rows.forEach(function(row) {
                        if (!row.part_id || !row.part_num) return;
                        var sugQty = parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0;
                        if (sugQty <= 0) return;
                        mergePerLgRow(lg, row, sugQty);
                        hits++;
                    });
                    debugLog('  LG ' + lg.name + ' (id=' + lg.id + '): ' + hits +
                             ' part(s) with a suggested qty, from ' + rows.length + ' engine row(s)', 'info');
                } catch (e) {
                    lgFailed.push(lg.name);
                    debugLog('  LG ' + lg.name + ' engine scan FAILED: ' + e.message, 'error');
                }
                setTimeout(scanNextLg, 0);
            }

            function finishPerLgScan() {
                // Only a clean sweep of every LG makes the split authoritative.
                perLgScanComplete = (lgFailed.length === 0);
                if (!perLgScanComplete) {
                    debugLog('Per-LG scan INCOMPLETE — failed for: ' + lgFailed.join(', ') +
                             '. The PO modal will re-scan rather than trust this split.', 'warning');
                    runPerLgSqlFallback();
                }
                backfillCompanyWideTotals();
                debugLog('Per-LG scan complete: ' + perLgAdded + ' new part(s) added, ' +
                         perLgUpdated + ' updated with per-LG suggestions', 'success');
                if (allResults.length > 0) {
                    computeDerivedFields();
                    buildVendorIndex();
                    renderTable();
                }
                setTimeout(finaliseLoad, 0);
            }

            // Last-resort approximation — reorder-point branch only. It cannot see
            // demand or qty on order, so it under-reports; it exists so a failed
            // engine call degrades to "some split" rather than "no split", and it
            // never sets perLgScanComplete.
            function runPerLgSqlFallback() {
                var lgIdList = userLocationGroups.map(function(lg) { return lg.id; });
                var lgNameMap = {};
                userLocationGroups.forEach(function(lg) { lgNameMap[lg.id] = lg.name; });
                try {
                    var perLgSql =
                        "SELECT * FROM (" +
                        "  SELECT " +
                        "    p.id AS part_id, p.num AS part_num, p.description AS part_description, " +
                        "    COALESCE(uom.code, '') AS part_uom_code, p.uomid AS part_uom_id, " +
                        "    vp.vendorid AS vendor_id, COALESCE(v.name, '') AS vendor_name, " +
                        "    lg.id AS lg_id, lg.name AS lg_name, " +
                        "    COALESCE(pr.reorderpoint, 0) AS reorder_level, " +
                        "    COALESCE(pr.orderuptolevel, 0) AS target_level, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) AS qty_on_hand, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) AS qty_allocated, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qna.qty, 0) AS qty_not_available, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qds.qty, 0) AS qty_on_drop_ship, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qoo.qty, 0) AS qty_on_order, " +
                        "    COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qna.qty, 0) + COALESCE(qds.qty, 0) AS _available, " +
                        "    CASE " +
                        "      WHEN (COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qna.qty, 0) + COALESCE(qds.qty, 0)) " +
                        "           < COALESCE(pr.reorderpoint, 0) " +
                        "      THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.orderuptolevel, 0) " +
                        "           - (COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qna.qty, 0) + COALESCE(qds.qty, 0)), 0) " +
                        "      ELSE 0 " +
                        "    END AS suggested_qty " +
                        "  FROM part p " +
                        "    INNER JOIN vendorparts vp ON p.id = vp.partid " +
                        "    INNER JOIN vendor v ON vp.vendorid = v.id AND v.activeflag = 1 " +
                        "    INNER JOIN uom ON p.uomid = uom.id " +
                        "    CROSS JOIN locationgroup lg " +
                        "    INNER JOIN partreorder pr ON p.id = pr.partid AND lg.id = pr.locationgroupid " +
                        "    LEFT JOIN qtyonhand qoh ON p.id = qoh.partid AND lg.id = qoh.locationgroupid " +
                        "    LEFT JOIN qtyallocated qal ON p.id = qal.partid AND lg.id = qal.locationgroupid " +
                        "    LEFT JOIN qtynotavailable qna ON p.id = qna.partid AND lg.id = qna.locationgroupid " +
                        "    LEFT JOIN qtydropship qds ON p.id = qds.partid AND lg.id = qds.locationgroupid " +
                        "    LEFT JOIN qtyonorder qoo ON p.id = qoo.partid AND lg.id = qoo.locationgroupid " +
                        "  WHERE p.typeid = 10 " +
                        "    AND lg.id IN (" + lgIdList.join(',') + ") " +
                        "    AND vp.vendorid IN (" + vendorIds.join(',') + ") ";

                    // Respect include No ROP/OUL setting
                    if (!includeNoROP) {
                        perLgSql += "    AND pr.reorderpoint > 0 AND pr.orderuptolevel > 0 ";
                    }

                    perLgSql +=
                        ") t " +
                        "WHERE t.suggested_qty > 0";

                    debugLog('Per-LG SQL query executing...', 'info');
                    var perLgRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(perLgSql));
                    debugLog('Per-LG SQL scan returned ' + perLgRows.length + ' rows with suggestions', 'info');

                    perLgRows.forEach(function(row) {
                        var sugQty = parseFloat(row.suggested_qty) || 0;
                        if (sugQty <= 0) return;
                        // Only fill gaps — never overwrite an engine answer with the
                        // approximation, and never double-count a part the engine
                        // already merged for this location group.
                        var ex = existingMap[row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id];
                        if (ex && ex._perLgQty && ex._perLgQty[row.lg_id] !== undefined) return;
                        row.qty_needed = sugQty;
                        row.qty_suggested = sugQty;
                        mergePerLgRow({ id: row.lg_id, name: row.lg_name }, row, sugQty);
                    });
                    debugLog('Per-LG SQL fallback merged ' + perLgRows.length + ' approximate row(s)', 'warning');
                } catch (sqlErr) {
                    debugLog('Per-LG SQL fallback also failed: ' + sqlErr.message, 'error');
                    console.error('Per-LG SQL fallback failed:', sqlErr);
                }
            }

            // Parts that only ever came from a per-LG answer carry per-LG inventory
            // figures; the main table row is company-wide, so fetch the totals.
            function backfillCompanyWideTotals() {
                var newPartIds = [];
                allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                    if (item._isAutoPo && item.qty_on_hand === 0 && item._perLgQty && Object.keys(item._perLgQty).length > 0) {
                        if (newPartIds.indexOf(item.part_id) === -1) newPartIds.push(item.part_id);
                    }
                });
                if (!newPartIds.length) return;
                try {
                    var cwSql =
                        "SELECT partid AS part_id, " +
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(qtyonhand), 0) AS qty_on_hand, " +
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(qtyallocated), 0) AS qty_allocated, " +
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(qtyonorder), 0) AS qty_on_order, " +
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(qtydropship), 0) AS qty_on_drop_ship, " +
                        "  GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(qtyonhand) - SUM(qtyallocated) - SUM(qtynotavailable) + SUM(qtydropship), 0), 0) AS _available " +
                        "FROM qtyinventorytotals " +
                        "WHERE partid IN (" + newPartIds.join(',') + ") " +
                        "GROUP BY partid";
                    var cwRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(cwSql));
                    var cwMap = {};
                    cwRows.forEach(function(r) { cwMap[r.part_id] = r; });

                    allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                        var cw = cwMap[item.part_id];
                        if (cw && item._perLgQty && Object.keys(item._perLgQty).length > 0 && !item._hasCompanyWideSuggestion) {
                            item.qty_on_hand = parseFloat(cw.qty_on_hand) || 0;
                            item.qty_allocated = parseFloat(cw.qty_allocated) || 0;
                            item.qty_on_order = parseFloat(cw.qty_on_order) || 0;
                            item.qty_on_drop_ship = parseFloat(cw.qty_on_drop_ship) || 0;
                            item._available = parseFloat(cw._available) || 0;
                        }
                    });
                    debugLog('Company-wide totals backfilled for ' + newPartIds.length + ' per-LG-only parts', 'info');
                } catch (cwErr) {
                    debugLog('Company-wide totals backfill failed: ' + cwErr.message, 'warning');
                }
            }

            setTimeout(scanNextLg, 0);
            } // end runPerLgScan


            function finaliseLoad() {
            try {

            // Mark items that had company-wide suggestions (for per-LG logic above)
            // This flag was already used during per-LG scan — now tag any remaining
            // items that have company-wide suggestions so we can also attach _perLgQty
            // to them in the per-LG modal prescan.

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Post-filter getAutoPo results by date range
            // The engine ignores date params, so we query
            // SO / WO demand within the window ourselves
            // and recalculate shortfall accordingly.
            // ------------------------------------------------
            try {
                var partsToFilter = [];
                allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                    if (item._isAutoPo && (parseFloat(item.qty_needed) || 0) > 0) {
                        if (partsToFilter.indexOf(item.part_id) === -1) {
                            partsToFilter.push(item.part_id);
                        }
                    }
                });

                if (partsToFilter.length > 0) {
                    var partIdList = partsToFilter.join(',');

                    // Diagnostic: show what dates exist for SO demand on these parts
                    try {
                        var soDiagSql =
                            "SELECT prod.partid AS part_id, p.num AS part_num, " +
                            "  so.num AS so_num, so.statusid AS so_status, " +
                            "  so.datefirstship AS ship_date, " +
                            "  GREATEST(si.qtytofulfill - si.qtyfulfilled, 0) AS unfulfilled " +
                            "FROM soitem si " +
                            "INNER JOIN product prod ON prod.id = si.productid " +
                            "INNER JOIN part p ON p.id = prod.partid " +
                            "INNER JOIN so ON so.id = si.soid " +
                            "WHERE prod.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                            "  AND so.statusid >= 20 AND so.statusid < 60 " +
                            "  AND si.typeid = 10 " +
                            "  AND GREATEST(si.qtytofulfill - si.qtyfulfilled, 0) > 0 ";
                        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                            soDiagSql += "  AND so.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                        }
                        soDiagSql += "ORDER BY prod.partid, so.datefirstship";
                        var diagRows = safeParseQuery(soDiagSql);
                        debugLog('=== SO DEMAND DATES (open SOs' + (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' LG=' + locationGroupId : '') + ') ===', 'info');
                        diagRows.forEach(function(r) {
                            debugLog('  ' + r.part_num + ': SO#' + r.so_num +
                                ' ship=' + (r.ship_date || 'NULL') +
                                ' unfulfilled=' + r.unfulfilled +
                                ' status=' + r.so_status, 'info');
                        });
                        if (diagRows.length === 0) {
                            debugLog('  (no open SO demand found for any of these parts)', 'info');
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        debugLog('SO diagnostic query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                    }

                    // Diagnostic: show what dates exist for WO/MO demand on these parts
                    if (includeMfg) {
                        try {
                            var woDiagSql =
                                "SELECT wi.partid AS part_id, p.num AS part_num, " +
                                "  mo.num AS mo_num, mo.statusid AS mo_status, " +
                                "  wo.num AS wo_num, wo.statusid AS wo_status, " +
                                "  wo.datescheduled AS wo_date, mi.datescheduled AS mo_date, " +
                                "  GREATEST(wi.qtyTarget - wi.qtyUsed, 0) AS unfulfilled " +
                                "FROM woitem wi " +
                                "INNER JOIN part p ON p.id = wi.partid " +
                                "INNER JOIN wo ON wo.id = wi.woid " +
                                "LEFT JOIN moitem mi ON wo.moitemid = mi.id " +
                                "LEFT JOIN mo ON mo.id = mi.moid " +
                                "WHERE wi.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                                "  AND wi.typeid = 20 " +
                                "  AND GREATEST(wi.qtyTarget - wi.qtyUsed, 0) > 0 ";
                            if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                                woDiagSql += "  AND wo.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                            }
                            woDiagSql += "ORDER BY wi.partid, wo.datescheduled";
                            var woDiagRows = safeParseQuery(woDiagSql);
                            debugLog('=== WO/MO DEMAND DATES (open WOs' + (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' LG=' + locationGroupId : '') + ') ===', 'info');
                            woDiagRows.forEach(function(r) {
                                debugLog('  ' + r.part_num + ': MO#' + (r.mo_num || '?') +
                                    '/WO#' + (r.wo_num || '?') +
                                    ' wo_date=' + (r.wo_date || 'NULL') +
                                    ' mo_date=' + (r.mo_date || 'NULL') +
                                    ' unfulfilled=' + r.unfulfilled +
                                    ' mo_status=' + r.mo_status +
                                    ' wo_status=' + r.wo_status, 'info');
                            });
                            if (woDiagRows.length === 0) {
                                debugLog('  (no open WO demand found for any of these parts)', 'info');
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            debugLog('WO diagnostic query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                        }
                    }

                    // SO demand: unfulfilled qty on open SOs within date range
                    // Note: SoItem.ProductId → Product.Id, Product.PartId → Part.Id
                    var soDemandMap = {};
                    try {
                        var soSql =
                            "SELECT prod.partid AS part_id, " +
                            "  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(si.qtytofulfill - si.qtyfulfilled, 0)), 0) AS dated_demand " +
                            "FROM soitem si " +
                            "INNER JOIN product prod ON prod.id = si.productid " +
                            "INNER JOIN so ON so.id = si.soid " +
                            "WHERE prod.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                            "  AND so.statusid >= 20 AND so.statusid < 60 " +
                            "  AND si.typeid = 10 " +
                            "  AND (so.datefirstship IS NULL OR so.datefirstship BETWEEN '" + startDate + "' AND '" + endDate + " 23:59:59') ";
                        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                            soSql += "  AND so.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                        }
                        soSql += "GROUP BY prod.partid";
                        var soRows = safeParseQuery(soSql);
                        soRows.forEach(function(r) {
                            soDemandMap[r.part_id] = parseFloat(r.dated_demand) || 0;
                        });
                        debugLog('Date-filtered SO demand for ' + partsToFilter.length + ' parts' +
                            (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' (LG=' + locationGroupId + ')' : ' (company-wide)') +
                            ': ' + JSON.stringify(soDemandMap), 'info');
                    } catch (e) {
                        debugLog('SO date-filter query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                    }

                    // TO demand: unfulfilled qty on open Transfer Orders within date range
                    // XoItem.PartId → Part.Id directly (TOs reference parts, not products)
                    var toDemandMap = {};
                    try {
                        // Diagnostic: show TO demand dates
                        var toDiagSql =
                            "SELECT xi.partid AS part_id, p.num AS part_num, " +
                            "  xo.num AS xo_num, xo.statusid AS xo_status, " +
                            "  COALESCE(xo.datefirstship, xo.datescheduled) AS ship_date, " +
                            "  GREATEST(xi.qtytofulfill - xi.qtyfulfilled, 0) AS unfulfilled " +
                            "FROM xoitem xi " +
                            "INNER JOIN part p ON p.id = xi.partid " +
                            "INNER JOIN xo ON xo.id = xi.xoid " +
                            "WHERE xi.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                            "  AND xo.statusid IN (10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) " +
                            "  AND GREATEST(xi.qtytofulfill - xi.qtyfulfilled, 0) > 0 ";
                        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                            toDiagSql += "  AND xo.fromlgid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                        }
                        toDiagSql += "ORDER BY xi.partid, COALESCE(xo.datefirstship, xo.datescheduled)";
                        var toDiagRows = safeParseQuery(toDiagSql);
                        debugLog('=== TO DEMAND DATES (open TOs' + (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' from LG=' + locationGroupId : '') + ') ===', 'info');
                        toDiagRows.forEach(function(r) {
                            debugLog('  ' + r.part_num + ': TO#' + r.xo_num +
                                ' ship=' + (r.ship_date || 'NULL') +
                                ' unfulfilled=' + r.unfulfilled +
                                ' status=' + r.xo_status, 'info');
                        });
                        if (toDiagRows.length === 0) {
                            debugLog('  (no open TO demand found for any of these parts)', 'info');
                        }

                        // Date-filtered TO demand
                        var toSql =
                            "SELECT xi.partid AS part_id, " +
                            "  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(xi.qtytofulfill - xi.qtyfulfilled, 0)), 0) AS dated_demand " +
                            "FROM xoitem xi " +
                            "INNER JOIN xo ON xo.id = xi.xoid " +
                            "WHERE xi.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                            "  AND xo.statusid IN (10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) " +
                            "  AND (COALESCE(xo.datefirstship, xo.datescheduled) IS NULL " +
                            "       OR COALESCE(xo.datefirstship, xo.datescheduled) BETWEEN '" + startDate + "' AND '" + endDate + " 23:59:59') ";
                        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                            toSql += "  AND xo.fromlgid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                        }
                        toSql += "GROUP BY xi.partid";
                        var toRows = safeParseQuery(toSql);
                        toRows.forEach(function(r) {
                            toDemandMap[r.part_id] = parseFloat(r.dated_demand) || 0;
                        });
                        debugLog('Date-filtered TO demand for ' + partsToFilter.length + ' parts' +
                            (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' (LG=' + locationGroupId + ')' : ' (company-wide)') +
                            ': ' + JSON.stringify(toDemandMap), 'info');
                    } catch (e) {
                        debugLog('TO date-filter query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                    }

                    // WO/MO demand: raw material consumption on open WOs within date range
                    var woDemandMap = {};
                    if (includeMfg) {
                        try {
                            // woitem has NO qtyToFulfill / qtyFulfilled — a work order
                            // line tracks qtyTarget (planned) against qtyUsed (consumed),
                            // so the outstanding raw-material demand is target - used.
                            // The old expression named columns that do not exist, so this
                            // query threw on every run and safeParseQuery swallowed it:
                            // WO demand was silently ZERO, which let the date gate below
                            // suppress parts whose only demand is manufacturing.
                            var woSql =
                                "SELECT wi.partid AS part_id, " +
                                "  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(wi.qtyTarget - wi.qtyUsed, 0)), 0) AS dated_demand " +
                                "FROM woitem wi " +
                                "INNER JOIN wo ON wo.id = wi.woid " +
                                "LEFT JOIN moitem mi ON wo.moitemid = mi.id " +
                                "LEFT JOIN mo ON mo.id = mi.moid " +
                                "WHERE wi.partid IN (" + partIdList + ") " +
                                "  AND wi.typeid = 20 " +
                                "  AND (COALESCE(wo.datescheduled, mi.datescheduled) IS NULL " +
                                "       OR COALESCE(wo.datescheduled, mi.datescheduled) BETWEEN '" + startDate + "' AND '" + endDate + " 23:59:59') ";
                            if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                                woSql += "  AND wo.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                            }
                            woSql += "GROUP BY wi.partid";
                            var woRows = safeParseQuery(woSql);
                            woRows.forEach(function(r) {
                                woDemandMap[r.part_id] = parseFloat(r.dated_demand) || 0;
                            });
                            debugLog('Date-filtered WO demand for ' + partsToFilter.length + ' parts' +
                                (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' (LG=' + locationGroupId + ')' : ' (company-wide)') +
                                ': ' + JSON.stringify(woDemandMap), 'info');
                        } catch (e) {
                            debugLog('WO date-filter query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                        }
                    }

                    // Query Not Available qty so we can compute true available
                    // (the getAutoPo engine doesn't return this field)
                    var notAvailMap = {};
                    try {
                        var naSql = "SELECT partid AS part_id, COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS qty " +
                            "FROM qtynotavailable WHERE partid IN (" + partIdList + ") ";
                        if (locationGroupId > 0) {
                            naSql += "AND locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " ";
                        }
                        naSql += "GROUP BY partid";
                        var naRows = safeParseQuery(naSql);
                        naRows.forEach(function(r) {
                            notAvailMap[r.part_id] = parseFloat(r.qty) || 0;
                        });
                        debugLog('Not Available qty for post-filter parts' +
                            (locationGroupId > 0 ? ' (LG=' + locationGroupId + ')' : '') +
                            ': ' + JSON.stringify(notAvailMap), 'info');
                    } catch (e) {
                        debugLog('qtynotavailable query failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                    }

                    // Date-gate: trust the engine's qty_needed (it already accounts
                    // for LG-scoped inventory, not-available, reorder points, OUL, etc.)
                    // but zero-out parts that have NO demand within the date window
                    // UNLESS the item is below its reorder point (ROP-based suggestion).
                    // We don't try to re-derive the qty — the engine knows better.
                    allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                        // === TRACE: tracked parts date filter ===
                        if (isTracePart(item._fbPartNum || item.part_num)) {
                            var _tn = (item._fbPartNum || item.part_num);
                            debugLog('>>> ' + _tn + ' DATE FILTER ENTRY: _isAutoPo=' + item._isAutoPo +
                                ' qty_needed=' + item.qty_needed + ' qty_suggested=' + item.qty_suggested +
                                ' vendor=' + item.vendor_id, 'warning');
                        }

                        if (!item._isAutoPo || (parseFloat(item.qty_needed) || 0) <= 0) return;

                        var soDemand = soDemandMap[item.part_id] || 0;
                        var toDemand = toDemandMap[item.part_id] || 0;
                        var woDemand = woDemandMap[item.part_id] || 0;
                        var datedAlloc = soDemand + toDemand + woDemand;
                        var origNeeded = parseFloat(item.qty_needed) || 0;

                        // Store not_available so computePartStatus can use the correct available
                        var notAvail = notAvailMap[item.part_id] || 0;
                        item._qty_not_available = notAvail;

                        // Check if item is below ROP or in inventory deficit.
                        // The engine's suggestion should be kept if:
                        //  - Item is below its reorder point (ROP-based need)
                        //  - Item is in deficit: allocated > onhand (unfulfilled demand exists)
                        // In these cases, the engine is right even if our demand queries miss it.
                        var onHand = parseFloat(item.qty_on_hand) || 0;
                        var allocated = parseFloat(item.qty_allocated) || 0;
                        var dropShip = parseFloat(item.qty_on_drop_ship) || 0;
                        var rop = parseFloat(item.reorder_level) || 0;
                        var rawAvail = onHand - allocated - notAvail + dropShip;  // can be negative
                        var belowROP = rop > 0 && Math.max(rawAvail, 0) < rop;
                        var inDeficit = rawAvail < 0;  // more allocated/committed than on-hand
                        // A per-LG shortfall outranks this gate. Every figure above is
                        // COMPANY-WIDE, so a part that is comfortably stocked in total can
                        // still be short at one location group — which is exactly the case
                        // per-LG reorder points exist for. Zeroing it here would drop the
                        // row from the selection and take its location group out of the PO
                        // modal's dropdown with it.
                        var perLgNeed = 0;
                        if (item._perLgQty) {
                            Object.keys(item._perLgQty).forEach(function(k) {
                                perLgNeed += parseFloat(item._perLgQty[k]) || 0;
                            });
                        }
                        var keepSuggestion = belowROP || inDeficit || perLgNeed > 0;

                        // === TRACE: tracked parts date filter detail ===
                        if (isTracePart(item._fbPartNum || item.part_num)) {
                            var _tn2 = (item._fbPartNum || item.part_num);
                            debugLog('>>> ' + _tn2 + ' DATE FILTER: SO=' + soDemand + ' TO=' + toDemand + ' WO=' + woDemand +
                                ' datedAlloc=' + datedAlloc + ' origNeeded=' + origNeeded +
                                ' notAvail=' + notAvail +
                                ' rawAvail=' + rawAvail + ' ROP=' + rop +
                                ' belowROP=' + belowROP + ' inDeficit=' + inDeficit, 'warning');
                        }

                        if (datedAlloc <= 0 && !keepSuggestion) {
                            // No demand in date window, not below ROP, not in deficit — suppress
                            debugLog('Date filter [' + item.part_num + ' v' + item.vendor_id + ']: ' +
                                'SO=' + soDemand + ' TO=' + toDemand + ' WO=' + woDemand +
                                ' rawAvail=' + rawAvail + ' ROP=' + rop +
                                ' → no demand & adequate stock, zeroing engine needed=' + origNeeded, 'info');
                            item.qty_needed = 0;
                            item.qty_suggested = 0;
                            var key = item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id;
                            selectionState[key] = false;
                        } else if (datedAlloc <= 0 && keepSuggestion) {
                            // No demand in date window BUT below ROP or in deficit — keep
                            debugLog('Date filter [' + item.part_num + ' v' + item.vendor_id + ']: ' +
                                'SO=' + soDemand + ' TO=' + toDemand + ' WO=' + woDemand +
                                ' rawAvail=' + rawAvail + ' ROP=' + rop +
                                ' → no demand but ' + (belowROP ? 'BELOW ROP' : 'IN DEFICIT') +
                                ', keeping engine needed=' + origNeeded, 'info');
                        } else {
                            // Demand exists in window — keep engine's qty_needed as-is
                            debugLog('Date filter [' + item.part_num + ' v' + item.vendor_id + ']: ' +
                                'SO=' + soDemand + ' TO=' + toDemand + ' WO=' + woDemand +
                                ' datedAlloc=' + datedAlloc +
                                ' → keeping engine needed=' + origNeeded, 'info');
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (e) {
                debugLog('Date post-filter failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Load standard inventory data for parts NOT already
            // returned by Auto PO — allows users to add items
            // to POs that weren't auto-suggested
            // ------------------------------------------------
            try {
                var autoPoPartIds = {};
                allResults.forEach(function(item) { autoPoPartIds[item.part_id] = true; });

                var usePerLG = (locationGroupId > 0);

                var stdQuery =
                    "SELECT " +
                    "  p.id as part_id, p.num as part_num, p.description as part_description, " +
                    "  COALESCE(uom.code, '') as part_uom_code, p.uomid as part_uom_id, " +
                    "  vp.vendorid as vendor_id, COALESCE(v.name, '') as vendor_name, " +
                    "  COALESCE(pr.reorderpoint, 0) as reorder_level, " +
                    "  COALESCE(pr.orderuptolevel, 0) as target_level, " +
                    (usePerLG ?
                    "  COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) as qty_on_hand, " +
                    "  COALESCE(qoo.qty, 0) as qty_on_order, " +
                    "  COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) as qty_allocated, " +
                    "  COALESCE(qds.qty, 0) as qty_on_drop_ship, " +
                    "  GREATEST(COALESCE(qoh.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qal.qty, 0) - COALESCE(qna.qty, 0) + COALESCE(qds.qty, 0), 0) as _available "
                    :
                    "  COALESCE(t.qtyonhand, 0) as qty_on_hand, " +
                    "  COALESCE(t.qtyonorder, 0) as qty_on_order, " +
                    "  COALESCE(t.qtyallocated, 0) as qty_allocated, " +
                    "  COALESCE(t.qtydropship, 0) as qty_on_drop_ship, " +
                    "  COALESCE(t.qtyavailable, 0) as _available "
                    ) +
                    "FROM part p " +
                    "  INNER JOIN uom ON p.uomid = uom.id " +
                    "  LEFT JOIN partreorder pr ON p.id = pr.partid AND pr.locationgroupid IS NULL " +
                    "  INNER JOIN vendorparts vp ON p.id = vp.partid AND vp.defaultflag = 1 " +
                    "  INNER JOIN vendor v ON vp.vendorid = v.id AND v.activeflag = 1 " +
                    (usePerLG ?
                    "  LEFT JOIN qtyonhand qoh ON p.id = qoh.partid AND qoh.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " " +
                    "  LEFT JOIN qtyallocated qal ON p.id = qal.partid AND qal.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " " +
                    "  LEFT JOIN qtyonorder qoo ON p.id = qoo.partid AND qoo.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " " +
                    "  LEFT JOIN qtynotavailable qna ON p.id = qna.partid AND qna.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " " +
                    "  LEFT JOIN qtydropship qds ON p.id = qds.partid AND qds.locationgroupid = " + locationGroupId + " "
                    :
                    "  LEFT JOIN (" +
                    "    SELECT partid, " +
                    "      COALESCE(SUM(qtyonhand), 0) as qtyonhand, " +
                    "      COALESCE(SUM(qtyallocated), 0) as qtyallocated, " +
                    "      COALESCE(SUM(qtyonorder), 0) as qtyonorder, " +
                    "      COALESCE(SUM(qtydropship), 0) as qtydropship, " +
                    "      IF(COALESCE(SUM(qtyonhand) - SUM(qtyallocated) - SUM(qtynotavailable) + SUM(qtydropship), 0) < 0, 0, " +
                    "         COALESCE(SUM(qtyonhand) - SUM(qtyallocated) - SUM(qtynotavailable) + SUM(qtydropship), 0)) as qtyavailable " +
                    "    FROM qtyinventorytotals GROUP BY partid" +
                    "  ) as t ON p.id = t.partid "
                    ) +
                    "WHERE p.typeid = 10 AND vp.vendorid IS NOT NULL";

                // Respect vendor filter
                if (vendorVal !== 'all') {
                    stdQuery += " AND vp.vendorid = " + parseInt(vendorVal);
                }

                // Respect include No ROP/OUL setting
                if (!includeNoROP) {
                    stdQuery += " AND pr.reorderpoint IS NOT NULL AND pr.reorderpoint > 0 AND pr.orderuptolevel IS NOT NULL AND pr.orderuptolevel > 0";
                }

                var stdRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(stdQuery));
                var stdAdded = 0;

                stdRows.forEach(function(row) {
                    // === TRACE: tracked parts standard inventory ===
                    if (isTracePart(row.part_num)) {
                        debugLog('>>> ' + row.part_num + ' STANDARD ROW: already in autoPo=' + !!autoPoPartIds[row.part_id] +
                            ' vendor=' + row.vendor_id + ' ' + row.vendor_name +
                            ' available=' + row._available +
                            ' ROP=' + row.reorder_level + ' OUL=' + row.target_level, 'warning');
                    }

                    // Skip parts already covered by Auto PO data
                    if (autoPoPartIds[row.part_id]) return;

                    // Merge vendorparts data (cost, leadtime, vendor PN, FB part number)
                    var vpKey = row.part_id + '_' + row.vendor_id;
                    var vpData = vendorPartsLookup[vpKey];
                    if (vpData) {
                        row.last_cost = vpData.lastcost;
                        row.lead_time = vpData.leadtime;
                        row._vendorPartNum = vpData.vendorpartnumber;
                        row._fbPartNum = vpData.fbpartnum;
                    } else {
                        row.last_cost = 0;
                        row.lead_time = 0;
                        row._vendorPartNum = '';
                        row._fbPartNum = row.part_num || '';
                    }
                    if (!row._fbPartNum) row._fbPartNum = row.part_num || '';

                    // Standard rows have no auto PO suggestion
                    row.qty_needed = 0;
                    row.qty_suggested = 0;
                    row.vendor_uom_code = row.part_uom_code;
                    row.vendor_uom_id = row.part_uom_id;
                    row._isStandardRow = true;
                    row._available = parseFloat(row._available) || 0;

                    allResults.push(row);
                    var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
                    selectionState[key] = false; // Standard rows start unchecked
                    stdAdded++;
                });

                debugLog('Standard inventory: ' + stdAdded + ' additional parts added (from ' + stdRows.length + ' queried)', 'success');
                totalParts += stdAdded;
            } catch(stdErr) {
                console.error('Standard inventory query failed:', stdErr);
                debugLog('Standard inventory query failed: ' + stdErr.message, 'error');
            }
