            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Per-location-group stock: committed, not available, and what could
            // actually be transferred out of each location group
            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Answers "is there stock elsewhere we could move instead of buying?".
            // The figure that answers it is AVAILABLE TO PICK:
            //
            //     onHand - committed - notAvailable
            //
            // NOT available-for-sale. Available-for-sale subtracts `allocated`,
            // which is total open demand — including orders that might themselves
            // be served from somewhere else. For a transfer decision what matters
            // is stock that is physically present and not already reserved.
            //
            // All three components come from Fishbowl's own views QTYONHAND,
            // QTYCOMMITTED and QTYNOTAVAILABLE, and all three read tag JOIN
            // location — so conditional aggregation gets them in ONE indexed pass
            // instead of three view materialisations. The views are TEMPTABLE (they
            // GROUP BY), so filtering them by partid does NOT push the filter down:
            // MySQL would build the totals for every part in the database first.
            // Reproducing the view bodies with the filter inline keeps tag.partid
            // indexed. Measured on demodb: 2 ms for a vendor-sized part set against
            // 94 ms for the equivalent read of qtyinventorytotals.
            //
            // Two subtleties, both taken from the view definitions rather than
            // assumed — see the notes on each CASE below.
            try {
                var stockPartIds = [];
                allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                    var pid = parseInt(item.part_id);
                    if (pid && stockPartIds.indexOf(pid) === -1) stockPartIds.push(pid);
                });
                if (stockPartIds.length) {
                    // Grouped by LOCATION, with the location-group totals summed back
                    // up in JS — one query serves both levels.
                    //
                    // This was briefly behind a setting on the assumption that per
                    // location would be far more rows than per location group. It is
                    // not: the GROUP BY only emits rows for (part, location) pairs
                    // that actually have tags, and a part sits in one or two bins per
                    // group rather than all of them. Measured on demodb, grouping one
                    // level finer costs 1.3-1.5x the rows (243 -> 318 across every
                    // inventory part) and single-digit milliseconds. The bound is
                    // structural — rows can never exceed the number of distinct
                    // (part, location) tag pairs — so it does not scale with how many
                    // locations exist. Not worth a setting.
                    var stockRows = safeParseQuery(
                        "SELECT t.partid AS part_id, l.locationgroupid AS lg_id, " +
                        "  l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, " +
                        "  l.countedasavailable AS loc_counted, l.typeid AS loc_type, " +
                        // QTYONHAND counts only tag types 30/40.
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.typeid IN (30,40) THEN t.qty END), 0) AS onhand, " +
                        // QTYCOMMITTED deliberately has NO type filter.
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(t.qtycommitted), 0) AS committed, " +
                        // QTYNOTAVAILABLE sums (qty - qtyCommitted), NOT qty, so stock
                        // that is both committed and in a non-available location is
                        // subtracted once rather than twice. It also EXCLUDES shipping
                        // locations (typeId 100) — goods staged to ship are on their
                        // way out, not unavailable.
                        "  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.typeid IN (30,40) " +
                        "                     AND l.countedasavailable = 0 " +
                        "                     AND l.typeid <> 100 " +
                        "                    THEN t.qty - t.qtycommitted END), 0) AS notavailable " +
                        "FROM tag t " +
                        "INNER JOIN location l ON l.id = t.locationid " +
                        "WHERE t.partid IN (" + stockPartIds.join(',') + ") " +
                        "GROUP BY t.partid, l.locationgroupid, l.id, l.name, " +
                        "         l.countedasavailable, l.typeid"
                    );

                    // Only location groups the user can actually see are offered as
                    // transfer sources.
                    var visibleLg = {};
                    userLocationGroups.forEach(function(lg) { visibleLg[lg.id] = lg.name; });

                    var stockByLg = {}, stockTotal = {}, stockByLoc = {};
                    stockRows.forEach(function(r) {
                        var pid = parseInt(r.part_id), lg = parseInt(r.lg_id);
                        if (!lg) return;
                        var onHand    = parseFloat(r.onhand) || 0;
                        var committed = parseFloat(r.committed) || 0;
                        var notAvail  = parseFloat(r.notavailable) || 0;

                        // With location detail on, several rows land on the same
                        // location group, so accumulate rather than assign.
                        if (!stockByLg[pid]) stockByLg[pid] = {};
                        var e = stockByLg[pid][lg];
                        if (!e) {
                            e = stockByLg[pid][lg] = {
                                lgId: lg, lgName: visibleLg[lg] || ('LG ' + lg),
                                onHand: 0, committed: 0, notAvailable: 0, atp: 0,
                                visible: !!visibleLg[lg]
                            };
                        }
                        e.onHand       += onHand;
                        e.committed    += committed;
                        e.notAvailable += notAvail;
                        // QTYCOMMITTED has no tag-type filter while QTYONHAND does, so
                        // committed against a tag outside types 30/40 could in principle
                        // subtract stock that was never added. Floor it rather than
                        // report a negative quantity of transferable stock. Floored on
                        // the LG TOTAL, not per location, so a negative in one bin still
                        // offsets a positive in another before the floor applies.
                        e.atp = Math.max(0, e.onHand - e.committed - e.notAvailable);

                        if (!stockTotal[pid]) stockTotal[pid] = { committed: 0, notAvailable: 0 };
                        stockTotal[pid].committed    += committed;
                        stockTotal[pid].notAvailable += notAvail;

                        // Per-location breakdown, kept only for locations that actually
                        // hold something — an empty bin is noise on a "where is it" list.
                        if (r.loc_id != null && onHand !== 0) {
                            if (!stockByLoc[pid]) stockByLoc[pid] = {};
                            if (!stockByLoc[pid][lg]) stockByLoc[pid][lg] = [];
                            stockByLoc[pid][lg].push({
                                locId: parseInt(r.loc_id),
                                name: r.loc_name || ('Location ' + r.loc_id),
                                onHand: onHand,
                                committed: committed,
                                // A location is "not available" when it is not counted
                                // as available AND is not a shipping location — the same
                                // test QTYNOTAVAILABLE applies. Shipping locations hold
                                // stock on its way out, which is a different thing.
                                notAvailable: !truthyBit(r.loc_counted) && parseInt(r.loc_type) !== 100,
                                shipping: parseInt(r.loc_type) === 100
                            });
                        }
                    });

                    allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                        var pid = parseInt(item.part_id);
                        var byLg = stockByLg[pid] || {};
                        var tot  = stockTotal[pid] || { committed: 0, notAvailable: 0 };
                        item._lgStock = byLg;
                        // { lgId: [ {name, onHand, committed, notAvailable, shipping} ] },
                        // biggest holding first — only present when the setting is on.
                        item._lgLoc = stockByLoc[pid] || null;
                        if (item._lgLoc) {
                            Object.keys(item._lgLoc).forEach(function(k) {
                                item._lgLoc[k].sort(function(a, b) { return b.onHand - a.onHand; });
                            });
                        }

                        // Committed and Not Available must be scoped the SAME way as
                        // On Hand and Allocated on this row, or the columns describe
                        // different populations and the row cannot be read. With one
                        // location group selected every other quantity is that LG's,
                        // so a company-wide total here would badly overstate what is
                        // reserved at the location group being ordered for.
                        item.qty_committed = (locationGroupId > 0)
                            ? ((byLg[locationGroupId] || {}).committed || 0)
                            : tot.committed;
                        item.qty_not_available = (locationGroupId > 0)
                            ? ((byLg[locationGroupId] || {}).notAvailable || 0)
                            : tot.notAvailable;
                        // computePartStatus falls back to _qty_not_available when the
                        // row has no pre-computed _available. Only the date post-filter
                        // set it, and only for parts it looked at; fill the gaps so the
                        // fallback is consistent, without overriding what it found.
                        if (item._qty_not_available === undefined) {
                            item._qty_not_available = item.qty_not_available;
                        }

                        // Carry the stock figures onto the per-LG rows that already
                        // exist for a needing location group.
                        if (item._perLgDetail) {
                            Object.keys(item._perLgDetail).forEach(function(lgId) {
                                var s = byLg[parseInt(lgId)];
                                var d = item._perLgDetail[lgId];
                                d.committed    = s ? s.committed    : 0;
                                d.notAvailable = s ? s.notAvailable : 0;
                                d.atp          = s ? s.atp          : 0;
                            });
                        }
                        computeAvailElsewhere(item, locationGroupId);
                    });
                    debugLog('Per-LG stock (committed / not available / available to pick) loaded for ' +
                             stockPartIds.length + ' part(s) from ' + stockRows.length + ' part/LG row(s)', 'info');
                }
            } catch (stockErr) {
                debugLog('Per-LG stock query failed: ' + stockErr.message, 'warning');
            }

            // === TRACE: tracked parts final summary ===
            TRACE_PARTS.forEach(function(traceName) {
                var traceItems = allResults.filter(function(r) {
                    return (r._fbPartNum || r.part_num || '').toUpperCase() === traceName;
                });
                if (traceItems.length > 0) {
                    debugLog('>>> ' + traceName + ' FINAL SUMMARY: ' + traceItems.length + ' row(s) in allResults', 'warning');
                    traceItems.forEach(function(b, idx) {
                        var key = b.vendor_id + '_' + b.part_id;
                        debugLog('>>> ' + traceName + ' [' + idx + ']: vendor=' + b.vendor_name + ' (id=' + b.vendor_id + ')' +
                            ' partId=' + b.part_id +
                            ' isAutoPo=' + !!b._isAutoPo + ' isStandard=' + !!b._isStandardRow +
                            ' needed=' + b.qty_needed + ' suggested=' + b.qty_suggested +
                            ' onhand=' + b.qty_on_hand + ' allocated=' + b.qty_allocated +
                            ' onorder=' + b.qty_on_order + ' available=' + b._available +
                            ' ROP=' + b.reorder_level + ' OUL=' + b.target_level +
                            ' perLgQty=' + JSON.stringify(b._perLgQty || null) +
                            ' selected=' + !!selectionState[key], 'warning');
                    });
                } else {
                    debugLog('>>> ' + traceName + ' FINAL SUMMARY: NOT FOUND in allResults (0 rows)', 'error');
                }
            });

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Compute status (state + capacity %) for all rows
            // ------------------------------------------------
            allResults.forEach(function(item) {
                computePartStatus(item);
            });

            // JS-side safety net: remove norop items when the checkbox is unchecked.
            // The SQL queries and Auto PO engine should already filter these, but
            // edge cases (e.g. ROP=0/OUL>0, or engine not filtering) can leak through.
            if (!includeNoROP) {
                var beforeCount = allResults.length;
                allResults = allResults.filter(function(item) {
                    return item._state !== 'norop';
                });
                if (allResults.length < beforeCount) {
                    debugLog('Post-filter removed ' + (beforeCount - allResults.length) + ' norop items that leaked through SQL/engine filters', 'warning');
                }
            }

            setLoadEnabled(true);

            if (allResults.length === 0) {
                clearProgress();
                showStatus('No inventory data found for the selected parameters.', 'warning');
                debugLog('No inventory data found', 'warning');
                document.getElementById('tableWrap').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('poSummaryBar').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display = 'block';
                setStatusLine('No inventory data found for the selected parameters.');
                return;
            }

            clearProgress();
            showStatus('Loaded ' + totalParts + ' parts from ' + vendorsWithData + ' vendor(s).', 'success');
            debugLog('Total loaded: ' + totalParts + ' parts from ' + vendorsWithData + ' vendor(s)', 'success');
            document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('poSummaryBar').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('tableWrap').style.display = 'block';

            computeDerivedFields();
            buildVendorIndex();
            renderTable();
            setStatusLine('Loaded ' + totalParts + ' parts from ' + vendorsWithData + ' vendor(s).');

            } catch (e) {
                console.error('loadAutoPoData finaliseLoad error:', e);
                showStatus('Error loading data: ' + e.message, 'error');
                setLoadEnabled(true);
            }
            } // end finaliseLoad

            loadVendorAt(0);

        } catch (e) {
            console.error('loadAutoPoData setup error:', e);
            showStatus('Error loading data: ' + e.message, 'error');
            setLoadEnabled(true);
        }
    }

    // ============================================
    // Status
    // ============================================
    function showStatus(message, type, heading) {
        var container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'toast ' + (type || 'info');
        if (heading) {
            toast.innerHTML = '<strong style="display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">' + heading + '</strong>' +
                '<span style="font-size:12px;">' + message + '</span>';
        } else {
            toast.textContent = message;
        }
        container.appendChild(toast);

        // Auto-dismiss after 5 seconds (longer for messages with headings)
        var dismissDelay = heading ? 10000 : 3000;
        setTimeout(function() {
            toast.classList.add('fade-out');
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (toast.parentNode) toast.parentNode.removeChild(toast);
            }, 300);
        }, dismissDelay);
    }

    // ============================================
    // Column Filters
    // ============================================
    function applyColumnFilters() {
        renderTable();
    }

    function clearColumnFilters() {
        document.getElementById('filterPartNum').value = '';
        document.getElementById('filterDescription').value = '';
        renderTable();
    }

    // Vendor narrowing is the Vendor selector in the same strip, so there is no separate
    // vendor text filter here.
    function getFilteredData() {
        var fp = (document.getElementById('filterPartNum').value || '').toLowerCase();
        var fd = (document.getElementById('filterDescription').value || '').toLowerCase();
        var suggestedOnly = document.getElementById('paramSuggestedOnly').checked;

        return allResults.filter(function(row) {
            if (fp && (row.part_num || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(fp) === -1) return false;
            if (fd && (row.part_description || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(fd) === -1) return false;
            if (suggestedOnly && (parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0) <= 0) return false;
            return true;
        });
    }

    // ============================================
    // Settings (FBLib.Settings — user layer + report master layer)
    // ============================================
    // ============================================
    // UOM conversion engine
    //
    // Parts carry their own sizeUomId / weightUomId, and in real data those are mixed
    // (mm, cm, in, ft for size; kg and lbs for weight), so conversion is mandatory.
    //
    // uomconversion semantics, per Fishbowl's own views:
    //     value_in_TO = value_in_FROM * multiply / factor
    // But rows only exist for pairs an admin explicitly created — there is no guarantee
    // that, say, in->m exists. So we seed known SI units by uom.code and walk the
    // conversion graph outward from those anchors to resolve everything else.
    // ============================================
    const UOM_TYPE_WEIGHT = 2;
    const UOM_TYPE_LENGTH = 3;

    const SI_LENGTH = {
        'mm': 0.001, 'cm': 0.01, 'm': 1, 'km': 1000,
        'in': 0.0254, 'ft': 0.3048, 'yd': 0.9144, 'mi': 1609.344
    };
    const SI_WEIGHT = {
        'mg': 0.000001, 'g': 0.001, 'kg': 1, 't': 1000, 'tonne': 1000,
        'oz': 0.0283495231, 'lb': 0.45359237, 'lbs': 0.45359237, 'ton': 907.18474
    };

    var UOM_BY_ID = {};   // { id: { id, code, name, type } }
    var UOM_CONV  = {};   // { fromId: [ { to, ratio } ] }  ratio = multiply / factor
    var LEN_TO_M  = {};   // { uomId: metres per unit }
    var WT_TO_KG  = {};   // { uomId: kilograms per unit }
    var PART_DIMS = {};   // { partId: { uomId, volM3, kg, w, h, l, sizeUomCode, ... } }
    var _uomLoaded = false;

    function loadUomEngine(force) {
        if (_uomLoaded && !force) return;
        UOM_BY_ID = {}; UOM_CONV = {}; LEN_TO_M = {}; WT_TO_KG = {};
        try {
            var uoms = JSON.parse(runQuery('SELECT id, code, name, uomtype, integral FROM uom') || '[]') || [];
            uoms.forEach(function(u) {
                UOM_BY_ID[parseInt(u.id)] = {
                    id: parseInt(u.id),
                    code: String(u.code || '').trim(),
                    name: u.name,
                    type: parseInt(u.uomtype),
                    integral: truthyBit(u.integral)
                };
            });

            var convs = JSON.parse(runQuery('SELECT fromuomid, touomid, multiply, factor FROM uomconversion') || '[]') || [];
            convs.forEach(function(c) {
                var f = parseInt(c.fromuomid), t = parseInt(c.touomid);
                var mul = parseFloat(c.multiply), fac = parseFloat(c.factor);
                if (!f || !t || !isFinite(mul) || !isFinite(fac) || fac === 0) return;
                if (!UOM_CONV[f]) UOM_CONV[f] = [];
                UOM_CONV[f].push({ to: t, ratio: mul / fac });
            });
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('UOM engine load failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
            return;
        }

        LEN_TO_M = _seedAndWalk(UOM_TYPE_LENGTH, SI_LENGTH);
        WT_TO_KG = _seedAndWalk(UOM_TYPE_WEIGHT, SI_WEIGHT);
        _uomLoaded = true;
        debugLog('UOM engine ready: ' + Object.keys(LEN_TO_M).length + ' length units, ' +
                 Object.keys(WT_TO_KG).length + ' weight units resolved', 'success');
    }

    // Anchor on SI codes, then BFS outward.
    // If value_T = value_F * r then one unit of T is worth (base(F) / r) base units.
    function _seedAndWalk(uomType, siTable) {
        var out = {};
        var queue = [];
        Object.keys(UOM_BY_ID).forEach(function(id) {
            var u = UOM_BY_ID[id];
            if (u.type !== uomType) return;
            var f = siTable[u.code.toLowerCase()];
            if (f !== undefined) { out[u.id] = f; queue.push(u.id); }
        });

        var guard = 0;
        while (queue.length && guard++ < 20000) {
            var from = queue.shift();
            var edges = UOM_CONV[from] || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
                var e = edges[i];
                if (out[e.to] !== undefined || !e.ratio) continue;
                var tu = UOM_BY_ID[e.to];
                if (!tu || tu.type !== uomType) continue;
                out[e.to] = out[from] / e.ratio;
                queue.push(e.to);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // General pairwise conversion for quantity UOMs (packs, boxes, each).
    // Returns the multiplier that turns a qty in fromId into a qty in toId, or null.
    function uomRatio(fromId, toId) {
        fromId = parseInt(fromId); toId = parseInt(toId);
        if (!fromId || !toId) return null;
        if (fromId === toId) return 1;

        var seen = {}; seen[fromId] = true;
        var queue = [{ id: fromId, r: 1 }];
        var guard = 0;
        while (queue.length && guard++ < 5000) {
            var cur = queue.shift();
            var edges = UOM_CONV[cur.id] || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
                var e = edges[i];
                var r = cur.r * e.ratio;
                if (e.to === toId) return r;
                if (seen[e.to]) continue;
                seen[e.to] = true;
                queue.push({ id: e.to, r: r });
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    // Fishbowl marks a UOM integral when it cannot be subdivided (Each, and anything else the
    // customer flags). Order quantities in such a UOM must be whole numbers.
    function uomIsIntegral(uomId) {
        var u = UOM_BY_ID[parseInt(uomId)];
        return !!(u && u.integral);
    }

    // ============================================
    // Tax rates
    //
    // taxrate.orderTypeId: 10 = purchase, 20 = sales, NULL = either. A PO must never carry a
    // sales-only rate, so anything scoped to 20 is rejected here rather than sent to Fishbowl.
    //
    // A rate is identified by its taxrate.id and NEVER by a name or code string, because
    // neither string identifies a rate on its own:
    //   * taxrate.code is not unique — "NCG" is both id 4 and id 13, "NCF" both id 5 and id 8.
    //   * The CSV importer discards names. Sending the exact, unique, active, purchase-scoped
    //     name "GST on Expenses" produced poitem.taxId = NULL, and so did an empty string, so
    //     blank does not fall back to the part default either — it just leaves the line untaxed.
    // The REST create endpoint takes taxRate:{id}, which is exact. That is why PO creation
    // goes through REST rather than ImportPurchaseOrder.
    // ============================================
    const TAX_ORDERTYPE_PURCHASE = 10;

    // Returns { id, name } when the rate may legally appear on a purchase order, else null.
    function purchaseTaxRate(id, name, orderTypeId) {
        var tid = parseInt(id);
        if (!tid) return null;
        var ot = (orderTypeId === null || orderTypeId === undefined || orderTypeId === '')
            ? null : parseInt(orderTypeId);
        if (ot !== null && ot !== TAX_ORDERTYPE_PURCHASE) return null;   // sales-scoped — not valid on a PO
        return { id: tid, name: name ? String(name) : ('#' + tid) };
    }

    // vendor.taxRateId is the vendor's own rate. Returns null when unset or sales-scoped.
    var _vendorTaxCache = {};

    function lookupVendorTaxRate(vendorId) {
        if (_vendorTaxCache[vendorId] !== undefined) return _vendorTaxCache[vendorId];
        var out = null;
        try {
            var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                "SELECT tr.id, tr.name, tr.ordertypeid " +
                "FROM vendor v INNER JOIN taxrate tr ON tr.id = v.taxrateid " +
                "WHERE v.id = " + parseInt(vendorId)
            ) || '[]') || [];
            if (rows.length) out = purchaseTaxRate(rows[0].id, rows[0].name, rows[0].ordertypeid);
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Vendor tax lookup failed for vendor ' + vendorId + ': ' + e.message, 'warning');
        }
        _vendorTaxCache[vendorId] = out;
        return out;
    }

    // The rule: the vendor's rate wins; otherwise fall back to the part's. Null means the line
    // is sent with no taxRate object at all, leaving Fishbowl to apply whatever it defaults to.
    function resolveLineTaxRate(vendorTax, partTax) {
        return vendorTax || partTax || null;
    }

    // ============================================
    // Part dimensions
    //
    // Both part and product carry an independent width/height/len/weight set. Take a
    // complete set atomically from ONE record with its own size UOM — never mix a part's
    // width with a product's length. Purchasing buys parts, so part wins ties.
    // ============================================
    function loadPartDimensions() {
        PART_DIMS = {};
        // Tax comes from part.taxId, NOT product.taxId. In Fishbowl the part carries the
        // PURCHASE-side rate (taxrate.orderTypeId 10 or NULL) while the product carries the
        // SALES-side rate (orderTypeId 20) — putting a product rate on a PO would stamp a
        // sales tax code onto a purchase order.
        var sql =
            "SELECT p.id, p.uomid, " +
            "p.width, p.height, p.len, p.sizeuomid, p.weight, p.weightuomid, " +
            "pr.width AS pwidth, pr.height AS pheight, pr.len AS plen, pr.sizeuomid AS psizeuomid, " +
            "pr.weight AS pweight, pr.weightuomid AS pweightuomid, " +
            "p.taxid, ptr.name AS taxname, ptr.ordertypeid AS taxordertype " +
            "FROM part p " +
            "LEFT JOIN product pr ON pr.id = p.defaultproductid " +
            "LEFT JOIN taxrate ptr ON ptr.id = p.taxid " +
            "WHERE p.typeid = 10";

        var rows;
        try {
            rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(sql) || '[]') || [];
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Part dimension query failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
            return;
        }

        var withDims = 0, withWeight = 0;
        rows.forEach(function(r) {
            var rec = {
                uomId: parseInt(r.uomid) || null,
                volM3: null, kg: null,
                w: null, h: null, l: null,
                sizeUomCode: null, dimSource: null, wtSource: null, dimNote: null,
                taxRate: purchaseTaxRate(r.taxid, r.taxname, r.taxordertype)
            };

            var sets = [
                { w: r.width,  h: r.height,  l: r.len,  u: r.sizeuomid,  src: 'part'    },
                { w: r.pwidth, h: r.pheight, l: r.plen, u: r.psizeuomid, src: 'product' }
            ];
            for (var i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
                var s = sets[i];
                var w = parseFloat(s.w), h = parseFloat(s.h), l = parseFloat(s.l);
                var uid = parseInt(s.u);
                if (!(w > 0 && h > 0 && l > 0)) continue;
                if (!uid) { rec.dimNote = 'Dimensions present but no size UOM is set'; continue; }
                var f = LEN_TO_M[uid];
                if (f === undefined) {
                    rec.dimNote = 'Size UOM "' + ((UOM_BY_ID[uid] || {}).code || uid) +
                                  '" has no conversion to metres';
                    continue;
                }
                rec.w = w; rec.h = h; rec.l = l;
                rec.sizeUomCode = (UOM_BY_ID[uid] || {}).code || '';
                rec.dimSource = s.src;
                rec.volM3 = (w * f) * (h * f) * (l * f);
                withDims++;
                break;
            }
            if (rec.volM3 == null && !rec.dimNote) {
                rec.dimNote = 'No width/height/length on the part record';
            }

            var wsets = [
                { v: r.weight,  u: r.weightuomid,  src: 'part'    },
                { v: r.pweight, u: r.pweightuomid, src: 'product' }
            ];
            for (var j = 0; j < wsets.length; j++) {
                var ws = wsets[j];
                var wv = parseFloat(ws.v);
                var wu = parseInt(ws.u);
                if (!(wv > 0) || !wu) continue;
                var wf = WT_TO_KG[wu];
                if (wf === undefined) continue;
                rec.kg = wv * wf;
                rec.wtSource = ws.src;
                withWeight++;
                break;
            }

            PART_DIMS[parseInt(r.id)] = rec;
        });

        debugLog('Part dimensions: ' + rows.length + ' parts scanned, ' + withDims +
                 ' with full W/H/L, ' + withWeight + ' with weight', 'info');
    }

    // Attaches per-unit cube/weight and the qty->base-UOM factor to every loaded row.
    // Skips rows it has already processed, so calling it once per vendor tick is cheap.
    function computeDerivedFields() {
        for (var i = 0; i < allResults.length; i++) {
            var item = allResults[i];
            if (item._derivedDone) continue;

            item._unitVolM3 = null;
            item._unitKg = null;
            item._dimW = null; item._dimH = null; item._dimL = null;
            item._sizeUomCode = null;
            item._dimSource = null; item._wtSource = null;
            item._dimNote = null;
            item._qtyToBase = 1;
            item._partTaxRate = null;
            // Order Qty is entered in the UOM shown in the UOM column.
            item._qtyIntegral = uomIsIntegral(item.part_uom_id);

            // Minimum order quantity for THIS part from THIS vendor
            // (vendorparts.qtyMin). It is loaded with the rest of the vendorparts
            // data but was never surfaced on the row. Attached here rather than in
            // each loader so every row source — engine, per-LG scan and standard
            // inventory — gets it the same way.
            var vp = vendorPartsLookup[item.part_id + '_' + item.vendor_id];
            item._qtyMin = (vp && parseFloat(vp.qtymin) > 0) ? parseFloat(vp.qtymin) : null;

            var d = PART_DIMS[item.part_id];
            if (!d) {
                item._dimNote = 'Part not found in the dimension lookup';
                item._derivedDone = true;
                continue;
            }
            item._partTaxRate = d.taxRate || null;

            if (d.volM3 != null) {
                item._unitVolM3 = d.volM3;
                item._dimW = d.w; item._dimH = d.h; item._dimL = d.l;
                item._sizeUomCode = d.sizeUomCode;
                item._dimSource = d.dimSource;
            } else {
                item._dimNote = d.dimNote;
            }

            if (d.kg != null) {
                item._unitKg = d.kg;
                item._wtSource = d.wtSource;
            }

            // Order Qty is denominated in the UOM shown in the UOM column — part_uom_code,
            // the part's stocking UOM as returned by the Auto PO engine — and the dimensions
            // above are per unit of that same stocking UOM, so this is normally a no-op.
            // It is done explicitly and defensively because vendorparts.uomId frequently
            // differs from part.uomId (pk vs ea, BX500 vs BX1000), and a silent mismatch
            // would scale every cube and weight figure wrongly.
            var qtyUomId = parseInt(item.part_uom_id) || null;
            if (qtyUomId && d.uomId && qtyUomId !== d.uomId) {
                var r = uomRatio(qtyUomId, d.uomId);
                if (r == null) {
                    item._noQtyConv = true;
                    debugLog('No UOM conversion from ' + ((UOM_BY_ID[qtyUomId] || {}).code || qtyUomId) +
                             ' to ' + ((UOM_BY_ID[d.uomId] || {}).code || d.uomId) +
                             ' for part ' + item.part_num + ' — cube/weight assume 1:1', 'warning');
                } else {
                    item._qtyToBase = r;
                }
            }

            item._derivedDone = true;
        }
    }

    // ============================================
    // Settings (FBLib.Settings — user layer + report master layer)
    // ============================================
    let _prefs = {};

    function initSettings() {
        try {
            FBLib.Settings.init(SETTINGS);
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('FBLib.Settings.init failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
        }

        _prefs = {
            dateRange:         FBLib.Settings.resolve('dateRange'),
            defaultVendorOnly: FBLib.Settings.resolve('defaultVendorOnly'),
            showVendorPN:      FBLib.Settings.resolve('showVendorPN'),
            includeNoROP:      FBLib.Settings.resolve('includeNoROP'),
            includeMfg:        FBLib.Settings.resolve('includeMfg'),
            suggestedOnly:     FBLib.Settings.resolve('suggestedOnly'),
            showContainer:     FBLib.Settings.resolve('showContainer'),
            filtersHidden:     FBLib.Settings.resolve('filtersHidden'),
            containerByVendor: FBLib.Settings.resolve('containerByVendor') || {},
            containerQtyByVendor: FBLib.Settings.resolve('containerQtyByVendor') || {},
            defaultContainer:  FBLib.Settings.resolve('defaultContainer') || '40ft_hc',
            volAllowance:      parseFloat(FBLib.Settings.resolve('volAllowance')),
            weightAllowance:   parseFloat(FBLib.Settings.resolve('weightAllowance'))
        };
        if (!isFinite(_prefs.volAllowance)    || _prefs.volAllowance    <= 0) _prefs.volAllowance = 100;
        if (!isFinite(_prefs.weightAllowance) || _prefs.weightAllowance <= 0) _prefs.weightAllowance = 100;

        // Container types: saved set if present, otherwise the built-in defaults.
        var savedContainers = FBLib.Settings.resolve('containers');
        CONTAINER_LIST = (Array.isArray(savedContainers) && savedContainers.length)
            ? savedContainers.map(function(c, i) {
                  return {
                      key: c.key || ('c' + i),
                      label: c.label || ('Container ' + (i + 1)),
                      len: parseFloat(c.len) || 0,
                      wid: parseFloat(c.wid) || 0,
                      hgt: parseFloat(c.hgt) || 0,
                      payloadKg: parseFloat(c.payloadKg) || 0
                  };
              })
            : cloneContainerDefaults();
        rebuildContainerIndex();
        if (!CONTAINER_SPECS[_prefs.defaultContainer]) _prefs.defaultContainer = CONTAINER_LIST[0].key;

        // Restore the sort. Guarded on the column still existing, so a saved sort
        // on a column that has since been removed degrades to natural order.
        var savedSortKey = FBLib.Settings.resolve('sortKey');
        if (savedSortKey && _columns.some(function(c) { return c.key === savedSortKey; })) {
            _sort = { key: savedSortKey, dir: FBLib.Settings.resolve('sortDir') === -1 ? -1 : 1 };
        }

        // Column order + visibility. Resilient to columns being added or removed between
        // versions: saved order first, then any column the saved set doesn't know about.
        var savedCols = FBLib.Settings.resolve('cols');
        if (Array.isArray(savedCols) && savedCols.length) {
            var savedMap  = {};
            savedCols.forEach(function(c) { savedMap[c.key] = c; });
            var reordered = savedCols
                .map(function(sc) { return _columns.find(function(c) { return c.key === sc.key; }); })
                .filter(Boolean);
            var extras = _columns.filter(function(c) { return !savedMap[c.key]; });
            _columns = reordered.concat(extras);
            _columns.forEach(function(c) { if (savedMap[c.key]) c.vis = !!savedMap[c.key].vis; });
        }

        // Column widths. Kept only for columns that still exist, so a width saved
        // against a column that has since been removed does not linger.
        var savedW = FBLib.Settings.resolve('colWidths');
        if (savedW && typeof savedW === 'object') {
            var known = {};
            _columns.forEach(function(c) { known[c.key] = true; });
            _colWidths = {};
            Object.keys(savedW).forEach(function(k) {
                var px = parseInt(savedW[k]);
                if (!isFinite(px) || px < MIN_COL_W) return;
                if (k === '__sel' || known[k]) _colWidths[k] = px;
            });
        }

        // Usage period. Restored before the first render so a saved custom window is
        // in place by the time the columns ask for it.
        var uRange = FBLib.Settings.resolve('usageRange');
        var uSel = document.getElementById('paramUsageRange');
        if (uSel && uRange) {
            for (var ui = 0; ui < uSel.options.length; ui++) {
                if (uSel.options[ui].value === String(uRange)) { uSel.value = String(uRange); break; }
            }
        }
        var uStart = FBLib.Settings.resolve('usageStart');
        var uEnd   = FBLib.Settings.resolve('usageEnd');
        if (uStart) document.getElementById('paramUsageStart').value = uStart;
        if (uEnd)   document.getElementById('paramUsageEnd').value   = uEnd;
        syncUsageControlVisibility();

        // Push the remembered filter state onto the DOM controls.
        applyPrefsToControls();
    }

    function applyPrefsToControls() {
        function setCheck(id, val) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el && val !== undefined && val !== null) el.checked = !!val;
        }
        setCheck('paramDefaultVendorOnly', _prefs.defaultVendorOnly);
        setCheck('paramShowVendorPN',      _prefs.showVendorPN);
        setCheck('paramIncludeNoROP',      _prefs.includeNoROP);
        setCheck('paramIncludeMfg',        _prefs.includeMfg);
        setCheck('paramSuggestedOnly',     _prefs.suggestedOnly);
        setCheck('paramShowContainer',     _prefs.showContainer);
        applyFilterBarState(!!_prefs.filtersHidden);

        var dr = document.getElementById('paramDateRange');
        if (dr && _prefs.dateRange) {
            for (var i = 0; i < dr.options.length; i++) {
                if (dr.options[i].value === _prefs.dateRange) { dr.value = _prefs.dateRange; break; }
            }
            // initParameters() already ran applyDateRange() against the default selection, so
            // the start/end inputs must be recomputed for the restored range.
            applyDateRange();
        }
    }

    function persistCols() {
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('cols', _columns.map(function(c) {
            return { key: c.key, vis: c.vis };
        }));
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    }

    function persistPrefs() {
        function chk(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.checked : undefined; }
        var dr = document.getElementById('paramDateRange');
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('dateRange',         dr ? dr.value : 'all');
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('defaultVendorOnly', chk('paramDefaultVendorOnly'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('showVendorPN',      chk('paramShowVendorPN'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('includeNoROP',      chk('paramIncludeNoROP'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('includeMfg',        chk('paramIncludeMfg'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('suggestedOnly',     chk('paramSuggestedOnly'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('showContainer',     chk('paramShowContainer'));
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    }

    function persistContainerPrefs() {
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('containerByVendor', _prefs.containerByVendor);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('containerQtyByVendor', _prefs.containerQtyByVendor);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('defaultContainer',  _prefs.defaultContainer);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('volAllowance',      _prefs.volAllowance);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('weightAllowance',   _prefs.weightAllowance);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('containers',        CONTAINER_LIST);
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    }

    // ============================================
    // Settings drawer — container types + usable allowances
    // ============================================
    function renderContainerSettings() {
        var volEl = document.getElementById('setVolAllow');
        var wtEl  = document.getElementById('setWtAllow');
        if (volEl) volEl.value = _prefs.volAllowance;
        if (wtEl)  wtEl.value = _prefs.weightAllowance;

        var body = document.getElementById('setContainerRows');
        if (!body) return;
        body.innerHTML = '';

        CONTAINER_LIST.forEach(function(c, i) {
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.setAttribute('data-idx', i);
            tr.innerHTML =
                '<td><input class="set-label" data-f="label" value="' + escAttr(c.label) + '"></td>' +
                '<td><input class="set-num" data-f="len"  type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value="' + c.len + '"></td>' +
                '<td><input class="set-num" data-f="wid"  type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value="' + c.wid + '"></td>' +
                '<td><input class="set-num" data-f="hgt"  type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value="' + c.hgt + '"></td>' +
                '<td><input class="set-num" data-f="payloadKg" type="number" step="1" min="0" value="' + c.payloadKg + '"></td>' +
                '<td class="set-vol"></td>' +
                '<td><button class="set-del" title="Remove this container">×</button></td>';

            tr.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(function(inp) {
                inp.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSettingsVolume(tr); });
            });
            tr.querySelector('.set-del').addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (CONTAINER_LIST.length <= 1) {
                    showStatus('Keep at least one container type.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }
                readContainerSettingsFromDom();
                CONTAINER_LIST.splice(parseInt(tr.getAttribute('data-idx')), 1);
                renderContainerSettings();
            });

            body.appendChild(tr);
            updateSettingsVolume(tr);
        });
    }

    function updateSettingsVolume(tr) {
        function v(f) { return parseFloat(tr.querySelector('[data-f="' + f + '"]').value) || 0; }
        var cell = tr.querySelector('.set-vol');
        if (cell) cell.textContent = (v('len') * v('wid') * v('hgt')).toFixed(2);
    }

    // Pulls the drawer inputs back into CONTAINER_LIST without persisting.
    function readContainerSettingsFromDom() {
        var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#setContainerRows tr');
        var next = [];
        rows.forEach(function(tr, i) {
            function val(f) { return tr.querySelector('[data-f="' + f + '"]').value; }
            var existing = CONTAINER_LIST[i] || {};
            var label = String(val('label') || '').trim() || ('Container ' + (i + 1));
            next.push({
                // Keep the original key so per-vendor selections survive a rename.
                key: existing.key || ('c' + i + '_' + label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '')),
                label: label,
                len: parseFloat(val('len')) || 0,
                wid: parseFloat(val('wid')) || 0,
                hgt: parseFloat(val('hgt')) || 0,
                payloadKg: parseFloat(val('payloadKg')) || 0
            });
        });
        CONTAINER_LIST = next;
        rebuildContainerIndex();
    }

    function addContainerRow() {
        readContainerSettingsFromDom();
        CONTAINER_LIST.push({
            key: 'custom_' + (CONTAINER_LIST.length + 1) + '_' + CONTAINER_LIST.length,
            label: 'New container', len: 12.03, wid: 2.35, hgt: 2.39, payloadKg: 25000
        });
        rebuildContainerIndex();
        renderContainerSettings();
    }

    function saveContainerSettings() {
        readContainerSettingsFromDom();

        var vol = parseFloat(document.getElementById('setVolAllow').value);
        var wt  = parseFloat(document.getElementById('setWtAllow').value);
        if (!isFinite(vol) || vol <= 0 || vol > 100) vol = 100;
        if (!isFinite(wt)  || wt  <= 0 || wt  > 100) wt  = 100;
        _prefs.volAllowance = vol;
        _prefs.weightAllowance = wt;

        var bad = CONTAINER_LIST.filter(function(c) {
            return !(c.len > 0 && c.wid > 0 && c.hgt > 0 && c.payloadKg > 0);
        });
        if (bad.length) {
            showStatus(bad.length + ' container type(s) have a zero dimension or payload — ' +
                       'their fill percentages will not compute.', 'warning');
        }

        // Drop per-vendor picks that point at a container that no longer exists.
        Object.keys(_prefs.containerByVendor || {}).forEach(function(vid) {
            if (!CONTAINER_SPECS[_prefs.containerByVendor[vid]]) delete _prefs.containerByVendor[vid];
        });
        if (!CONTAINER_SPECS[_prefs.defaultContainer]) {
            _prefs.defaultContainer = CONTAINER_LIST[0].key;
        }

        persistContainerPrefs();
        renderContainerSettings();
        renderTable();
        showStatus('Container settings saved.', 'success');
    }

    function resetContainerSettings() {
        CONTAINER_LIST = cloneContainerDefaults();
        rebuildContainerIndex();
        _prefs.volAllowance = 100;
        _prefs.weightAllowance = 100;
        _prefs.containerByVendor = {};
        _prefs.containerQtyByVendor = {};
        _prefs.defaultContainer = '40ft_hc';
        persistContainerPrefs();
        renderContainerSettings();
        renderTable();
        showStatus('Container settings reset to defaults.', 'info');
    }

    function setStatusLine(text) {
        var el = document.getElementById('statusLine');
        if (el) el.textContent = text;
    }

    // Collapsing the filter bar buys back ~60px of table height on short screens. Load has
    // to stay reachable, so the green Run button moves into the header while it is hidden.
    function applyFilterBarState(hidden) {
        var panel  = document.getElementById('filtersPanel');
        var toggle = document.getElementById('filterToggleBtn');
        var run    = document.getElementById('hdrRunBtn');
        if (!panel) return;
        panel.classList.toggle('hidden', !!hidden);
        if (toggle) {
            toggle.classList.toggle('active', !hidden);
            toggle.title = hidden ? 'Show the filter bar' : 'Hide the filter bar';
        }
        if (run) run.style.display = hidden ? '' : 'none';
    }

    function toggleFilters() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('filtersPanel');
        if (!panel) return;
        var nowHidden = !panel.classList.contains('hidden');
        applyFilterBarState(nowHidden);
        _prefs.filtersHidden = nowHidden;
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('filtersHidden', nowHidden);
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    }

    // ============================================
    // Container capacity
    // Internal dimensions in metres, payload in kg. Volume is computed, never stored.
    // ============================================
    const CONTAINER_DEFAULTS = [
        { key: '20ft',    label: '20ft Standard',  len: 5.90,  wid: 2.35, hgt: 2.39, payloadKg: 25000 },
        { key: '40ft',    label: '40ft Standard',  len: 12.03, wid: 2.35, hgt: 2.39, payloadKg: 27600 },
        { key: '40ft_hc', label: '40ft High Cube', len: 12.03, wid: 2.35, hgt: 2.69, payloadKg: 26580 },
        { key: '45ft_hc', label: '45ft High Cube', len: 13.56, wid: 2.35, hgt: 2.69, payloadKg: 27600 }
    ];

    // Live, user-configurable set (Settings drawer). CONTAINER_SPECS is the key index.
    let CONTAINER_LIST = [];
    let CONTAINER_SPECS = {};

    function cloneContainerDefaults() {
        return CONTAINER_DEFAULTS.map(function(c) {
            return { key: c.key, label: c.label, len: c.len, wid: c.wid, hgt: c.hgt, payloadKg: c.payloadKg };
        });
    }

    function rebuildContainerIndex() {
        CONTAINER_SPECS = {};
        CONTAINER_LIST.forEach(function(c) { CONTAINER_SPECS[c.key] = c; });
        if (!CONTAINER_LIST.length) {
            CONTAINER_LIST = cloneContainerDefaults();
            CONTAINER_LIST.forEach(function(c) { CONTAINER_SPECS[c.key] = c; });
        }
    }

    function vendorContainerKey(vendorId) {
        var k = _prefs.containerByVendor ? _prefs.containerByVendor[vendorId] : null;
        if (CONTAINER_SPECS[k]) return k;
        if (CONTAINER_SPECS[_prefs.defaultContainer]) return _prefs.defaultContainer;
        return CONTAINER_LIST.length ? CONTAINER_LIST[0].key : null;
    }

    function vendorContainerSpec(vendorId) {
        return CONTAINER_SPECS[vendorContainerKey(vendorId)] ||
               CONTAINER_LIST[0] ||
               CONTAINER_DEFAULTS[2];
    }

    // Nominal internal volume reduced by the volume allowance: an allowance of 80% means the
    // container reads 100% full at 80% of nominal. Bulk cube only — there is no bin-packing,
    // so this already flatters what will really fit.
    function containerUsableVolume(spec) {
        return spec.len * spec.wid * spec.hgt * (_prefs.volAllowance / 100);
    }

    function containerUsablePayload(spec) {
        return spec.payloadKg * (_prefs.weightAllowance / 100);
    }

    function setVendorContainer(vendorId, key) {
        if (!CONTAINER_SPECS[key]) return;
        if (!_prefs.containerByVendor) _prefs.containerByVendor = {};
        _prefs.containerByVendor[vendorId] = key;
        persistContainerPrefs();
        refreshVendorBand(vendorId);
    }

    // How many containers this vendor's order is being planned against. Whole containers only.
    function vendorContainerQty(vendorId) {
        var n = _prefs.containerQtyByVendor ? parseInt(_prefs.containerQtyByVendor[vendorId]) : NaN;
        return (isFinite(n) && n >= 1) ? n : 1;
    }

    function setVendorContainerQty(vendorId, value) {
        var n = Math.round(parseFloat(value));
        if (!isFinite(n) || n < 1) n = 1;
        if (!_prefs.containerQtyByVendor) _prefs.containerQtyByVendor = {};
        _prefs.containerQtyByVendor[vendorId] = n;
        persistContainerPrefs();
        var input = _q('.cap-qty[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (input && String(n) !== input.value) input.value = String(n);
        refreshVendorBand(vendorId);
    }

    function fmtM3(v) {
        if (!isFinite(v)) return '0';
        if (v === 0) return '0';
        if (v < 0.01) return v.toFixed(4);
        if (v < 1) return v.toFixed(3);
        return v.toFixed(2);
    }

    // Always kilograms — the column header says kg, so never silently switch to tonnes here.
    function fmtKg(v) {
        if (!isFinite(v) || v === 0) return '0';
        if (v < 1) return v.toFixed(3);
        return v.toLocaleString(LOCALE_CODE, { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
    }

    // used / capacity as one string, with a single shared unit so the two halves are
    // directly comparable (never "752.7 / 26.58 t").
    function fmtKgPair(used, cap) {
        if (cap >= 1000) return (used / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' / ' + (cap / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' t';
        return fmtKg(used) + ' / ' + fmtKg(cap) + ' kg';
    }

    function fmtM3Pair(used, cap) {
        return fmtM3(used) + ' / ' + fmtM3(cap) + ' m³';
    }

    // ============================================
    // Per-vendor rollup — PO value, cube, weight, capacity
    // Reads vendorIndex (built once per load) so a keystroke costs O(rows), not O(vendors x rows).
    // ============================================
    function calcVendorLoad(vendorId) {
        var items = vendorIndex[vendorId] || [];
        var out = {
            vendorId: vendorId,
            partCount: items.length,
            selectedCount: 0,
            lines: 0,
            linesNoDims: 0,
            linesNoWeight: 0,
            poValue: 0,
            volM3: 0,
            weightKg: 0
        };

        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            var item = items[i];
            var key = vendorId + '_' + item.part_id;
            if (!selectionState[key]) continue;
            out.selectedCount++;

            var qty = qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined
                ? qtyOverrides[key]
                : (parseFloat(item.qty_suggested) || 0);
            out.poValue += qty * safeCost(item.last_cost);
            if (qty <= 0) continue;
            out.lines++;

            // Dimensions are per unit of the part's stocking UOM; convert the order qty
            // into that UOM before applying them. _qtyToBase is 1 when they already match.
            var baseQty = qty * (item._qtyToBase || 1);

            if (item._unitVolM3 == null) out.linesNoDims++;
            else out.volM3 += baseQty * item._unitVolM3;

            if (item._unitKg == null) out.linesNoWeight++;
            else out.weightKg += baseQty * item._unitKg;
        }

        var spec = vendorContainerSpec(vendorId);
        out.spec = spec;
        out.containerKey = vendorContainerKey(vendorId);

        // Capacity of ONE container, then scaled by how many the user is planning to fill.
        out.unitCapVol = containerUsableVolume(spec);
        out.unitCapWt = containerUsablePayload(spec);
        out.containerQty = vendorContainerQty(vendorId);
        out.capVol = out.unitCapVol * out.containerQty;
        out.capWt = out.unitCapWt * out.containerQty;

        out.volPct = out.capVol > 0 ? (out.volM3 / out.capVol) * 100 : 0;
        out.weightPct = out.capWt > 0 ? (out.weightKg / out.capWt) * 100 : 0;

        // Fractional count of single containers this load actually fills, e.g. 2.3 — the
        // binding constraint decides, same as the headline percentage.
        var byVol = out.unitCapVol > 0 ? out.volM3 / out.unitCapVol : 0;
        var byWt  = out.unitCapWt  > 0 ? out.weightKg / out.unitCapWt : 0;
        out.containersNeeded = Math.max(byVol, byWt);

        if (out.volM3 <= 0 && out.weightKg <= 0) {
            out.binding = 'none';
            out.headlinePct = 0;
        } else if (out.volPct >= out.weightPct) {
            out.binding = 'volume';
            out.headlinePct = out.volPct;
        } else {
            out.binding = 'weight';
            out.headlinePct = out.weightPct;
        }
        return out;
    }

    function buildVendorIndex() {
        vendorIndex = {};

            var vid = item.vendor_id;
            if (vid === undefined || vid === null) return;
            if (!vendorIndex[vid]) vendorIndex[vid] = [];
            vendorIndex[vid].push(item);
            rowByKey[vid + '_' + item.part_id] = item;
        });
    }

    const WARN_SVG =
        '<svg class="warn-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
        'stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +

    // ============================================
    // Numeric text inputs
    // ============================================
    // type=number is not used anywhere in the grid. At a 20px row height the
    // native spinner renders poorly, and in a narrow cell its arrows overlay the
    // digits - so the control actively hides the value it exists to edit. These
    // fields are plain text that police their own content instead.
    //
    // Everything downstream already reads the value with parseFloat, so nothing
    // else changes. Arrow-key stepping is re-implemented by hand, because that is
    // the one thing genuinely lost with the spinner buttons.
    function sanitizeNumericText(raw, allowDecimals) {
        var t = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
        if (!allowDecimals) return t.replace(/\./g, '');
        var dot = t.indexOf('.');
        if (dot === -1) return t;
        // Keep the FIRST decimal point and drop any later ones, so "1.2.3" becomes
        // "1.23" rather than being rejected outright mid-typing.
        return t.slice(0, dot + 1) + t.slice(dot + 1).replace(/\./g, '');
    }

    // opts: { decimals, min, step, onInput }
    function attachNumericInput(input, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        var dec  = !!opts.decimals;
        var min  = (opts.min == null) ? 0 : opts.min;
        var step = opts.step || 1;

        input.type = 'text';
        input.setAttribute('inputmode', dec ? 'decimal' : 'numeric');
        input.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
        input.spellcheck = false;

        input.addEventListener('input', function() {
            var pos   = input.selectionStart;
            var clean = sanitizeNumericText(input.value, dec);
            if (clean !== input.value) {
                // Rewriting value resets the caret to the end, which makes editing
                // the middle of a number impossible. Put it back, shifted by however
                // many characters were rejected.
                var delta = input.value.length - clean.length;
                input.value = clean;
                var at = Math.max(0, (pos || 0) - delta);
                try { input.setSelectionRange(at, at); } catch (e) { /* not selectable */ }
            }
            if (opts.onInput) opts.onInput();
        });

        input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key !== 'ArrowUp' && e.key !== 'ArrowDown') return;
            e.preventDefault();
            var by  = step * (e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
            var cur = parseFloat(input.value);
            if (isNaN(cur)) cur = min;
            var next = cur + (e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? by : -by);
            if (next < min) next = min;
            // Float noise: 0.1 + 0.2 must not become 0.30000000000000004 in a field.
            input.value = String(dec ? Math.round(next * 1e6) / 1e6 : Math.round(next));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',  { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
    }

    // ============================================
    // Cell builders
    // ============================================
    function cellStatus(td, row) {
        var state = row._state;
        var pct = row._capacitypct;

        function grey(label) {
            td.style.setProperty('background', '#e2e8f0', 'important');
            td.style.setProperty('color', '#64748b', 'important');
            td.style.setProperty('font-weight', 'normal', 'important');
            td.innerHTML = '<strong style="font-size:11px;">' + label + '</strong>';
        }

        if (state === 'norop') { grey('No ROP/OUL'); return; }

        var bgColor, lightColor;
        if (state === 'fb10')      { bgColor = '#1976D2'; lightColor = '#90CAF9'; }
        else if (state === 'fb20') { bgColor = '#2E7D32'; lightColor = '#A5D6A7'; }
        else if (state === 'fb30') { bgColor = '#F57C00'; lightColor = '#FFCC80'; }
        else if (state === 'fb40') { bgColor = '#C62828'; lightColor = '#EF9A9A'; }
        else { grey('—'); return; }   // no status computed for this row

        var text;
        if (state === 'fb10' || pct > 100) text = 'Overstocked';
        else if (pct === null || pct === undefined || isNaN(pct)) { grey('—'); return; }
        else text = pct + '%';

        var gradient;
        if (state === 'fb10' || pct > 100) {
            gradient = bgColor;
        } else if (pct < 0) {
            var fillFromRight = Math.min(100, Math.abs(pct));
            gradient = 'linear-gradient(to left, ' + bgColor + ' ' + fillFromRight + '%, ' + lightColor + ' ' + fillFromRight + '%)';
        } else {
            var fillPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
            gradient = 'linear-gradient(to right, ' + bgColor + ' ' + fillPercent + '%, ' + lightColor + ' ' + fillPercent + '%)';
        }
        td.style.setProperty('background', gradient, 'important');
        td.style.setProperty('color', '#FFFFFF', 'important');
        td.style.setProperty('text-shadow', '1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 'important');
        td.innerHTML = '<strong style="font-size:11px;">' + text + '</strong>';
    }
