    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Transferable stock at other location groups
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // A location group is a candidate SOURCE for a transfer when it holds
    // available-to-pick stock and is not itself short of the part. Which groups
    // count as "other" depends on what the user is looking at:
    //
    //   one LG selected  — every OTHER location group is a candidate.
    //   all LGs          — any location group the Auto PO does NOT want to buy
    //                      for. A group that is itself short cannot be a donor.
    //
    // Sets _availElsewhere (total transferable) and _donorLgs (the breakdown).
    function computeAvailElsewhere(item, selectedLgId) {
        item._availElsewhere = 0;
        item._donorLgs = [];
        if (!item._lgStock) return;

        var needs = item._perLgQty || {};
        Object.keys(item._lgStock).forEach(function(lgIdStr) {
            var s = item._lgStock[lgIdStr];
            if (!s.visible) return;                       // outside the user's access
            if (s.atp <= 0) return;                       // nothing to give
            if (selectedLgId > 0) {
                if (s.lgId === selectedLgId) return;       // that is "here", not elsewhere
            } else if ((parseFloat(needs[s.lgId]) || 0) > 0) {
                return;                                    // short itself — not a donor
            }
            item._availElsewhere += s.atp;
            item._donorLgs.push(s);
        });
        item._donorLgs.sort(function(a, b) { return b.atp - a.atp; });
    }

    // How much of this part the Auto PO wants to buy, for judging whether the
    // stock sitting elsewhere would actually cover it.
    function orderQtyOf(row) {
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        return qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined
            ? qtyOverrides[key]
            : (parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0);
    }

    function cellAvailElsewhere(td, row) {
        var donors = row._donorLgs || [];
        var total  = row._availElsewhere || 0;
        if (!donors.length || total <= 0) {
            td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-split-none">-</span>';
            return;
        }
        var want = orderQtyOf(row);
        // Green only when the stock elsewhere would actually cover the order —
        // otherwise this reads as "don't buy" when a purchase is still needed.
        var covers = want > 0 && total >= want;
        var wrap = document.createElement('span');
        wrap.className = 'lg-split elsewhere' + (covers ? ' covers' : '');
        wrap.setAttribute('data-key', row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id);

        var MAX = 2;
        donors.slice(0, MAX).forEach(function(s) {
            var chip = document.createElement('span');
            chip.className = 'lg-chip lg-chip-src';
            chip.textContent = lgShortName(s.lgName) + ' ' + formatNumber(s.atp);
            chip.title = s.lgName + ' could supply ' + formatNumber(s.atp) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
                '\nOn hand ' + formatNumber(s.onHand) +
                ' − committed ' + formatNumber(s.committed) +
                ' − not available ' + formatNumber(s.notAvailable) +
                ' = ' + formatNumber(s.atp) + ' available to pick';
            wrap.appendChild(chip);
        });
        if (donors.length > MAX) {
            var more = document.createElement('span');
            more.className = 'lg-chip lg-chip-more';
            more.textContent = '+' + (donors.length - MAX);
            more.title = donors.slice(MAX).map(function(s) {
                return s.lgName + ': ' + formatNumber(s.atp);
            }).join('\n');
            wrap.appendChild(more);
        }
        wrap.title = formatNumber(total) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
            ' available to pick across ' + donors.length + ' other location group(s)' +
            (want > 0
                ? (covers
                    ? ' — enough to cover the ' + formatNumber(want) + ' on order, so a transfer could replace this purchase.'
                    : ' — short of the ' + formatNumber(want) + ' on order, so a transfer would only reduce it.')
                : '.') +
            '\nAvailable to pick = on hand − committed − not available. Click for the breakdown.';
        wrap.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            toggleLgDetail(row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id);
        });
        td.appendChild(wrap);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Per-location-group split
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // True only when a per-LG breakdown is meaningful: the system is on per-LG
    // reorder points AND the user is looking at all of them at once.
    function lgSplitActive() {
        var sel = document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup');
        return !!(lgReorderEnabled && sel && sel.value === '-1' && userLocationGroups.length > 1);
    }

    // "Could we transfer instead" is worth asking whenever there is more than one
    // location group — including with a single one selected, where every OTHER
    // group is a potential source. It does not depend on per-LG reorder points.
    function lgElsewhereActive() {
        return userLocationGroups.length > 1;
    }

    // Every location group worth a sub-row for this part.
    //
    // Deliberately NOT limited to groups the Auto PO wants to buy for. A part with
    // no per-location-group reorder point produces no per-LG requirement at all —
    // the engine has nothing to divide — and the same is true company-wide when
    // per-LG reordering is off entirely. Building the list from need alone left
    // those parts with no breakdown whatsoever, so there was no way to see how the
    // stock is actually distributed. Any location group holding the part earns a
    // row; where a requirement exists it is shown alongside.
    //
    // Roles: 'need' first (largest first), then 'source' (transferable stock),
    // then 'stock' (holds some, none of it transferable).
    function lgDetailRowsFor(row) {
        var byLg = {};
        function slot(lgId, lgName) {
            if (!byLg[lgId]) {
                byLg[lgId] = { lgId: lgId, lgName: lgName, need: 0, detail: null,
                               stock: (row._lgStock || {})[lgId] || null };
            }
            return byLg[lgId];
        }

        lgSplitRows(row).forEach(function(s) {
            var e = slot(s.lgId, s.lgName);
            e.need = s.suggested;
            e.detail = s.detail;
        });
        (row._donorLgs || []).forEach(function(s) { slot(s.lgId, s.lgName).stock = s; });
        // Every location group the part physically sits in, whether or not it is
        // short and whether or not any of it can be moved.
        Object.keys(row._lgStock || {}).forEach(function(k) {
            var st = row._lgStock[k];
            if (!st.visible) return;                                  // outside the user's access
            if (st.onHand === 0 && st.committed === 0) return;         // no presence at all
            slot(st.lgId, st.lgName).stock = st;
        });

        function rank(e) {
            if (e.need > 0) return 0;
            if (e.stock && e.stock.atp > 0) return 1;
            return 2;
        }
        var out = Object.keys(byLg).map(function(k) { return byLg[k]; });
        out.sort(function(a, b) {
            var ra = rank(a), rb = rank(b);
            if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb;
            if (ra === 0) return b.need - a.need;
            return (b.stock ? b.stock.atp || b.stock.onHand : 0) -
                   (a.stock ? a.stock.atp || a.stock.onHand : 0);
        });
        return out;
    }

    // [{lgId, lgName, suggested, ...}] for a row, largest need first, or [].
    function lgSplitRows(row) {
        if (!row._perLgQty) return [];
        var out = [];
        Object.keys(row._perLgQty).forEach(function(k) {
            var qty = parseFloat(row._perLgQty[k]) || 0;
            if (qty <= 0) return;
            var d = (row._perLgDetail && row._perLgDetail[k]) || null;
            var lg = userLocationGroups.find(function(g) { return String(g.id) === String(k); });
            out.push({
                lgId: parseInt(k),
                lgName: (d && d.lgName) || (lg && lg.name) || ('LG ' + k),
                suggested: qty,
                detail: d
            });
        });
        out.sort(function(a, b) { return b.suggested - a.suggested; });
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Location breakdown tooltip
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Where inside a location group the stock actually sits. Deliberately a
    // TOOLTIP rather than another tier of sub-rows: below location-group level
    // the only honest figures are the ones on the tags (on hand, committed, and
    // whether the location counts as available) — reorder points, allocation and
    // on-order are all held per location group and have no per-location meaning.
    // A sub-row tier would therefore be four columns populated and the rest
    // blank, for every location, on every part.
    //
    // Uses the report's own #customTooltip, not a native title attribute, so it
    // can be a laid-out table and match the rest of the UI.
    function locTooltipHtml(row, lgId, lgName) {
        var locs = (row._lgLoc || {})[lgId];
        if (!locs || !locs.length) return null;
        var uom = row.part_uom_code || '';

        var body = locs.map(function(l) {
            var flag = l.notAvailable
                ? '<span class="tt-flag tt-flag-na">not available</span>'
                : (l.shipping ? '<span class="tt-flag tt-flag-ship">shipping</span>' : '');
            return '<tr>' +
                '<td class="tt-name">' + escHtml(l.name) + flag + '</td>' +
                '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(l.onHand) + '</td>' +
                '<td class="tt-num">' + (l.committed ? formatNumber(l.committed) : '·') + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
        }).join('');

        var total = locs.reduce(function(s, l) { return s + l.onHand; }, 0);
        var naCount = locs.filter(function(l) { return l.notAvailable; }).length;

        return '<div class="tt-loc">' +
            '<div class="tt-head">' + escHtml(lgName) + ' — where the stock is</div>' +
            '<table class="tt-tbl">' +
                '<thead><tr><th>Location</th><th class="tt-num">On Hand</th>' +
                '<th class="tt-num">Cmtd</th></tr></thead>' +
                '<tbody>' + body + '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot><tr><td class="tt-name">' + locs.length + ' location' +
                    (locs.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' holding stock</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(total) + '</td><td class="tt-num"></td></tr></tfoot>' +
            '</table>' +
            (naCount
                ? '<div class="tt-note">' + naCount + ' of these ' +
                  (naCount === 1 ? 'is' : 'are') + ' not counted as available, so ' +
                  (naCount === 1 ? 'it is' : 'they are') + ' excluded from what could be picked or transferred.</div>'
                : '') +
            (uom ? '<div class="tt-note">Quantities in ' + escHtml(uom) + '.</div>' : '') +
        '</div>';
    }

    // The same question one level up: where is this part, across location groups
    // AND the locations inside them. Hung off the On Hand cell of the PART row,
    // because On Hand is the figure that provokes the question — and because it is
    // the one entry point that does not depend on per-LG reorder points existing,
    // on the LG Split column being shown, or on the row being expanded.
    //
    // Locations are nested under their group rather than listed flat: a bare list
    // of bins cannot be reconciled against the location-group figures beside it.
    var LOC_LINES_MAX = 14;

    function lgStockTooltipHtml(row) {
        var byLg = row._lgStock || {};
        var all = Object.keys(byLg).map(function(k) { return byLg[k]; })
            .filter(function(s) { return s.onHand !== 0 || s.committed !== 0; });
        var lgs = all.filter(function(s) { return s.visible; })
            .sort(function(a, b) { return b.onHand - a.onHand; });
        if (!lgs.length) return null;
        // Stock in location groups this user has no access to is NOT listed, but it
        // is counted in the row's On Hand — so without saying so the breakdown would
        // simply fail to add up to the number it is hanging off.
        var hidden = all.filter(function(s) { return !s.visible; });
        var hiddenQty = hidden.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + s.onHand; }, 0);

        var uom = row.part_uom_code || '';
        var locBudget = LOC_LINES_MAX;
        var locHidden = 0;

        var body = lgs.map(function(s) {
            var out = '<tr class="tt-lg">' +
                '<td class="tt-name">' + escHtml(s.lgName) + '</td>' +
                '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(s.onHand) + '</td>' +
                '<td class="tt-num">' + (s.committed ? formatNumber(s.committed) : '·') + '</td>' +
                '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(s.atp) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
            var locs = (row._lgLoc || {})[s.lgId] || [];
            locs.forEach(function(l) {
                if (locBudget <= 0) { locHidden++; return; }
                locBudget--;
                var flag = l.notAvailable
                    ? '<span class="tt-flag tt-flag-na">n/a</span>'
                    : (l.shipping ? '<span class="tt-flag tt-flag-ship">ship</span>' : '');
                out += '<tr class="tt-sub">' +
                    '<td class="tt-name">↳ ' + escHtml(l.name) + flag + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(l.onHand) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + (l.committed ? formatNumber(l.committed) : '·') + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num"></td></tr>';
            });
            return out;
        }).join('');

        var tOnHand = lgs.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + s.onHand; }, 0);
        var tCmtd   = lgs.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + s.committed; }, 0);
        var tAtp    = lgs.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + s.atp; }, 0);

        return '<div class="tt-loc">' +
            '<div class="tt-head">Where this part is held</div>' +
            '<table class="tt-tbl">' +
                '<thead><tr><th>Location group</th><th class="tt-num">On Hand</th>' +
                '<th class="tt-num">Cmtd</th><th class="tt-num">Avail</th></tr></thead>' +
                '<tbody>' + body + '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot><tr><td class="tt-name">' + lgs.length + ' location group' +
                    (lgs.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(tOnHand) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(tCmtd) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="tt-num">' + formatNumber(tAtp) + '</td></tr></tfoot>' +
            '</table>' +
            (locHidden ? '<div class="tt-note">' + locHidden + ' further location' +
                         (locHidden === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' not shown.</div>' : '') +
            (hiddenQty ? '<div class="tt-note">A further ' + formatNumber(hiddenQty) +
                         ' sits in ' + hidden.length + ' location group' +
                         (hidden.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' you do not have access to, ' +
                         'which is why this does not add up to On Hand.</div>' : '') +
            '<div class="tt-note">Avail is available to pick — on hand minus committed ' +
            'minus stock in locations not counted as available' +
            (uom ? '. Quantities in ' + escHtml(uom) : '') + '.</div>' +
        '</div>';
    }

    // On Hand carries the breakdown above. The number itself is still just the
    // number, so the column keeps sorting and exporting exactly as before.
    function cellOnHand(td, row) {
        td.textContent = formatNumber(row.qty_on_hand);
        var html = lgStockTooltipHtml(row);
        if (!html) return;
        td.classList.add('has-loc-tip');
        td.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(e) { showTooltip(e, html); });
        td.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
    }

    // Chip label. Truncate rather than abbreviate: initials turn "QLD Stock"
    // into "QS", which nobody recognises. The full name is in the title, and
    // the sub-rows spell it out in full.
    function lgShortName(name) {
        var n = String(name || '').trim();
        if (!n) return '?';
        return n.length > 12 ? n.slice(0, 11) + '…' : n;
    }

    function cellLgSplit(td, row) {
        var split = lgSplitRows(row);
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        if (!split.length) {
            // No per-LG requirement — which is the normal case for a part with no
            // per-location-group reorder point, since the engine has nothing to
            // divide. There is still a stock distribution worth seeing, so offer it
            // rather than showing a dead dash and hiding the breakdown entirely.
            var lgCount = lgDetailRowsFor(row).length;
            if (!lgCount) { td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-split-none">-</span>'; return; }
            var link = document.createElement('span');
            link.className = 'lg-split lg-split-stockonly';
            link.textContent = lgCount + ' LG' + (lgCount === 1 ? '' : 's');
            link.title = 'No per-location-group requirement for this part — it has no ' +
                         'per-LG reorder point, so the Auto PO engine has nothing to split.\n' +
                         'It is held in ' + lgCount + ' location group' + (lgCount === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                         '; click to see the distribution.';
            link.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleLgDetail(key); });
            td.appendChild(link);
            return;
        }
        var total = split.reduce(function(s, x) { return s + x.suggested; }, 0);

        var wrap = document.createElement('span');
        wrap.className = 'lg-split';
        wrap.setAttribute('data-key', key);
        // Cap the chips so a part needed across many location groups does not
        // stretch its row to the height of the list. The overflow chip carries
        // the rest, and expanding always shows every one of them.
        var MAX_CHIPS = 3;
        var shown = split.slice(0, MAX_CHIPS);
        var rest  = split.slice(MAX_CHIPS);
        shown.forEach(function(s) {
            var chip = document.createElement('span');
            chip.className = 'lg-chip';
            chip.textContent = lgShortName(s.lgName) + ' ' + formatNumber(s.suggested);
            chip.title = s.lgName + ': ' + formatNumber(s.suggested) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
                (s.detail ? '\nOn hand ' + formatNumber(s.detail.onHand) +
                            ' · Allocated ' + formatNumber(s.detail.allocated) +
                            ' · On order ' + formatNumber(s.detail.onOrder) +
                            '\nROP ' + formatNumber(s.detail.rop) + ' · Target ' + formatNumber(s.detail.target)
                          : '');
            wrap.appendChild(chip);
        });
        if (rest.length) {
            var more = document.createElement('span');
            more.className = 'lg-chip lg-chip-more';
            more.textContent = '+' + rest.length;
            more.title = rest.map(function(s) {
                return s.lgName + ': ' + formatNumber(s.suggested);
            }).join('\n');
            wrap.appendChild(more);
        }
        // The chips are a summary; the sub-rows carry the numbers that justify them.
        wrap.title = split.length + ' location group(s) need this part — ' +
                     formatNumber(total) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
                     ' in total. Click for the full per-LG figures.';
        wrap.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            toggleLgDetail(key);
        });
        td.appendChild(wrap);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Column sorting
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rows sort WITHIN each vendor, never across them: the table is grouped by
    // vendor with a band row and a Create PO button per group, so a global sort
    // would interleave vendors and break the grouping the whole report is built
    // on. Clicking a header cycles ascending -> descending -> back to the
    // natural (load) order, so there is always a way back to what the engine
    // returned. The chosen sort is persisted per user.
    let _sort = { key: null, dir: 1 };

    // Comparable value for a column. Numbers sort numerically, everything else
    // case-insensitively as text; blanks are reported as null and always sink to
    // the bottom regardless of direction, so a half-populated column does not
    // bury the rows that actually have values.
    function sortValue(col, row) {
        switch (col.key) {
            case 'part_num':      return (row._fbPartNum || row.part_num || '').toLowerCase() || null;
            case '_capacitypct':  return row._state === 'norop' ? null : (row._capacitypct == null ? null : row._capacitypct);
            case 'qty_suggested': return orderQtyOf(row);
            case '_qtyMin':       return row._qtyMin == null ? null : row._qtyMin;
            case 'cubeLine':      return row._unitVolM3 == null ? null : _lineQty(row) * row._unitVolM3;
            case 'weightLine':    return row._unitKg == null ? null : _lineQty(row) * row._unitKg;
            case 'cubeUnit':      return row._unitVolM3;
            case 'weightUnit':    return row._unitKg;
            case 'dimW':          return row._dimW;
            case 'dimH':          return row._dimH;
            case 'dimL':          return row._dimL;
            case 'sizeUom':       return (row._sizeUomCode || '').toLowerCase() || null;
            case 'last_cost':     return safeCost(row.last_cost);
            case 'lead_time':     return parseInt(row.lead_time) || null;
            // Summary columns sort by the total they summarise, which is what the
            // reader is comparing when they click the header.
            case '_lgSplit':      return lgSplitRows(row).reduce(function(s, x) { return s + x.suggested; }, 0) || null;
            case '_availElsewhere': return row._availElsewhere || null;
            // Text, so a purchase can be worked through in warehouse order. Parts
            // with no default location sort to the bottom either way rather than
            // interleaving with the ones that have one.
            case '_defaultLocation': {
                var dl = defaultLocFor(row, getSelectedLgId());
                return (dl && dl.locName) ? dl.locName.toLowerCase() : null;
            }
            case '_qtySold':      return usageMap[row.part_id] ? usageMap[row.part_id].sold : null;
            case '_daysOfStock':  return daysOfStockFor(row);
        }
        var v = row[col.key];
        if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return null;
        if (col.qty || col.money) { var n = parseFloat(v); return isNaN(n) ? null : n; }
        var n2 = parseFloat(v);
        if (!isNaN(n2) && String(v).trim() !== '' && isFinite(n2)) return n2;
        return String(v).toLowerCase();
    }

    function sortParts(parts) {
        if (!_sort.key) return parts;
        var col = _columns.find(function(c) { return c.key === _sort.key; });
        if (!col) return parts;
        // Decorate with the original index so the sort is stable across browsers
        // and equal values keep their load order.
        return parts
            .map(function(r, i) { return { r: r, i: i, v: sortValue(col, r) }; })
            .sort(function(a, b) {
                if (a.v === null && b.v === null) return a.i - b.i;
                if (a.v === null) return 1;                 // blanks last, both ways
                if (b.v === null) return -1;
                if (a.v < b.v) return -_sort.dir;
                if (a.v > b.v) return _sort.dir;
                return a.i - b.i;
            })
            .map(function(x) { return x.r; });
    }

    function toggleSort(key) {
        if (_sort.key !== key)      _sort = { key: key, dir: 1 };
        else if (_sort.dir === 1)   _sort.dir = -1;
        else                        _sort = { key: null, dir: 1 };   // third click = natural order
        renderTable();
        try {
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('sortKey', _sort.key);
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('sortDir', _sort.dir);
            FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (e) { /* sorting must work even if settings do not */ }
    }

    // Which part rows have their per-LG detail expanded: { 'vendorId_partId': true }
    let lgDetailOpen = {};

    function toggleLgDetail(key) {
        lgDetailOpen[key] = !lgDetailOpen[key];
        renderTable();
    }

    // One sub-row per location group that either NEEDS this part or HOLDS stock
    // that could be transferred instead, in the SAME columns as the part row
    // above it — real <td> per visible column, never a colspan spanning the
    // numeric columns, so the figures stay under their own headings.
    function buildLgDetailRows(row, vis, idx) {
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        if (!lgDetailOpen[key]) return [];
        var split = lgDetailRowsFor(row);
        if (!split.length) return [];

        return split.map(function(s) {
            var d  = s.detail;
            var st = s.stock;
            var needs   = s.need > 0;
            var isDonor = !needs && !!(st && st.atp > 0);
            // Three roles, not two: a group can hold stock that is entirely
            // committed or not-available, which is neither a requirement nor a
            // transfer source but still worth showing.
            var role = needs ? 'need' : (isDonor ? 'source' : 'stock');
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'lg-detail-row' + (isDonor ? ' lg-donor-row' : '');
            tr.setAttribute('data-vendor-id', row.vendor_id);
            tr.setAttribute('data-lg-parent', key);
            tr.setAttribute('data-lg-role', role);

            var tdSel = document.createElement('td');   // aligns with the checkbox column
            tr.appendChild(tdSel);

            vis.forEach(function(col) {
                var td = document.createElement('td');
                td.setAttribute('data-column', col.key);
                // Class assignment MUST mirror buildRow() exactly, or the sub-row
                // sits under a different text alignment than the part row above it
                // and the digits stop lining up. Notably `qty: true` columns get NO
                // alignment class in buildRow — adding num-cell here shifted every
                // quantity right by a few pixels.
                if (col.grp) td.classList.add(col.grp);
                if (col.align === 'left') td.classList.add('td-left');
                else if (col.align === 'right') td.classList.add('num-cell');

                switch (col.key) {
                    case 'part_num': {
                        // Hovering the location group name reveals which locations
                        // inside it actually hold the stock.
                        var locHtml = locTooltipHtml(row, s.lgId, s.lgName);
                        td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-detail-ind">↳</span>' +
                                       '<span class="lg-detail-name' + (locHtml ? ' has-loc' : '') + '">' +
                                       escHtml(s.lgName) + '</span>';
                        if (locHtml) {
                            var nameEl = td.querySelector('.lg-detail-name');
                            nameEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(e) { showTooltip(e, locHtml); });
                            nameEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    case 'part_description':
                        // Say which role this location group is playing, and say when
                        // the per-LG figures are the approximation rather than the
                        // engine's answer.
                        if (needs) {
                            td.innerHTML = d
                                ? '<span class="lg-detail-note">location group requirement</span>'
                                : '<span class="lg-detail-note lg-detail-warn">quantity only — full figures unavailable</span>';
                        } else if (isDonor) {
                            td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-detail-note lg-detail-src">has stock — could transfer</span>';
                        } else {
                            // Holds some, none of it movable. Naming the reason is the
                            // point — otherwise it reads as a row with no purpose.
                            td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-detail-note">holds stock — ' +
                                (st && st.notAvailable > 0 && st.committed > 0 ? 'committed and not available'
                                 : st && st.committed > 0 ? 'fully committed'
                                 : st && st.notAvailable > 0 ? 'not counted as available'
                                 : 'none transferable') + '</span>';
                        }
                        break;
                    // Prefer the ENGINE's on hand on a row that has one: it is the
                    // figure the suggested quantity was derived from, and it sits
                    // beside that row's ROP / Target / Needed, so the row has to be
                    // internally consistent. The stock query covers every location
                    // group and so is the only source on a transfer-source row.
                    // (The two agree in practice — both come from tags — but where
                    // they cannot, the row should not mix sources.)
                    case 'qty_on_hand':
                        td.textContent = d ? formatNumber(d.onHand) : (st ? formatNumber(st.onHand) : '');
                        break;
                    case 'qty_committed':
                        td.textContent = st ? formatNumber(st.committed)
                                            : (d && d.committed != null ? formatNumber(d.committed) : '');
                        break;
                    case 'qty_not_available':
                        td.textContent = st ? formatNumber(st.notAvailable) : '';
                        break;
                    // Available-for-sale is the engine's figure and only exists for a
                    // location group it costed; left blank elsewhere rather than
                    // substituting the different available-to-pick measure.
                    case '_available':       td.textContent = d && d.available != null ? formatNumber(d.available) : ''; break;
                    case 'qty_on_order':     td.textContent = d ? formatNumber(d.onOrder)   : ''; break;
                    case 'qty_allocated':    td.textContent = d ? formatNumber(d.allocated) : ''; break;
                    case 'qty_on_drop_ship': td.textContent = d ? formatNumber(d.dropShip)  : ''; break;
                    case 'reorder_level':    td.textContent = d && d.rop    ? formatNumber(d.rop)    : '-'; break;
                    case 'target_level':     td.textContent = d && d.target ? formatNumber(d.target) : '-'; break;
                    case 'qty_needed':       td.textContent = d ? formatNumber(d.needed)    : ''; break;
                    case '_lgSplit':
                        td.innerHTML = s.need > 0
                            ? '<span class="lg-chip">' + escHtml(lgShortName(s.lgName)) + ' ' + formatNumber(s.need) + '</span>'
                            : '';
                        break;
                    case '_availElsewhere': {
                        // On a sub-row this is THIS location group's transferable
                        // stock, so the column keeps one meaning throughout.
                        if (!st || st.atp <= 0) { td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-split-none">-</span>'; break; }
                        var sums = 'On hand ' + formatNumber(st.onHand) +
                                   ' − committed ' + formatNumber(st.committed) +
                                   ' − not available ' + formatNumber(st.notAvailable) +
                                   ' = ' + formatNumber(st.atp) + ' available to pick';
                        // A location group that is itself short is NOT a transfer
                        // source, so its figure is muted rather than shown as an
                        // amber source chip. Without this the part row reads "none
                        // available elsewhere" while its sub-rows appear to show
                        // stock, which looks like a contradiction.
                        td.innerHTML = isDonor
                            ? '<span class="lg-chip lg-chip-src" title="' + escAttr(sums) + '">' +
                              formatNumber(st.atp) + '</span>'
                            : '<span class="lg-detail-nosrc" title="' + escAttr(sums +
                                '\n\nNot a transfer source: this location group needs ' +
                                formatNumber(s.need) + ' itself.') + '">' + formatNumber(st.atp) + '</span>';
                        break;
                    }
                    // Unlike MOQ and UOM below, the default location genuinely IS
                    // per location group, so each sub-row shows its own.
                    case '_defaultLocation':
                        td.textContent = defaultLocForLg(row, s.lgId) || '';
                        break;
                    // MOQ and UOM are attributes of the PART / vendor pair, not of a
                    // location group. Repeating them down the sub-rows implies they
                    // vary per location group, which they do not — they belong to the
                    // part row and are left blank here. (They fall through to the
                    // default branch below.)
                    case 'qty_suggested':
                        // Not an input: the PO quantity is committed per LG in the
                        // Create PO modal's per-LG mode, not edited here.
                        td.innerHTML = s.need > 0
                            ? '<span class="lg-detail-qty">' + formatNumber(s.need) + '</span>'
                            : '';
                        break;
                    default:                 td.textContent = '';
                }
                tr.appendChild(td);
            });
            return tr;
        });
    }

    function cellDashZero(td, row) {
        var num = parseFloat(row[this.key]);
        td.textContent = (!num || num === 0) ? '-' : formatNumber(row[this.key]);
    }

    function cellLead(td, row) {
        var num = parseInt(row.lead_time);
        td.textContent = (!num || num === 0) ? '-' : num + 'd';
    }

    // Minimum order quantity. Flagged when the line is being ordered BELOW it —
    // the vendor will not accept the order at that quantity, and Fishbowl only
    // raises the suggestion to the minimum automatically when the
    // UseMinQtyAutoGenPOs system property is on. Editing the qty down afterwards
    // bypasses that entirely, which is exactly when this needs to be visible.
    function cellMoq(td, row) {
        td.setAttribute('data-moq-key', row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id);
        var moq = row._qtyMin;
        if (!moq) { td.textContent = '-'; return; }

        var qty = orderQtyOf(row);
        var short = qty > 0 && qty < moq;
        if (!short) {
            td.textContent = formatNumber(moq);
            td.title = 'Minimum order quantity: ' + formatNumber(moq) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '');
            return;
        }
        td.innerHTML = '<span class="moq-short">' + WARN_SVG + formatNumber(moq) + '</span>';
        td.title = 'Order Qty ' + formatNumber(qty) + ' is BELOW the minimum order quantity of ' +
                   formatNumber(moq) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
                   '.\nRaise it by ' + formatNumber(moq - qty) + ' to meet the vendor minimum.';
    }

    function cellQty(td, row) {
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        var currentQty = qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined
            ? qtyOverrides[key]
            : (parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0);
        var integral = !!row._qtyIntegral;
        var uomCode = row.part_uom_code || 'units';

        var input = document.createElement('input');
        input.className = 'qty-input';
        input.setAttribute('data-key', key);
        input.value = integral ? String(Math.round(currentQty)) : String(currentQty);
        // An integral UOM cannot be subdivided, so the decimal point is rejected at
        // the keystroke rather than corrected after the fact.
        attachNumericInput(input, { decimals: !integral, min: 0, step: 1 });
        input.title = (integral
            ? 'Whole ' + uomCode + ' only — this unit of measure is integral'
            : 'Fractional quantities allowed for ' + uomCode) +
            '\nUp / Down arrows step by 1, Shift+Arrow by 10.';
        input.disabled = !selectionState[key];

        // input drives the live gauge; change is the authoritative commit and is where the
        // value is normalised, so typing "1.5" is not fought mid-keystroke.
        input.addEventListener('input', function() { updateQtyOverride(key, this.value, true); });
        input.addEventListener('change', function() {
            var v = updateQtyOverride(key, this.value, false);
            if (String(v) !== this.value) this.value = String(v);
        });
        input.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
        td.appendChild(input);
    }

    function _lineQty(row) {
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        var qty = qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined
            ? qtyOverrides[key]
            : (parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0);
        return qty * (row._qtyToBase || 1);
    }

    function cellCubeLine(td, row) {
        td.setAttribute('data-cube-key', row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id);
        if (row._unitVolM3 == null) {
            var note = (row._dimNote || 'No width/height/length on the part record')
                .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/</g, '<');
            td.innerHTML = '<span class="dim-warn" title="' + note + '">' + WARN_SVG + '</span>';
            return;
        }
        td.textContent = fmtM3(_lineQty(row) * row._unitVolM3);
        td.title = fmtM3(row._unitVolM3) + ' m³ per ' + (row.part_uom_code || 'unit') +
            (row._dimSource ? ' (from ' + row._dimSource + ')' : '');
    }

    function cellWeightLine(td, row) {
        td.setAttribute('data-weight-key', row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id);
        if (row._unitKg == null) {
            td.innerHTML = '<span class="dim-warn" title="No weight on the part record">' + WARN_SVG + '</span>';
            return;
        }
        td.textContent = fmtKg(_lineQty(row) * row._unitKg);
        td.title = fmtKg(row._unitKg) + ' kg per ' + (row.part_uom_code || 'unit') +
            (row._wtSource ? ' (from ' + row._wtSource + ')' : '');
    }

    function cellCubeUnit(td, row) {
        td.textContent = row._unitVolM3 == null ? '-' : fmtM3(row._unitVolM3);
    }

    function cellWeightUnit(td, row) {
        td.textContent = row._unitKg == null ? '-' : fmtKg(row._unitKg);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Default location / usage columns
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function cellDefaultLoc(td, row) {
        var d = defaultLocFor(row, getSelectedLgId());
        if (!d) { td.innerHTML = '<span class="lg-split-none">-</span>'; return; }

        if (!d.locName) {
            // Several groups define one and none of them is the user's own, so any
            // single answer would be a guess. Say how many and offer them on hover.
            var amb = document.createElement('span');
            amb.className = 'defloc-multi';
            amb.textContent = d.others.length + ' locations';
            amb.title = 'This part has a default location in ' + d.others.length +
                ' location groups and none of them is your default group, so there is no ' +
                'single answer to show:\n' +
                d.others.map(function(e) { return '  ' + e.lgName + ': ' + e.locName; }).join('\n') +
                '\n\nSelect a location group to see one.';
            td.appendChild(amb);
            return;
        }

        td.textContent = d.locName;
        var tip = d.lgName + ': ' + d.locName;
        if (d.others.length) {
            // The figure shown is one warehouse's. Flag that quietly rather than
            // letting it read as the only default the part has.
            var more = document.createElement('span');
            more.className = 'defloc-more';
            more.textContent = ' +' + d.others.length;
            td.appendChild(more);
            tip += '\nAlso set in:\n' +
                d.others.map(function(e) { return '  ' + e.lgName + ': ' + e.locName; }).join('\n');
        }
        td.title = tip;
    }

    function cellQtySold(td, row) {
        var u = usageMap[row.part_id];
        if (!u) { td.textContent = usageWindow.days ? '0' : '-'; return; }
        td.textContent = formatNumber(u.sold);
        td.title = formatNumber(u.sold) + ' ' + (row.part_uom_code || '') +
            ' shipped on sales orders in the ' + u.days + ' days to ' + usageWindow.end +
            (usageWindow.lgId > 0 ? ', in this location group only' : ', across all location groups') +
            (u.transferred ? '\nA further ' + formatNumber(u.transferred) +
                             ' left on transfers, which is not a sale and is not counted.' : '') +
            (u.consumed ? '\nA further ' + formatNumber(u.consumed) +
                          ' was consumed by manufacturing — that is in Days of Stock, not here.' : '');
    }

    // Available divided by the daily usage rate. Same shape as
    // Inv_Reorder_Watchlist's Days of Stock, including the lead-time-relative
    // colour bands, so the two reports agree.
    function daysOfStockFor(row) {
        var u = usageMap[row.part_id];
        if (!u || !u.rate) return null;
        var avail = parseFloat(row._available);
        if (isNaN(avail)) avail = 0;
        return Math.round(avail / u.rate);
    }

    function cellDaysOfStock(td, row) {
        var days = daysOfStockFor(row);
        if (days === null) {
            td.textContent = '-';
            td.title = usageWindow.days
                ? 'No usage recorded in the ' + usageWindow.days + '-day window, so there is no ' +
                  'rate to divide by. Stock on hand would last indefinitely at that rate.'
                : 'Set a usage period to compute this.';
            return;
        }
        var lt = parseInt(row.lead_time) || 0;
        // Amber inside two lead times, red inside one: a reorder placed now takes a
        // lead time to arrive, so anything under that is already late.
        var tone = lt > 0 ? (days >= lt * 2 ? '' : (days >= lt ? 'amber' : 'red'))
                          : (days >= 60 ? '' : (days >= 30 ? 'amber' : 'red'));
        var u = usageMap[row.part_id];
        td.innerHTML = tone
            ? '<strong class="dos-' + tone + '">' + days + 'd</strong>'
            : days + 'd';
        td.title = formatNumber(row._available || 0) + ' available / ' +
            u.rate.toFixed(2) + ' per day = ' + days + ' days of cover' +
            '\nRate: ' + formatNumber(u.total) + ' used in ' + u.days + ' days (' +
            formatNumber(u.sold) + ' sold' +
            (u.consumed ? ' + ' + formatNumber(u.consumed) + ' consumed by manufacturing' : '') + ')' +
            (lt > 0 ? '\nVendor lead time ' + lt + ' days — amber under ' + (lt * 2) +
                      'd, red under ' + lt + 'd.'
                    : '\nNo vendor lead time set — amber under 60d, red under 30d.');
    }

    function cellDimW(td, row) { td.textContent = row._dimW == null ? '-' : formatNumber(row._dimW); }
    function cellDimH(td, row) { td.textContent = row._dimH == null ? '-' : formatNumber(row._dimH); }
    function cellDimL(td, row) { td.textContent = row._dimL == null ? '-' : formatNumber(row._dimL); }
    function cellSizeUom(td, row) { td.textContent = row._sizeUomCode || '-'; }

    // ============================================
    // Render
    // ============================================
    // The LG Split column is hidden - not just empty - whenever a per-LG breakdown
    // cannot exist, so a single-LG or company-wide-ROP run does not carry a column
    // of dashes. Everything that needs the on-screen column set asks for it here,
    // so the resize code and the renderer can never disagree about it.
    function visibleColumns() {
        var splitOn = lgSplitActive();
        var elseOn  = lgElsewhereActive();
        return _columns.filter(function(c) {
            if (c.key === '_lgSplit')        return c.vis && splitOn;
            if (c.key === '_availElsewhere') return c.vis && elseOn;
            return c.vis;
        });
    }

    function renderTable() {
        var vis = visibleColumns();
        renderHead(vis);
        renderBody(vis);
        applyColWidths(vis);
    }

    // ============================================
    // Column resizing
    // ============================================
    // The table runs on the browser's AUTOMATIC layout until the moment the user
    // drags a column edge. On that first drag the current rendered widths are
    // snapshotted into a <colgroup> and the table switches to table-layout: fixed.
    //
    // That ordering matters. Going fixed up front would mean inventing a width for
    // every column and the table would not look the way it does now; snapshotting
    // what is already on screen makes the switch invisible, and from then on the
    // widths are exact and a drag moves only the column being dragged. Widths are
    // per user and survive a reload; "Reset widths" in the Columns panel drops the
    // colgroup and hands the table back to automatic layout.
    const MIN_COL_W = 40;
    let _colWidths = {};        // { __sel: px, <columnKey>: px }  empty = automatic

    function defaultColWidth(col) {
        var w = parseInt(col.width);
        return isFinite(w) && w > 0 ? w : 110;
    }

    function colWidthsActive() { return Object.keys(_colWidths).length > 0; }

    function applyColWidths(vis) {
        var table = document.getElementById('dataTable');
        if (!table) return;
        var old = table.querySelector('colgroup');
        if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);

        if (!colWidthsActive()) {
            table.style.tableLayout = '';
            table.style.width = '';
            return;
        }

        var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
        var total = 0;
        function addCol(px) {
            var c = document.createElement('col');
            c.style.width = px + 'px';
            cg.appendChild(c);
            total += px;
        }
        addCol(_colWidths.__sel || 34);
        vis.forEach(function(col) {
            addCol(_colWidths[col.key] || defaultColWidth(col));
        });
        table.insertBefore(cg, table.firstChild);
        table.style.tableLayout = 'fixed';
        // An explicit total, not 100%: under fixed layout a table wider than the sum
        // of its columns redistributes the slack, so every drag would nudge the
        // columns either side of the one being dragged.
        table.style.width = total + 'px';
    }

    // Freeze the table exactly as it looks right now.
    function snapshotColWidths(vis) {
        var ths = document.querySelectorAll('#tHead th');
        if (!ths.length) return;
        _colWidths = { __sel: Math.round(ths[0].offsetWidth) || 34 };
        vis.forEach(function(col, i) {
            var th = ths[i + 1];
            _colWidths[col.key] = Math.round(th ? th.offsetWidth : defaultColWidth(col));
        });
    }

    function persistColWidths() {
        try {
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('colWidths', _colWidths);
            FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (e) { /* resizing must work even if settings do not */ }
    }

    function resetColWidths() {
        _colWidths = {};
        persistColWidths();
        renderTable();
        showStatus('Column widths reset to automatic.', 'info');
    }

    function beginColResize(e, col, th) {
        // Claim the gesture before the header can read it as a sort click or the
        // start of a column-reorder drag.
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        var vis = visibleColumns();
        if (!colWidthsActive()) snapshotColWidths(vis);

        var startX = e.clientX;
        var startW = _colWidths[col.key] || Math.round(th.offsetWidth) || defaultColWidth(col);
        var wasDraggable = th.draggable;
        th.draggable = false;
        document.body.classList.add('col-resizing');

        function onMove(ev) {
            var w = Math.round(startW + (ev.clientX - startX));
            _colWidths[col.key] = Math.max(MIN_COL_W, w);
            applyColWidths(vis);
        }
        function onUp() {
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
            document.body.classList.remove('col-resizing');
            th.draggable = wasDraggable;
            // mouseup on a header is about to fire a click, which would sort the
            // column the user was only resizing. Swallow exactly one.
            var swallow = function(ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); };
            document.addEventListener('click', swallow, true);
            setTimeout(function() { document.removeEventListener('click', swallow, true); }, 0);
            persistColWidths();
        }
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }

    function addColResizer(th, col) {
        var grip = document.createElement('span');
        grip.className = 'col-resizer';
        grip.draggable = false;
        grip.title = 'Drag to resize this column. Double-click to reset every column ' +
                     'to automatic width.';
        grip.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { beginColResize(e, col, th); });
        // Belt and braces around the header's own handlers.
        grip.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); });
        grip.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); });
        grip.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
            resetColWidths();
        });
        th.appendChild(grip);
    }

    function renderHead(vis) {
        var thead = document.getElementById('tHead');
        thead.innerHTML = '';
        var tr = document.createElement('tr');

        var thSel = document.createElement('th');
        thSel.style.width = '34px';
        thSel.innerHTML = '<input type="checkbox" id="selectAllGlobal" class="row-checkbox" ' +
            'onclick="toggleSelectAll(this.checked)" title="Select / deselect all">';
        tr.appendChild(thSel);

        vis.forEach(function(col) {
            var th = document.createElement('th');
            th.textContent = col.label;
            th.setAttribute('data-column', col.key);
            if (col.tip) th.title = col.tip;
            if (col.align === 'left') th.className = 'th-left';
            else if (col.align === 'right') th.className = 'num-cell';
            if (col.width) th.style.width = col.width;

            // Click to sort. A drag fires dragstart, not click, so this coexists
            // with the column reordering already on these headers.
            th.classList.add('th-sortable');
            if (_sort.key === col.key) {
                th.classList.add('th-sorted');
                var caret = document.createElement('span');
                caret.className = 'th-caret';
                caret.textContent = _sort.dir === 1 ? '▲' : '▼';
                th.appendChild(caret);
            }
            th.title = (col.tip ? col.tip + '\n\n' : '') +
                (_sort.key === col.key
                    ? (_sort.dir === 1 ? 'Sorted ascending — click for descending.'
                                       : 'Sorted descending — click to clear.')
                    : 'Click to sort by this column (within each vendor).');
            th.addEventListener('click', function() { toggleSort(col.key); });

            th.draggable = true;
            th.addEventListener('dragstart', function() { _dragColKey = col.key; });
            th.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                th.classList.add('col-drag-over');
            });
            th.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { th.classList.remove('col-drag-over'); });
            th.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                th.classList.remove('col-drag-over');
                if (!_dragColKey || _dragColKey === col.key) return;
                var from = _columns.findIndex(function(c) { return c.key === _dragColKey; });
                var to   = _columns.findIndex(function(c) { return c.key === col.key; });
                _dragColKey = null;
                if (from < 0 || to < 0) return;
                var moved = _columns.splice(from, 1)[0];
                _columns.splice(to, 0, moved);
                renderTable();
                buildColPanel();
                persistCols();
            });
            addColResizer(th, col);
            tr.appendChild(th);
        });
        thead.appendChild(tr);
    }

    function renderBody(vis) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('tBody');
        tbody.innerHTML = '';

        var groups = buildGroupedData(getFilteredData());
        if (!groups.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + (vis.length + 1) +
                '" style="padding:2rem; color:#9ca3af; text-align:center;">' +
                'No results for the selected filters.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        var showCap = _containerOn();
        var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        groups.forEach(function(g) {
            frag.appendChild(buildVendorHeader(g, vis));
            if (showCap) frag.appendChild(buildVendorCapRow(g, vis));
            var collapsed = !!vendorCollapsed[g.vendorId];
            g.parts.forEach(function(row, i) {
                var tr = buildRow(row, vis, i);
                if (collapsed) tr.classList.add('vendor-collapsed');
                frag.appendChild(tr);
                // Per-LG detail sits directly under its part row and inherits the
                // vendor's collapsed state, so collapsing a vendor hides both.
                buildLgDetailRows(row, vis, i).forEach(function(sub) {
                    if (collapsed) sub.classList.add('vendor-collapsed');
                    frag.appendChild(sub);
                });
            });
        });
        tbody.appendChild(frag);

        // Paint the band figures once the rows exist.
        groups.forEach(function(g) { refreshVendorBand(g.vendorId); });
        updateOverallSummary();
    }

    function buildRow(row, vis, idx) {
        var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
        var tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'item-row' + (idx % 2 ? ' even-item' : '');
        tr.setAttribute('data-vendor-id', row.vendor_id);
        tr.setAttribute('data-key', key);
        if (!selectionState[key]) tr.classList.add('row-deselected');

        var tdSel = document.createElement('td');
        tdSel.innerHTML = '<input type="checkbox" class="row-checkbox" data-key="' + key + '"' +
            (selectionState[key] ? ' checked' : '') +
            ' onclick="toggleRowSelection(\'' + key + '\', this.checked)">';
        tr.appendChild(tdSel);

        vis.forEach(function(col) {
            var td = document.createElement('td');
            td.setAttribute('data-column', col.key);
            if (col.grp) td.classList.add(col.grp);
            if (col.align === 'left') td.classList.add('td-left');
            else if (col.align === 'right') td.classList.add('num-cell');

            if (col.cell)       col.cell.call(col, td, row);
            else if (col.qty)   td.textContent = formatNumber(row[col.key]);
            else if (col.money) td.textContent = formatCurrencyVal(safeCost(row[col.key]));
            else                td.textContent = row[col.key] == null ? '' : row[col.key];

            tr.appendChild(td);
        });

        // Clicking anywhere on the row expands the location-group breakdown. The
        // chips in LG Split / Avail Elsewhere were the only way in, which made the
        // breakdown invisible whenever those columns were hidden — and they are
        // hidden automatically when there is no per-LG requirement to summarise.
        //
        // Anything the user might be aiming AT is excluded: the qty box and the
        // checkbox (which would otherwise expand a row on every edit), links into
        // Fishbowl modules, and the chips, which toggle this themselves and would
        // cancel their own effect by bubbling.
        if (lgDetailRowsFor(row).length) {
            tr.classList.add('has-lg-detail');
            if (lgDetailOpen[key]) tr.classList.add('lg-detail-open');
            tr.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target.closest('input, a, button, select, textarea, label, .lg-split')) return;
                toggleLgDetail(key);
            });
        }
        return tr;
    }

    // Groups the filtered rows by vendor and returns [{vendorId, vendorName, parts}].
    function buildGroupedData(data) {
        var vendorGroups = {};
        var vendorOrder = [];

        data.forEach(function(row) {
            var vid = row.vendor_id;
            if (vid === undefined || vid === null) return;
            if (!vendorGroups[vid]) {
                vendorGroups[vid] = {
                    vendorId: vid,
                    vendorName: row.vendor_name || 'Unknown Vendor',
                    parts: []
                };
                vendorOrder.push(vid);
            }
            vendorGroups[vid].parts.push(row);
        });

        vendorOrder.sort(function(a, b) {
            var nameA = (vendorGroups[a].vendorName || '').toLowerCase();
            var nameB = (vendorGroups[b].vendorName || '').toLowerCase();
            return nameA < nameB ? -1 : nameA > nameB ? 1 : 0;
        });

        return vendorOrder.map(function(vid) {
            var g = vendorGroups[vid];
            // Auto-collapse vendors with no Auto PO suggestions, first time we see them only.
            if (vendorCollapsed[vid] === undefined) {
                var hasSuggestions = g.parts.some(function(p) {
                    return (parseFloat(p.qty_suggested) || 0) > 0;
                });
                vendorCollapsed[vid] = !hasSuggestions;
            }
            // Sorting happens here rather than in renderBody so CSV and print,
            // which both call this function, come out in the order on screen.
            g.parts = sortParts(g.parts);
            return g;
        });
    }

    // Vendor band row 1 — one full-width cell: identity on the left, PO Value and the
    // Create PO button pinned to the far right of the table. The cube/weight totals live
    // in the container row below, so no per-column subtotal cells are needed here.
    function buildVendorHeader(g, vis) {
        var vid = g.vendorId;
        var vname = g.vendorName || '';
        var tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'vendor-group-header';
        tr.setAttribute('data-vendor-id', vid);

        var td = document.createElement('td');
        td.colSpan = vis.length + 1;

        var isCollapsed = vendorCollapsed[vid];
        var expandClass = isCollapsed ? '' : ' expanded';
        var expandBtn = '<span class="vendor-expand-toggle' + expandClass + '" data-vendor-id="' + vid +
            '" onclick="toggleVendorCollapse(' + vid + ', this)" title="Expand / collapse">' +
            '<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' +
            '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"></path></svg></span>';
        var vendorIcon = '<svg class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
            'viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color: var(--color-primary);"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ' +

    // Vendor band row 2 — container selector + volume/weight bars + verdict.
    function buildVendorCapRow(g, vis) {

        tr.setAttribute('data-vendor-id', vid);

        var td = document.createElement('td');

        var selected = vendorContainerKey(vid);
        var opts = CONTAINER_LIST.map(function(c) {
