    // ============================================
    // Band refresh — the single place the live figures are written
    // ============================================
    function _q(sel) { return document.querySelector(sel); }

    function refreshVendorBand(vendorId) {
        var load = calcVendorLoad(vendorId);

        var cb = _q('.vendor-select-all[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (cb) cb.checked = (load.selectedCount === load.partCount && load.partCount > 0);

        var badge = _q('.vendor-count-badge[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (badge) badge.textContent = '(' + load.selectedCount + '/' + load.partCount + ' selected)';

        var poEl = _q('.vendor-po-value[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (poEl) poEl.textContent = 'PO Value: ' + formatCurrencyVal(load.poValue);

        var cubeEl = _q('.cap-total-val[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"][data-kind="cube"]');
        if (cubeEl) cubeEl.textContent = fmtM3(load.volM3) + ' m³';
        var wtEl = _q('.cap-total-val[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"][data-kind="weight"]');
        if (wtEl) wtEl.textContent = fmtKg(load.weightKg) + ' kg';

        _paintBar(vendorId, 'vol', load.volPct, fmtM3Pair(load.volM3, load.capVol));
        _paintBar(vendorId, 'wt',  load.weightPct, fmtKgPair(load.weightKg, load.capWt));

        // "2.3 needed" — the fractional count of single containers this load actually fills.
        var needEl = _q('.cap-count-need[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (needEl) {
            if (load.binding === 'none') {
                needEl.textContent = '';
                needEl.className = 'cap-count-need';
            } else {
                var n = load.containersNeeded;
                needEl.textContent = '→ ' + (n < 0.1 ? n.toFixed(2) : n.toFixed(1)) + ' needed';
                needEl.className = 'cap-count-need' +
                    (n > load.containerQty + 1e-9 ? ' over' : '');
                needEl.title = 'Fills ' + n.toFixed(2) + ' x ' + load.spec.label +
                    ' (planning for ' + load.containerQty + ')';
            }
        }

        var verdict = _q('.cap-verdict[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (verdict) {
            if (load.binding === 'none') {
                verdict.textContent = '';
                verdict.className = 'cap-verdict';
            } else {
                var pct = Math.round(load.headlinePct);
                var word = load.binding === 'volume' ? 'WILL CUBE OUT' : 'WILL WEIGH OUT';
                var of = load.containerQty === 1
                    ? load.spec.label
                    : load.containerQty + ' x ' + load.spec.label;
                verdict.textContent = '▸ ' + word + ' — ' + pct + '% of ' + of;
                verdict.className = 'cap-verdict' + (load.headlinePct > 100 ? ' over'
                    : load.headlinePct >= 90 ? ' near' : '');
            }
        }

        var warn = _q('.cap-warn[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (warn) {
            var bits = [];
            if (load.linesNoDims)   bits.push(load.linesNoDims + ' line' + (load.linesNoDims === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' missing dimensions');
            if (load.linesNoWeight) bits.push(load.linesNoWeight + ' missing weight');
            // Text is built from integers only, so it needs no escaping.
            warn.innerHTML = bits.length
                ? WARN_SVG + ' ' + bits.join(', ') + ' — actual fill will be higher'
                : '';
        }
        return load;
    }

    function _paintBar(vendorId, kind, pct, label) {
        var fill = _q('.cap-bar-fill[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"][data-kind="' + kind + '"]');
        var val  = _q('.cap-bar-val[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"][data-kind="' + kind + '"]');
        if (fill) {
            fill.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)) + '%';
            fill.className = 'cap-bar-fill' + (pct > 100 ? ' over' : pct >= 90 ? ' near' : '');
        }
        if (val) val.textContent = label + '  (' + Math.round(pct) + '%)';
    }

    function refreshAllVendorBands() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.vendor-select-all[data-vendor-id]').forEach(function(cb) {
            refreshVendorBand(parseInt(cb.getAttribute('data-vendor-id')));
        });
        updateOverallSummary();
    }

    function updateOverallSummary() {
        var overallTotal = 0;
        var overallSelected = 0;
        Object.keys(vendorIndex).forEach(function(vid) {
            var load = calcVendorLoad(parseInt(vid));
            overallTotal += load.poValue;
            overallSelected += load.selectedCount;
        });
        var totalEl = document.getElementById('overallPoTotal');
        if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = formatCurrencyVal(overallTotal);
        var countEl = document.getElementById('overallSelectedCount');
        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = overallSelected + ' / ' + allResults.length + ' parts';
    }

    // Repaint just the cube/weight cells of one row without a full re-render.
    function refreshRowDerived(key) {
        var row = rowByKey[key];
        if (!row) return;
        var cubeTd = _q('td[data-cube-key="' + key + '"]');
        if (cubeTd) { cubeTd.innerHTML = ''; cellCubeLine(cubeTd, row); }
        var wtTd = _q('td[data-weight-key="' + key + '"]');
        if (wtTd) { wtTd.innerHTML = ''; cellWeightLine(wtTd, row); }
        // "Elsewhere covers the order" is judged against Order Qty, so it has to
        // be repainted as the buyer edits — otherwise it keeps saying a transfer
        // would cover an order that has since been increased.
        var tr = _q('tr[data-key="' + key + '"]');
        var elseTd = tr ? tr.querySelector('td[data-column="_availElsewhere"]') : null;
        if (elseTd) { elseTd.innerHTML = ''; cellAvailElsewhere(elseTd, row); }
        // The below-minimum flag is judged against Order Qty, so it repaints too —
        // editing a quantity down under the vendor minimum has to show immediately.
        var moqTd = _q('td[data-moq-key="' + key + '"]');
        if (moqTd) { moqTd.innerHTML = ''; moqTd.removeAttribute('title'); cellMoq(moqTd, row); }
    }

    // ============================================
    // Collapse
    // ============================================
    function toggleVendorCollapse(vendorId, toggleEl) {
        vendorCollapsed[vendorId] = !vendorCollapsed[vendorId];
        var isCollapsed = vendorCollapsed[vendorId];

        if (isCollapsed) toggleEl.classList.remove('expanded');
        else toggleEl.classList.add('expanded');

        document.querySelectorAll('#tBody tr.item-row[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]').forEach(function(tr) {
            if (isCollapsed) tr.classList.add('vendor-collapsed');
            else tr.classList.remove('vendor-collapsed');
        });
    }

    // ============================================
    // Column picker
    // ============================================
    function buildColPanel() {
        var list = document.getElementById('colList');
        if (!list) return;
        list.innerHTML = '';

        _columns.forEach(function(col, i) {
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'col-row';
            div.draggable = true;
            div.dataset.idx = i;

            var handle = document.createElement('span');
            handle.className = 'drag-handle';
            handle.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="10" viewBox="0 0 12 10" fill="currentColor">' +
                '<rect y="0" width="12" height="2" rx="1"/><rect y="4" width="12" height="2" rx="1"/>' +
                '<rect y="8" width="12" height="2" rx="1"/></svg>';

            var cbx = document.createElement('input');
            cbx.type = 'checkbox';
            cbx.checked = col.vis;
            cbx.id = 'cv_' + col.key;
            cbx.addEventListener('change', function() {
                col.vis = cbx.checked;
                // Turning a usage column on for the first time has to fetch the data
                // it needs — the query is skipped while they are all hidden.
                if ((col.key === '_qtySold' || col.key === '_daysOfStock') && cbx.checked
                    && !usageWindow.days) {
                    loadUsageData();
                }
                syncUsageControlVisibility();
                renderTable();
                persistCols();
            });

            var lbl = document.createElement('label');
            lbl.htmlFor = cbx.id;
            lbl.textContent = col.label;
            if (col.tip) lbl.title = col.tip;

            div.appendChild(handle);
            div.appendChild(cbx);
            div.appendChild(lbl);

            div.addEventListener('dragstart', function() {
                _dragIdx = i;
                setTimeout(function() { div.classList.add('dragging'); }, 0);
            });
            div.addEventListener('dragend', function() {
                div.classList.remove('dragging');
                _dragIdx = null;
            });
            div.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                list.querySelectorAll('.col-row').forEach(function(r) { r.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
                div.classList.add('drag-over');
            });
            div.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { div.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
            div.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                div.classList.remove('drag-over');
                var from = _dragIdx;
                if (from === null || from === i) return;
                var moved = _columns.splice(from, 1)[0];
                _columns.splice(i, 0, moved);
                buildColPanel();
                renderTable();
                persistCols();
            });

            list.appendChild(div);
        });
    }

    function toggleColPanel() {
        var p = document.getElementById('colPanel');
        if (p) p.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }

    // ============================================
    // Selection Logic
    // ============================================
    function _vendorIdOfKey(key) {
        return parseInt(String(key).split('_')[0]);
    }

    function toggleRowSelection(key, checked) {
        selectionState[key] = checked;
        var qtyInput = document.querySelector('.qty-input[data-key="' + key + '"]');
        if (qtyInput) qtyInput.disabled = !checked;
        var tr = document.querySelector('#tBody tr.item-row[data-key="' + key + '"]');
        if (tr) tr.classList.toggle('row-deselected', !checked);
        refreshRowDerived(key);
        refreshVendorBand(_vendorIdOfKey(key));
        updateOverallSummary();
    }

    function toggleVendorSelectAll(vendorId, checked) {
        (vendorIndex[vendorId] || []).forEach(function(item) {
            selectionState[item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id] = checked;
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#tBody tr.item-row[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]').forEach(function(tr) {
            var key = tr.getAttribute('data-key');
            tr.classList.toggle('row-deselected', !checked);
            var cb = tr.querySelector('.row-checkbox');
            if (cb) cb.checked = checked;
            var inp = tr.querySelector('.qty-input');
            if (inp) inp.disabled = !checked;
            refreshRowDerived(key);
        });
        refreshVendorBand(vendorId);
        updateOverallSummary();
    }

    function toggleSelectAll(checked) {
        allResults.forEach(function(item) {
            selectionState[item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id] = checked;
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#tBody tr.item-row').forEach(function(tr) {
            tr.classList.toggle('row-deselected', !checked);
            var cb = tr.querySelector('.row-checkbox');
            if (cb) cb.checked = checked;
            var inp = tr.querySelector('.qty-input');
            if (inp) inp.disabled = !checked;
            refreshRowDerived(tr.getAttribute('data-key'));
        });
        refreshAllVendorBands();
    }

    // ============================================
    // Qty Override
    // Fires on every keystroke (live=true) so the vendor capacity gauge tracks typing;
    // the change event repeats it as the authoritative commit. Only the touched vendor's
    // band repaints, and calcVendorLoad reads vendorIndex, so this stays cheap.
    // ============================================
    var _qtyLiveTimer = null;

    function updateQtyOverride(key, value, live) {
        var num = parseFloat(value);
        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) num = 0;
        // Whole numbers only when the part's UOM is integral (Each and friends).
        var row = rowByKey[key];
        if (row && row._qtyIntegral) num = Math.round(num);
        qtyOverrides[key] = num;

        if (live) {
            if (_qtyLiveTimer) clearTimeout(_qtyLiveTimer);
            _qtyLiveTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                refreshRowDerived(key);
                refreshVendorBand(_vendorIdOfKey(key));
                updateOverallSummary();
            }, 120);
            return num;
        }
        if (_qtyLiveTimer) { clearTimeout(_qtyLiveTimer); _qtyLiveTimer = null; }
        refreshRowDerived(key);
        refreshVendorBand(_vendorIdOfKey(key));
        updateOverallSummary();
        return num;
    }

    // ============================================
    // PO Modal
    // ============================================
    function collectModalItems(vendorId) {
        var selectedItems = [];
        allResults.forEach(function(item) {
            if (item.vendor_id !== vendorId) return;
            var key = item.vendor_id + '_' + item.part_id;
            if (!selectionState[key]) return;

            var qty = qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined ? qtyOverrides[key] : (parseFloat(item.qty_suggested) || 0);
            if (qty <= 0) return;

            var cost = safeCost(item.last_cost);
            var fbPN = item._fbPartNum || '';
            var vendorPN = item._vendorPartNum || '';
            var showVPN = document.getElementById('paramShowVendorPN').checked;
            var partDisplay = fbPN;
            if (showVPN && vendorPN && vendorPN !== fbPN) {
                partDisplay = fbPN + ' (' + vendorPN + ')';
            }

            selectedItems.push({
                partId: item.part_id,
                partNum: fbPN,
                vendorPartNum: vendorPN,
                partNumDisplay: partDisplay,
                partDescription: item.part_description || '',
                qty: qty,
                originalQty: qty,
                uomId: item.vendor_uom_id || item.part_uom_id,
                uomCode: item.vendor_uom_code || item.part_uom_code || 'ea',
                unitCost: cost,
                lineTotal: qty * cost,
                partTaxRate: item._partTaxRate || null,
                _perLgQty: item._perLgQty || null
            });
        });
        return selectedItems;
    }

    function buildModalTableHtml(items, editable) {
        var tableRows = '';
        items.forEach(function(item, idx) {
            // Honour the UOM's integral flag here too — this input is what actually
            // becomes the PO line quantity. (Both branches of `editable` were identical.)
            var lineIntegral = uomIsIntegral(item.uomId);
            var qtyCell = '<input type="text" class="modal-input" id="modal-qty-' + idx + '"' +
                ' value="' + (lineIntegral ? Math.round(item.qty) : item.qty) + '"' +
                ' title="' + (lineIntegral
                    ? 'Whole ' + escAttr(item.uomCode) + ' only — this unit of measure is integral'
                    : 'Fractional quantities allowed for ' + escAttr(item.uomCode)) + '"' +
                ' onchange="recalcModalLine(' + idx + ')">';
            tableRows +=
                '<tr>' +
                    '<td><strong>' + item.partNumDisplay + '</strong></td>' +
                    '<td>' + item.partDescription + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="col-right">' + item.uomCode + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="col-right">' + qtyCell + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="col-right"><input type="text" class="modal-input modal-cost" id="modal-cost-' + idx + '" value="' + item.unitCost.toFixed(2) + '" onchange="recalcModalLine(' + idx + ')"></td>' +
                    '<td class="col-right" id="modal-linetotal-' + idx + '">' + formatCurrencyVal(item.lineTotal) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
        });

        var grandTotal = 0;
        items.forEach(function(i) { grandTotal += i.lineTotal; });

        tableRows +=
            '<tr class="modal-total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3"></td>' +
                '<td class="col-right"><strong>Total</strong></td>' +
                '<td></td>' +
                '<td class="col-right"><strong id="modal-grand-total">' + formatCurrencyVal(grandTotal) + '</strong></td>' +
            '</tr>';

        return '<table class="modal-table">' +
            '<thead><tr>' +
                '<th>Part #</th><th>Description</th><th class="col-right">UOM</th>' +
                '<th class="col-right">Qty</th><th class="col-right">Unit Cost</th><th class="col-right">Line Total</th>' +
            '</tr></thead>' +
            '<tbody>' + tableRows + '</tbody></table>';
    }

    // The modal table is built as an HTML string, so its inputs are wired after
    // insertion. Same no-spinner rule as the grid: the cost field in particular was
    // losing ~16px of its width to arrows nobody uses.
    function wireModalNumericInputs() {
        var items = window._modalItems || [];
        document.querySelectorAll('#poModal input.modal-input').forEach(function(inp) {
            if (inp.getAttribute('data-num-wired')) return;
            inp.setAttribute('data-num-wired', '1');
            var id = inp.id || '';
            var isCost = id.indexOf('modal-cost-') === 0;
            var idx = parseInt(id.replace(/^modal-(qty|cost)-/, ''));
            // Money always takes decimals; a quantity takes them only when its UOM
            // can be subdivided, exactly as in the grid.
            var dec = isCost || !uomIsIntegral((items[idx] || {}).uomId);
            attachNumericInput(inp, { decimals: dec, min: 0, step: isCost ? 0.01 : 1 });
        });
    }

    function openPoModal(vendorId) {
        var selectedItems = collectModalItems(vendorId);

        if (selectedItems.length === 0) {
            showStatus('No parts selected with qty > 0 for this vendor.', 'warning');
            return;
        }

        var vendorName = '';
        allResults.forEach(function(item) {
            if (item.vendor_id === vendorId && !vendorName) vendorName = item.vendor_name;
        });

        // Store modal state
        window._modalItems = selectedItems;
        window._modalVendorId = vendorId;
        window._modalVendorName = vendorName;
        window._modalMode = 'single';
        window._modalCreatedPOs = [];  // track POs created in per-LG mode: [{ lgId, lgName, poNum, items }]
        // Deep copy original items so we can track remainders
        window._modalOriginalItems = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(selectedItems));

        var isLgSplitAvailable = lgReorderEnabled && document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup').value === '-1' && userLocationGroups.length > 1;

        // Build LG options for dropdown
        var lgOptions = '';
        if (isLgSplitAvailable) {
            userLocationGroups.forEach(function(lg) {
                var selected = (lg.id === userDefaultLG.id) ? ' selected' : '';
                lgOptions += '<option value="' + lg.id + '"' + selected + '>' + lg.name + '</option>';
            });
        }

        // LG selector section (only shown when LG split is available)
        var lgSectionHtml = '';
        if (isLgSplitAvailable) {
            lgSectionHtml =
                '<div style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; padding:12px 24px; background:#f8fafc;">' +
                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
