    function switchModalLgMode(mode) {
        window._modalMode = mode;
        var label = document.getElementById('modal-lg-label');
        if (mode === 'single') {
            if (label) label.textContent = 'Ship to:';
            // Restore full LG dropdown (all user LGs)
            var lgSel = document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');
            if (lgSel) {
                lgSel.innerHTML = '';
                userLocationGroups.forEach(function(lg) {
                    var opt = document.createElement('option');
                    opt.value = lg.id;
                    opt.textContent = lg.name;
                    if (lg.id === userDefaultLG.id) opt.selected = true;
                    lgSel.appendChild(opt);
                });
            }
            // Restore full item list (minus any already-ordered quantities from per-LG POs)
            refreshModalTableForRemainder();
        } else {
            if (label) label.textContent = 'Location Group:';
            // Pre-scan all LGs to find which have suggestions, cache results
            prescanLgSuggestions();
        }
    }

    function prescanLgSuggestions() {
        var vendorId = window._modalVendorId;
        var originalItems = window._modalOriginalItems;

        window._lgSuggestionCache = {};
        var lgsWithSuggestions = [];

        // Use the cached split ONLY when the main load's per-LG scan swept every
        // location group through the Auto PO engine. A cache that merely has SOME
        // per-LG data is not evidence that it has ALL of it — trusting "any item
        // has any entry" is what let a location group with real need go missing
        // from this dropdown while selecting it on its own reported it correctly.
        var hasCachedPerLg = perLgScanComplete &&
            originalItems.some(function(o) { return o._perLgQty && Object.keys(o._perLgQty).length > 0; });

        if (!perLgScanComplete) {
            debugLog('Per-LG split was incomplete at load — re-scanning every LG with the engine', 'warning');
        }

        if (hasCachedPerLg) {
            // Build LG list from cached per-LG data — no engine calls needed
            debugLog('Using cached per-LG data from main load for vendor ' + vendorId, 'info');
            var lgIdSet = {};
            originalItems.forEach(function(o) {
                if (!o._perLgQty) return;
                Object.keys(o._perLgQty).forEach(function(lgIdStr) {
                    var lgId = parseInt(lgIdStr);
                    // Skip LGs that already have a PO created
                    var alreadyDone = window._modalCreatedPOs.some(function(p) { return p.lgId === lgId; });
                    if (alreadyDone) return;
                    if (!lgIdSet[lgId]) {
                        lgIdSet[lgId] = {};
                    }
                    lgIdSet[lgId][o.partId] = o._perLgQty[lgId];
                });
            });
            Object.keys(lgIdSet).forEach(function(lgIdStr) {
                var lgId = parseInt(lgIdStr);
                var lgInfo = userLocationGroups.find(function(lg) { return lg.id === lgId; });
                if (!lgInfo) return;
                window._lgSuggestionCache[lgId] = lgIdSet[lgId];
                lgsWithSuggestions.push(lgInfo);
                debugLog('  LG ' + lgInfo.name + ' (id=' + lgId + '): ' + Object.keys(lgIdSet[lgId]).length + ' parts (cached)', 'info');
            });
        } else {
            // No cached data — fall back to calling getAutoPo per LG
            var qbClassId = parseInt(document.getElementById('paramQBClass').value);
            var showVendorPN = document.getElementById('paramShowVendorPN').checked;
            var includeNoROP = document.getElementById('paramIncludeNoROP').checked;
            var includeMfg = document.getElementById('paramIncludeMfg').checked;
            var startDate = document.getElementById('paramStartDate').value;
            var endDate = document.getElementById('paramEndDate').value;
            var originalPartIds = {};
            originalItems.forEach(function(o) { originalPartIds[o.partId] = true; });

            debugLog('Pre-scanning ' + userLocationGroups.length + ' LGs for vendor ' + vendorId + ' (no cache)...', 'info');

            userLocationGroups.forEach(function(lg) {
                var alreadyDone = window._modalCreatedPOs.some(function(p) { return p.lgId === lg.id; });
                if (alreadyDone) return;

                try {
                    var resultJson = getAutoPo(vendorId, lg.id, qbClassId, showVendorPN, includeNoROP, includeMfg, startDate, endDate);
                    var engineItems = JSON.parse(resultJson);

                    var lgQtyMap = {};
                    var hasSuggestions = false;
                    if (engineItems && engineItems.length > 0) {
                        engineItems.forEach(function(ei) {
                            var sugQty = parseFloat(ei.qty_suggested) || 0;
                            if (sugQty > 0 && originalPartIds[ei.part_id]) {
                                lgQtyMap[ei.part_id] = sugQty;
                                hasSuggestions = true;
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    if (hasSuggestions) {
                        window._lgSuggestionCache[lg.id] = lgQtyMap;
                        lgsWithSuggestions.push(lg);
                        debugLog('  LG ' + lg.name + ' (id=' + lg.id + '): ' + Object.keys(lgQtyMap).length + ' parts', 'info');
                    } else {
                        debugLog('  LG ' + lg.name + ' (id=' + lg.id + '): no suggestions', 'info');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    debugLog('  LG ' + lg.name + ' scan failed: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                }
            });
        }

        debugLog('LGs with suggestions: ' + lgsWithSuggestions.length + '/' + userLocationGroups.length, 'info');

        // Rebuild dropdown with only LGs that have suggestions
        var lgSel = document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');
        if (lgSel) {
            lgSel.innerHTML = '';
            if (lgsWithSuggestions.length === 0) {
                var opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = '';
                opt.textContent = '(No LGs with suggestions)';
                opt.disabled = true;
                lgSel.appendChild(opt);
                document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
                    '<div style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:#64748b;">' +
                        '<p style="font-size:14px;">No location groups have suggested quantities for this vendor.</p>' +
                        '<p style="font-size:12px; margin-top:4px;">Switch to Single PO mode to create one order.</p>' +
                    '</div>';
                document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = true;
                document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = '0';
                return;
            }
            lgsWithSuggestions.forEach(function(lg, idx) {
                var opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = lg.id;
                opt.textContent = lg.name;
                if (idx === 0) opt.selected = true;
                lgSel.appendChild(opt);
            });
        }

        // Load the first LG's items
        onModalLgChange();
    }

    // Select the next un-ordered location group that actually has a quantity left
    // to buy. Per-LG shortfalls routinely sum to MORE than the company-wide
    // suggestion, so the last group or two can be fully covered by the earlier
    // orders; advancing to one of those left the buyer on an empty table.
    function advanceToNextOrderableLg() {
        var lgSel = document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');
        if (!lgSel) return false;
        var ordered = {};
        (window._modalCreatedPOs || []).forEach(function(po) { ordered[po.lgId] = true; });

        for (var i = 0; i < lgSel.options.length; i++) {
            var lgId = parseInt(lgSel.options[i].value);
            if (!lgId || ordered[lgId]) continue;
            lgSel.selectedIndex = i;
            loadPerLgItems(lgId);                       // fills window._modalItems
            if ((window._modalItems || []).length > 0) return true;
            ordered[lgId] = true;                       // nothing left here — keep going
        }
        return false;
    }

    function onModalLgChange() {
        if (window._modalMode !== 'per-lg') return;
        var lgSel = document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');
        if (!lgSel) return;
        var lgId = parseInt(lgSel.value);
        var lgName = lgSel.options[lgSel.selectedIndex].text;

        // Check if PO already created for this LG
        var alreadyDone = window._modalCreatedPOs.some(function(p) { return p.lgId === lgId; });
        if (alreadyDone) {
            document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
                '<div style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:#64748b;">' +
                    '<p style="font-size:14px; font-weight:600;">PO already created for ' + lgName + '</p>' +
                    '<p style="font-size:12px; margin-top:4px;">Select another location group or switch to Single PO for remaining items.</p>' +
                '</div>';
            document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = '0';
            return;
        }

        // Call getAutoPo for this specific LG to get per-LG quantities
        loadPerLgItems(lgId);
    }

    function loadPerLgItems(lgId) {
        try {
            // Use cached per-LG data from prescan if available, otherwise call engine
            var lgQtyMap = {};
            if (window._lgSuggestionCache && window._lgSuggestionCache[lgId]) {
                lgQtyMap = window._lgSuggestionCache[lgId];
                debugLog('Using cached per-LG data for LG ' + lgId, 'info');
            } else {
                var vendorId = window._modalVendorId;
                var qbClassId = parseInt(document.getElementById('paramQBClass').value);
                var showVendorPN = document.getElementById('paramShowVendorPN').checked;
                var includeNoROP = document.getElementById('paramIncludeNoROP').checked;
                var includeMfg = document.getElementById('paramIncludeMfg').checked;
                var startDate = document.getElementById('paramStartDate').value;
                var endDate = document.getElementById('paramEndDate').value;

                var resultJson = getAutoPo(vendorId, lgId, qbClassId, showVendorPN, includeNoROP, includeMfg, startDate, endDate);
                var engineItems = JSON.parse(resultJson);

                if (engineItems && engineItems.length > 0) {
                    engineItems.forEach(function(ei) {
                        var sugQty = parseFloat(ei.qty_suggested) || 0;
                        if (sugQty > 0) {
                            lgQtyMap[ei.part_id] = sugQty;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            // Build per-LG items from original selection, using per-LG quantities
            // Also subtract any quantities already ordered for this part in other LG POs
            var perLgItems = [];
            var originalItems = window._modalOriginalItems;
            originalItems.forEach(function(orig) {
                var lgQty = lgQtyMap[orig.partId] || 0;
                if (lgQty <= 0) return;

                // Cap to remaining qty (original minus already-ordered across all LGs)
                var alreadyOrdered = 0;
                window._modalCreatedPOs.forEach(function(po) {
                    po.items.forEach(function(pi) {
                        if (pi.partId === orig.partId) alreadyOrdered += pi.qty;
                    });
                });
                var remaining = orig.originalQty - alreadyOrdered;
                if (remaining <= 0) return;
                var qty = Math.min(lgQty, remaining);
                if (qty <= 0) return;

                perLgItems.push({
                    partId: orig.partId,
                    partNum: orig.partNum,
                    vendorPartNum: orig.vendorPartNum,
                    partNumDisplay: orig.partNumDisplay,
                    partDescription: orig.partDescription,
                    qty: qty,
                    originalQty: orig.originalQty,
                    uomId: orig.uomId,
                    uomCode: orig.uomCode,
                    unitCost: orig.unitCost,
                    lineTotal: qty * orig.unitCost,
                    partTaxRate: orig.partTaxRate || null
                });
            });

            window._modalItems = perLgItems;

            if (perLgItems.length === 0) {
                document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
                    '<div style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:#64748b;">' +
                        '<p style="font-size:14px;">No suggested quantities for this location group.</p>' +
                    '</div>';
                document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = true;
                document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = '0';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML = buildModalTableHtml(perLgItems, true);
                wireModalNumericInputs();
                document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = false;
                document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = perLgItems.length;
            }

            debugLog('Per-LG items for LG ' + lgId + ': ' + perLgItems.length + ' items', 'info');
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Failed to load per-LG Auto PO data: ' + e.message, 'error');
            document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
                '<div style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:#ef4444;">' +
                    '<p style="font-size:14px;">Error loading data for this location group.</p>' +
                    '<p style="font-size:12px; margin-top:4px;">' + e.message + '</p>' +
                '</div>';
            document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = true;
        }
    }

    function refreshModalTableForRemainder() {
        // Rebuild items list from originals minus already-ordered quantities
        var remainderItems = [];
        window._modalOriginalItems.forEach(function(orig) {
            var alreadyOrdered = 0;
            window._modalCreatedPOs.forEach(function(po) {
                po.items.forEach(function(pi) {
                    if (pi.partId === orig.partId) alreadyOrdered += pi.qty;
                });
            });
            var remaining = orig.originalQty - alreadyOrdered;
            if (remaining <= 0) return;

            remainderItems.push({
                partId: orig.partId,
                partNum: orig.partNum,
                vendorPartNum: orig.vendorPartNum,
                partNumDisplay: orig.partNumDisplay,
                partDescription: orig.partDescription,
                qty: remaining,
                originalQty: orig.originalQty,
                uomId: orig.uomId,
                uomCode: orig.uomCode,
                unitCost: orig.unitCost,
                lineTotal: remaining * orig.unitCost,
                partTaxRate: orig.partTaxRate || null
            });
        });

        window._modalItems = remainderItems;

        if (remainderItems.length === 0) {
            document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
                '<div style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:#16a34a;">' +
                    '<svg class="w-8 h-8" style="margin:0 auto 8px; color:#16a34a;" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>' +
                    '<p style="font-size:14px; font-weight:600;">All items have been ordered</p>' +
                '</div>';
            document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = '0';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML = buildModalTableHtml(remainderItems, true);
            wireModalNumericInputs();
            document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn').disabled = false;
            document.getElementById('modal-item-count').textContent = remainderItems.length;
        }
    }

    // Shown once every location group with a shortfall has its order. Without this
    // the flow simply ran out of location groups and left the buyer looking at a
    // remainder table with no indication that the job was done or how to leave.
    function showModalPerLgComplete() {
        var created = window._modalCreatedPOs || [];
        var leftover = 0;
        (window._modalOriginalItems || []).forEach(function(o) {
            leftover += Math.max(0, o.originalQty - modalOrderedSoFar(o.partId));
        });

        var links = created.map(function(po) {
            return '<a href="#" onclick="openModule(\'Purchase Order\', \'' +
                String(po.poNum || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\'); return false;" ' +
                'style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:12px; ' +
                'padding:4px 10px; border-radius:6px; background:#dcfce7; color:#166534; ' +
                'font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid #bbf7d0;">' +
                escHtml(po.lgName) + (po.poNum ? ' — PO# ' + escHtml(po.poNum) : '') + '</a>';
        }).join(' ');

        document.getElementById('modal-table-body').innerHTML =
            '<div style="text-align:center; padding:28px 16px;">' +
                '<svg style="width:34px;height:34px;margin:0 auto 10px;color:#16a34a;display:block;" ' +
                    'fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' +
                    '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" ' +
                    'd="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>' +
                '<p style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#166534; margin:0 0 4px;">' +
                    created.length + ' purchase order' + (created.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                    ' created</p>' +
                '<p style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; margin:0 0 14px;">' +
                    'Every location group with a shortfall now has an order. ' +
                    'They are listed on the vendor row behind this dialog.</p>' +
                '<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; justify-content:center;">' +
                    links + '</div>' +
                (leftover > 0
                    ? '<p style="font-size:12px; color:#92400e; margin:16px 0 0;">' +
                      formatNumber(leftover) + ' unit(s) of the original suggestion are not ' +
                      'covered by any location group\'s shortfall. Switch to <strong>Single PO' +
                      '</strong> above to order the remainder, or leave it — the quantity is ' +
                      'still on the row behind.</p>'
                    : '') +
            '</div>';
        var submit = document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn');
        if (submit) submit.disabled = true;
        var count = document.getElementById('modal-item-count');
        if (count) count.textContent = '0';
    }

    // The footer's left button is Cancel until something has actually been created,
    // at which point cancelling is the wrong word for the only way out — it reads as
    // "undo", which it cannot do. It becomes a positive Done.
    function syncModalCloseButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('modal-close-btn');
        if (!btn) return;
        var any = (window._modalCreatedPOs || []).length > 0;
        btn.textContent = any ? 'Done' : 'Cancel';
        btn.style.background = any ? '#16a34a' : '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = any ? '#15803d' : '#cbd5e1';
        btn.style.color = any ? '#fff' : '#334155';
        btn.title = any
            ? 'Close this dialog. The orders already created are listed on the vendor row.'
            : 'Close without creating a purchase order';
    }

    function updateModalCreatedSummary() {
        var container = document.getElementById('modal-lg-created');
        if (!container || window._modalCreatedPOs.length === 0) return;

        var html = '<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; align-items:center;">' +
            '<span style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b; font-weight:600;">Created:</span>';
        window._modalCreatedPOs.forEach(function(po) {
            html += '<span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; background:#dcfce7; color:#166534; font-weight:500; border:1px solid #bbf7d0;">' +
                po.lgName + (po.poNum ? ' — PO# ' + po.poNum : '') +
                ' (' + po.items.length + ' items)</span>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
        container.innerHTML = html;
        container.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // Every PO raised for this vendor, shown on its band row.
    //
    // IDEMPOTENT, and called after EVERY purchase order rather than only once the
    // whole selection is accounted for. The per-location-group flow raises several
    // orders in a row, and it used to update the band only when nothing was left to
    // buy — so a buyer who ordered for the two groups that needed stock and then
    // closed the modal was returned to a page that still said "Create PO" and listed
    // none of the orders they had just raised. (The old version also appended the
    // full badge list on every call, so calling it per PO duplicated them.)
    //
    // The Create PO button SURVIVES while the vendor still has something selected
    // with a quantity: the remainder is genuinely still to buy, and removing the
    // button would strand it.
    function syncVendorHeaderPOs(vendorId) {
        var toggle = document.querySelector(
            '.vendor-group-header .vendor-expand-toggle[data-vendor-id="' + vendorId + '"]');
        if (!toggle) return;
        var headerDiv = toggle.closest('.vendor-group-header td > div');
        if (!headerDiv) return;
        var rightDiv = headerDiv.querySelector('div:last-child');
        if (!rightDiv) return;

        var poNums = [];
        if (window._vendorPOs && window._vendorPOs[vendorId]) {
            var stored = window._vendorPOs[vendorId];
            poNums = Array.isArray(stored) ? stored.slice() : [stored];
        }
        poNums = poNums.filter(Boolean);

        // Rebuild rather than append, so repeat calls cannot double up.
        rightDiv.querySelectorAll('.po-raised-link').forEach(function(el) { el.remove(); });
        poNums.forEach(function(poNum) {
            rightDiv.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
                ' <a href="#" class="po-raised-link" onclick="openModule(\'Purchase Order\', \'' +
                String(poNum).replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\'); return false;" ' +
                'title="Open PO ' + escAttr(poNum) + ' in Fishbowl" ' +
                'style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:12px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:6px; ' +
                'background:#dcfce7; color:#166534; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid #bbf7d0;">' +
                '<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="width:14px;height:14px;">' +
                '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>' +
                'PO# ' + escHtml(poNum) + '</a>'
            );
        });

        // Anything still selected with a quantity means there is more to buy.
        var stillToBuy = (vendorIndex[vendorId] || []).some(function(item) {
            var key = vendorId + '_' + item.part_id;
            return selectionState[key] && orderQtyOf(item) > 0;
        });
        var createBtn = headerDiv.querySelector('.btn-create-po');
        if (createBtn && !stillToBuy) createBtn.remove();
    }

    // Total quantity of one part committed to a PO so far in this modal session.
    function modalOrderedSoFar(partId) {
        var n = 0;
        (window._modalCreatedPOs || []).forEach(function(po) {
            po.items.forEach(function(pi) { if (pi.partId === partId) n += pi.qty; });
        });
        return n;
    }

    // Reflect a created PO back onto the grid.
    //
    // Per location group, a part is usually ordered in PARTS — 9 for Melbourne now,
    // 12 for Adelaide next — so "ordered" is not a boolean. A row whose quantity is
    // only partly on order keeps its checkbox and has its Order Qty reduced to what
    // is actually left; only a fully ordered row is badged green, deselected and
    // locked. Leaving the full quantity in place after a partial order would make
    // the row, the vendor PO Value and the container gauge all overstate the buy.
    function markSubmittedRows(vendorId, items, poNum) {
        var origBy = {};
        (window._modalOriginalItems || []).forEach(function(o) { origBy[o.partId] = o.originalQty; });
        var perLg = window._modalMode === 'per-lg';

        items.forEach(function(item) {
            var key = vendorId + '_' + item.partId;
            // Single-PO mode does not record into _modalCreatedPOs, so the batch IS
            // everything that was ordered.
            var done = perLg ? modalOrderedSoFar(item.partId) : item.qty;
            var orig = origBy[item.partId] != null ? origBy[item.partId]
                                                   : (item.originalQty || item.qty);
            var remaining = Math.max(0, orig - done);

            var tr = document.querySelector('#tBody tr.item-row[data-key="' + key + '"]');
            if (tr && poNum) {
                var partCell = tr.querySelector('td[data-column="part_num"]');
                // One badge per PO number — a part ordered across three location
                // groups earns three badges, and a repeat call adds none.
                if (partCell && !partCell.querySelector('.po-badge[data-po="' + escAttr(poNum) + '"]')) {
                    partCell.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
                        '<span class="po-badge' + (remaining > 0 ? ' po-badge-part' : '') +
                        '" data-po="' + escAttr(poNum) + '" title="' +
                        (remaining > 0
                            ? formatNumber(item.qty) + ' of ' + formatNumber(orig) +
                              ' ordered on PO ' + escAttr(poNum) + ' — ' +
                              formatNumber(remaining) + ' still to buy'
                            : 'Fully ordered on PO ' + escAttr(poNum)) +
                        '">PO# ' + escHtml(poNum) + '</span>');
                }
            }

            if (remaining <= 0) {
                selectionState[key] = false;
                qtyOverrides[key] = 0;
                if (tr) {
                    tr.classList.add('row-ordered');
                    tr.classList.remove('row-part-ordered');
                    var cb = tr.querySelector('.row-checkbox');
                    if (cb) { cb.checked = false; cb.disabled = true; }
                    var inp = tr.querySelector('.qty-input');
                    if (inp) { inp.value = '0'; inp.disabled = true; }
                }
            } else {
                qtyOverrides[key] = remaining;
                if (tr) {
                    tr.classList.add('row-part-ordered');
                    var inp2 = tr.querySelector('.qty-input');
                    if (inp2) inp2.value = String(remaining);
                }
            }
            refreshRowDerived(key);
        });

        refreshVendorBand(vendorId);
        updateOverallSummary();
    }

    function closePoModal(event) {
        if (event && event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
        document.getElementById('poModal').innerHTML = '';
    }

    function recalcModalLine(idx) {
        var qtyInput = document.getElementById('modal-qty-' + idx);
        var costInput = document.getElementById('modal-cost-' + idx);
        var lineTotalEl = document.getElementById('modal-linetotal-' + idx);
        if (!qtyInput || !costInput || !lineTotalEl) return;

        var qty = parseFloat(qtyInput.value) || 0;
        if (qty < 0) qty = 0;
        // Normalise to whole units when the line's UOM is integral.
        var mi = window._modalItems && window._modalItems[idx];
        if (mi && uomIsIntegral(mi.uomId)) {
            qty = Math.round(qty);
            if (String(qty) !== qtyInput.value) qtyInput.value = String(qty);
        }
        var cost = parseFloat(costInput.value) || 0;
        var lineTotal = qty * cost;

        lineTotalEl.textContent = formatCurrencyVal(lineTotal);

        // Update item data
        if (window._modalItems && window._modalItems[idx]) {
            window._modalItems[idx].qty = qty;
            window._modalItems[idx].unitCost = cost;
            window._modalItems[idx].lineTotal = lineTotal;
        }

        // Recalculate grand total
        var grandTotal = 0;
        if (window._modalItems) {
            window._modalItems.forEach(function(item) { grandTotal += item.lineTotal; });
        }
        var gtEl = document.getElementById('modal-grand-total');
        if (gtEl) gtEl.textContent = formatCurrencyVal(grandTotal);
    }

    /**
     * Get location group name for PO creation.
     * When a specific LG is selected, returns that name.
     * When "Company Wide" (-1) is selected, returns user's default LG name
     * so the PO is raised against the user's default location group.
     */
    function getLocationGroupName() {
        var sel = document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup');
        if (sel.selectedIndex >= 0) {
            // Company Wide: use user's default LG
            if (sel.value === '-1') return userDefaultLG.name || '';
            return sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text;
        }
        return '';
    }

    /**
     * Get location group ID for address resolution.
     * Returns the selected LG ID, or the user's default LG ID when Company Wide.
     */
    function getLocationGroupId() {
        var val = parseInt(document.getElementById('paramLocationGroup').value);
        if (val === -1 || isNaN(val)) return userDefaultLG.id || 0;
        return val;
    }

    /**
     * Lookup vendor address from the address table.
     *
     * Returns the REST address shape — {name, street, city, state, postalCode, country} — where
     * `state` is the state ABBREVIATION and `country` the full country name, matching the
     * documented /api/purchase-orders contract.
     *
     * Every alias below is already lowercase on purpose: runQuery lowercases all result keys, so
     * reading `row.stateName` from `sc.name AS stateName` silently yields undefined. That bug is
     * why every PO this report has created so far carried an empty state and country.
     *
     * @param {number} vendorId - Vendor ID to resolve accountid
     * @param {number} addrType - Address type: 30=Remit To, 10=Ship To
     * @param {number} locationGroupId - Current location group ID (0 or -1 = any)
     */
    function lookupVendorAddress(vendorId, addrType, locationGroupId) {
        var empty = { name: '', street: '', city: '', state: '', postalCode: '', country: '' };
        try {
            // Get vendor's accountid
            var vendorRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                "SELECT accountid FROM vendor WHERE id = " + parseInt(vendorId)
            ));
            if (!vendorRows || vendorRows.length === 0) return empty;
            var accountId = vendorRows[0].accountid;
            if (!accountId) return empty;

            var lgId = (locationGroupId && locationGroupId > 0) ? parseInt(locationGroupId) : null;

            // Query addresses joining stateconst and countryconst for names.
            // Order by: LG match first, then requested type before Main Office, then default flag.
            var sql =
                "SELECT a.addressName AS addrname, a.address AS street, a.city AS city, " +
                "sc.code AS statecode, a.zip AS postalcode, cc.name AS countryname, " +
                "a.typeid, a.defaultflag, a.locationgroupid " +
                "FROM address a " +
                "LEFT JOIN stateconst sc ON sc.id = a.stateId " +
                "LEFT JOIN countryconst cc ON cc.id = a.countryId " +
                "WHERE a.accountid = " + parseInt(accountId) +
                " AND a.typeid IN (" + parseInt(addrType) + ", 50)" +
                " ORDER BY " +
                (lgId
                    ? "  CASE WHEN a.locationgroupid = " + lgId + " THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
                    : "") +
                "  CASE WHEN a.typeid = " + parseInt(addrType) + " THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, " +
                "  a.defaultflag DESC";

            var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(sql));
            debugLog('Vendor address rows (type ' + addrType + ' for accountid ' + accountId + ', lgId=' + lgId + '): ' + rows.length + ' candidates', 'info');
            if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return empty;

            // Pick best match: prefer requested type with matching locationgroup, then defaultFlag
            var best = null;

            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                var r = rows[i];
                var isRequestedType = (parseInt(r.typeid) === addrType);
                // Use == for type-coercing comparison (handles string/number mismatches from DB)
                var isLgMatch = lgId && r.locationgroupid != null && r.locationgroupid != 0 && r.locationgroupid == lgId;
                var isDefault = truthyBit(r.defaultflag);   // bit(1) — arrives as a raw byte

                // Best: requested type + matching LG — always wins
                if (isRequestedType && isLgMatch) { best = r; break; }
                // Next best: requested type + default flag
                if (!best && isRequestedType && isDefault) { best = r; }
                // Next: requested type (any)
                if (!best && isRequestedType) { best = r; }
                // Fallback: Main Office type 50
                if (!best) { best = r; }
            }

            if (!best) return empty;
            debugLog('Vendor address selected: name=' + best.addrname + ' city=' + best.city +
                     ' state=' + best.statecode + ' country=' + best.countryname +
                     ' lg=' + best.locationgroupid, 'info');
            return {
                name: best.addrname || '',
                street: best.street || '',
                city: best.city || '',
                state: best.statecode || '',
                postalCode: best.postalcode || '',
                country: best.countryname || ''
            };
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Address lookup error (type ' + addrType + '): ' + e.message, 'error');
            return empty;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Lookup the company Ship To address (accountid = 1).
     * ShipTo on a PO = where goods are delivered (our warehouse), not the vendor's address.
     * Same priority cascade as lookupVendorAddress:
     *   1. Ship To (type 10) matching the location group
     *   2. Ship To (type 10) with defaultFlag
     *   3. Ship To (type 10) any
     *   4. Main Office (type 50) fallback
     */
    function lookupCompanyShipTo(locationGroupId) {
        var empty = { name: '', street: '', city: '', state: '', postalCode: '', country: '' };
        try {
            var companyAccountId = 1;
            var lgId = (locationGroupId && locationGroupId > 0) ? parseInt(locationGroupId) : null;
            debugLog('Company ShipTo lookup: locationGroupId=' + locationGroupId + ' resolved lgId=' + lgId, 'info');

            // Query all Ship To (type 10) and Main Office (type 50) addresses for the company.
            // Order by: LG match first, then Ship To before Main Office, then default flag.
            var sql =
                "SELECT a.addressName AS addrname, a.address AS street, a.city AS city, " +
                "sc.code AS statecode, a.zip AS postalcode, cc.name AS countryname, " +
                "a.typeid, a.defaultflag, a.locationgroupid " +
                "FROM address a " +
                "LEFT JOIN stateconst sc ON sc.id = a.stateId " +
                "LEFT JOIN countryconst cc ON cc.id = a.countryId " +
                "WHERE a.accountid = " + companyAccountId +
                " AND a.typeid IN (10, 50)" +
                " ORDER BY " +
                (lgId
                    ? "  CASE WHEN a.locationgroupid = " + lgId + " THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
                    : "") +
                "  CASE WHEN a.typeid = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, " +
                "  a.defaultflag DESC";

            var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery(sql));
            debugLog('Company ShipTo candidates (' + rows.length + ' rows, lgId=' + lgId + '):', 'info');
            for (var d = 0; d < rows.length; d++) {
                var dr = rows[d];
                debugLog('  [' + d + '] name=' + dr.addrname + ' city=' + dr.city + ' type=' + dr.typeid + ' lg=' + dr.locationgroupid + ' default=' + dr.defaultflag, 'info');
            }
            if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return empty;

            // Pick best match: LG-matching Ship To → default Ship To → any Ship To → Main Office
            var best = null;

            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                var r = rows[i];
                var isShipTo = (parseInt(r.typeid) === 10);
                // Use == for type-coercing comparison (handles string/number mismatches from DB)
                var isLgMatch = lgId && r.locationgroupid != null && r.locationgroupid != 0 && r.locationgroupid == lgId;
                var isDefault = truthyBit(r.defaultflag);   // bit(1) — arrives as a raw byte

                // Best: Ship To + matching LG — always wins
                if (isShipTo && isLgMatch) { best = r; break; }
                // Next best: Ship To + default flag
                if (!best && isShipTo && isDefault) { best = r; }
                // Next: Ship To (any)
                if (!best && isShipTo) { best = r; }
                // Fallback: Main Office type 50
                if (!best) { best = r; }
            }

            if (!best) return empty;
            debugLog('Company ShipTo selected: name=' + best.addrname + ' city=' + best.city +
                     ' state=' + best.statecode + ' country=' + best.countryname +
                     ' lg=' + best.locationgroupid, 'success');
            return {
                name: best.addrname || '',
                street: best.street || '',
                city: best.city || '',
                state: best.statecode || '',
                postalCode: best.postalcode || '',
                country: best.countryname || ''
            };
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Company ShipTo lookup error: ' + e.message, 'error');
            return empty;
        }
    }

    // ============================================
    // PO creation — REST, not the CSV importer
    //
    // POST /api/purchase-orders replaces ImportPurchaseOrder because the CSV route cannot carry
    // a tax rate. Its TaxCode column is a string, and no string identifies a rate here:
    // taxrate.code is not unique ("NCG" is both id 4 and id 13), and exact, unique, active NAMES
    // are discarded outright — "GST on Expenses" and "" both produced poitem.taxId = NULL, so
    // blank does not fall back to the part default either. REST takes taxRate:{id}, which is
    // exact, and returns the created order, so the PO number no longer has to be inferred from
    // "the newest PO for this vendor" — a race the CSV path could not avoid.
    // ============================================
    async function submitPoFromModal(vendorId) {
        var items = window._modalItems;
        var vendorName = window._modalVendorName;
        if (!items || items.length === 0) return;

        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('modal-submit-btn');
        if (submitBtn && submitBtn.disabled) return;   // a submit is already in flight
        if (typeof runRestApiAsync !== 'function') {
            showStatus('The Fishbowl REST connection is not available, so purchase orders cannot ' +
                       'be created from this report. Open it from a client connected to a server ' +
                       'with REST enabled.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        // Re-read values from modal inputs in case user changed them
        items.forEach(function(item, idx) {
            var qtyInput = document.getElementById('modal-qty-' + idx);
            var costInput = document.getElementById('modal-cost-' + idx);
            if (qtyInput) item.qty = parseFloat(qtyInput.value) || 0;
            if (costInput) item.unitCost = parseFloat(costInput.value) || 0;
        });

        // Filter out zero qty
        items = items.filter(function(i) { return i.qty > 0; });
        if (items.length === 0) {
            showStatus('All line items have zero quantity.', 'warning');
            return;
        }

        var isPerLg = window._modalMode === 'per-lg';
        var isSingleWithLgSelect = window._modalMode === 'single' && document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');

        try {
            var lgName, lgId;
            if (isPerLg || isSingleWithLgSelect) {
                // Use the modal LG dropdown
                var lgSel = document.getElementById('modal-lg-select');
                lgId = parseInt(lgSel.value);
                lgName = lgSel.options[lgSel.selectedIndex].text;
            } else {
                lgName = getLocationGroupName();
                lgId = getLocationGroupId();
            }
            debugLog('PO submit: lgName=' + lgName + ' lgId=' + lgId + ' vendorId=' + vendorId, 'info');
            // PO status — the REST create takes a status STRING, not the numeric status id.
            var statusEl = document.querySelector('input[name="modal-po-status"]:checked');
            var poStatusName = (statusEl && statusEl.value === '20') ? 'Issued' : 'Bid Request';

            // Lookup addresses
            var remitTo = lookupVendorAddress(vendorId, 30, lgId);  // Vendor: type 30 Remit To, fallback 50 Main Office
            var shipTo  = lookupCompanyShipTo(lgId);                // Company: type 10 Ship To, fallback 50 Main Office

            // Neither name may be empty — fall back to the vendor / location group name.
            if (!remitTo.name) remitTo.name = vendorName;
            if (!shipTo.name) shipTo.name = lgName;

            // Default carrier for this vendor, else the company default. REST wants the id.
            var carrierId = null;
            try {
                var carrierRows = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                    "SELECT c.id FROM carrier c " +
                    "INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.defaultcarrierid = c.id " +
                    "WHERE v.id = " + parseInt(vendorId)
                ) || '[]') || [];
                if (carrierRows.length) carrierId = parseInt(carrierRows[0].id) || null;
            } catch (e) {
                debugLog('Carrier lookup error: ' + e.message, 'warning');
            }
            if (!carrierId) {
                try {
                    var companyCarrier = JSON.parse(runQuery(
                        "SELECT c.id FROM carrier c " +
                        "INNER JOIN company co ON co.defaultcarrierid = c.id"
                    ) || '[]') || [];
                    if (companyCarrier.length) carrierId = parseInt(companyCarrier[0].id) || null;
                } catch (e) {
                    debugLog('Company carrier lookup error: ' + e.message, 'warning');
                }
            }
            debugLog('Carrier id: ' + (carrierId || '(none)'), 'info');
            debugLog('RemitTo address: ' + JSON.stringify(remitTo), 'info');
            debugLog('ShipTo address: ' + JSON.stringify(shipTo), 'info');

            // Tax: the vendor's rate wins, else the part's, else the line carries no rate object
            // at all and Fishbowl applies whatever it defaults to.
            var vendorTax = lookupVendorTaxRate(vendorId);
            var taxedFromVendor = 0, taxedFromPart = 0, taxedNone = 0;

            var poItems = items.map(function(item, i) {
                var qty = parseFloat(item.qty) || 0;
                var unit = parseFloat(item.unitCost) || 0;
                // part.name is the part NUMBER, and is sent only when we actually have one —
                // an empty name alongside a valid id is worse than no name at all.
                // description is nominally optional, but Fishbowl does NOT backfill it from the
                // part record: omit it and poitem.description lands blank on the order.
                var partRef = { id: parseInt(item.partId) };
                if (item.partNum) partRef.name = item.partNum;
                if (item.partDescription) partRef.description = item.partDescription;
                var line = {
                    part: partRef,
                    type: { id: 10 },                     // 10 = Purchase
                    lineNumber: i + 1,
                    quantity: qty,
                    // There is no unitCost field on create — Fishbowl derives it from the line
                    // total, so send the total. toFixed(4) strips float noise: 321 x 3226.82
                    // evaluates to 1035809.2199999999 in raw IEEE arithmetic.
                    totalCost: Number((qty * unit).toFixed(4))
                };
                if (item.uomId) line.uom = { id: parseInt(item.uomId) };
                if (item.vendorPartNum) line.vendorPartNumber = item.vendorPartNum;

                var lineTax = resolveLineTaxRate(vendorTax, item.partTaxRate);
                if (lineTax) {
                    line.taxRate = { id: lineTax.id };
                    if (vendorTax) taxedFromVendor++; else taxedFromPart++;
                } else {
                    taxedNone++;
                }
                return line;
            });

            var payload = {
                vendor: { id: parseInt(vendorId) },
                status: poStatusName,
                note: 'Auto PO from BI Report',
                poItems: poItems
            };
            if (lgId) payload.locationGroup = { id: parseInt(lgId) };
            if (currentUser) payload.buyer = { id: parseInt(currentUser) };
            if (carrierId) payload.carrier = { id: carrierId };
            if (vendorTax) payload.taxRate = { id: vendorTax.id };
            if (remitTo.name) payload.remitToAddress = remitTo;
            if (shipTo.name) payload.shipToAddress = shipTo;

            debugLog('Tax rates — ' + taxedFromVendor + ' from the vendor, ' + taxedFromPart +
                     ' from the part, ' + taxedNone + ' with no rate. ' +
                     (vendorTax ? 'Vendor rate: ' + vendorTax.name + ' (#' + vendorTax.id + ').'
                                : 'Vendor has no rate set, so lines use the part rate.'), 'info');
            debugLog('Submitting PO for vendor: ' + vendorName + ' (' + items.length +
                     ' items) as ' + poStatusName, 'click');
            debugLog('POST /api/purchase-orders ' + JSON.stringify(payload), 'info');

            if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

            var res = await runRestApiAsync({
                method: 'POST',
                path: '/api/purchase-orders',
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            debugLog('PO create response: ' + JSON.stringify(res), 'info');

            // The created order comes back directly, so the number is authoritative rather than
            // inferred from whichever PO happens to be newest for this vendor.
            var poNum = (res && (res.number || res.num)) || '';
            var poCreated = !!(res && (res.id || poNum));

            if (poCreated) {
                debugLog('PO created for ' + vendorName + ': ' + items.length +
                         ' line items, PO# ' + (poNum || '(number not returned)'), 'success');

                var lgSuffix = isPerLg ? ' (' + lgName + ')' : '';
                showStatus('PO created successfully for ' + vendorName + lgSuffix + '! ' + items.length + ' line items.' + (poNum ? ' PO#: ' + poNum : ''), 'success');

                // Store the PO against this vendor so the header row can show it
                if (poNum) {
                    if (!window._vendorPOs) window._vendorPOs = {};
                    // For per-LG mode, store array of POs; for single mode, store single PO
                    if (isPerLg) {
                        if (!Array.isArray(window._vendorPOs[vendorId])) {
                            window._vendorPOs[vendorId] = [];
                        }
                        window._vendorPOs[vendorId].push(poNum);
                    } else {
                        window._vendorPOs[vendorId] = poNum;
                    }
                }

                if (isPerLg) {
                    // Per-LG mode: record this PO and refresh the modal for the next LG
                    window._modalCreatedPOs.push({
                        lgId: lgId,
                        lgName: lgName,
                        poNum: poNum,
                        items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items))
                    });

                    updateModalCreatedSummary();

                    // The page behind is brought up to date after EVERY order, not
                    // only once nothing is left to buy. Closing the dialog at any
                    // point now leaves a correct grid.
                    markSubmittedRows(vendorId, items, poNum);
                    syncVendorHeaderPOs(vendorId);
                    syncModalCloseButton();

                    // Move to the next location group that still has something to
                    // order, skipping any whose shortfall the earlier orders already
                    // covered — landing on an empty table was another dead end.
                    if (!advanceToNextOrderableLg()) {
                        // Every location group that needed stock has its order. Say so
                        // and give an unambiguous way out, rather than dropping the
                        // buyer on a remainder table with Cancel as the only exit.
                        showModalPerLgComplete();
                    }
                } else {
                    // Single PO mode — update header, mark rows, close modal
                    markSubmittedRows(vendorId, items, poNum);
                    syncVendorHeaderPOs(vendorId);
                    closePoModal();
                }
            } else {
                poFailed(vendorName, 'The server accepted the request but returned no purchase ' +
                                     'order: ' + JSON.stringify(res));
                if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('submitPoFromModal error:', e);
            // runRestApiAsync rejects with { message, status } on an HTTP error; anything else
            // arrives as an ordinary Error.
            poFailed(vendorName,
                (e && (e.message || (e.status != null ? 'HTTP ' + e.status : ''))) || 'unknown error');
            if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
        // Deliberately no `finally` re-enable on the success path: the per-LG flow calls
        // onModalLgChange() / refreshModalTableForRemainder(), which own the button state from
        // there, and single-PO mode has already closed the modal.
    }

    // Shared failure path. An incomplete address is the common, actionable case, so name it and
    // link straight to the vendor instead of dumping a raw server string on the user.
    function poFailed(vendorName, rawMsg) {
        rawMsg = rawMsg || 'unknown error';
        if (/(remit\s*to|ship\s*to|address)/i.test(rawMsg)) {
            var escapedName = String(vendorName || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
            showStatus(
                'Fishbowl rejected the order address. Check that the vendor’s Remit To address ' +
                'and your company Ship To address each have a street, city, state and postcode, ' +
                'then try again.' +
                '<span style="display:block; margin-top:6px; opacity:0.85;">' + escHtml(rawMsg) + '</span>' +
                '<a href="#" onclick="openModule(\'Vendor\', \'' + escapedName + '\'); return false;" ' +
                'style="color:#fff; text-decoration:underline; font-weight:600; margin-top:6px; display:inline-block;">' +
                'Open ' + escHtml(vendorName) + ' in Fishbowl →</a>',
                'error',
                'Address Incomplete'
            );
        } else {
            showStatus('PO creation failed for ' + vendorName + ': ' + rawMsg, 'error');
        }
        debugLog('PO creation failed for ' + vendorName + ': ' + rawMsg, 'error');
    }

    // ============================================
    // Export / Print
    // ============================================
    // Values for the export/print grid, in the current visible column order.
    function _exportCellText(col, row) {
        if (col.key === 'cubeLine')   return row._unitVolM3 == null ? '' : fmtM3(_lineQty(row) * row._unitVolM3);
        if (col.key === 'weightLine') return row._unitKg == null ? '' : fmtKg(_lineQty(row) * row._unitKg);
        if (col.key === 'cubeUnit')   return row._unitVolM3 == null ? '' : fmtM3(row._unitVolM3);
        if (col.key === 'weightUnit') return row._unitKg == null ? '' : fmtKg(row._unitKg);
        if (col.key === 'dimW')       return row._dimW == null ? '' : formatNumber(row._dimW);
        if (col.key === 'dimH')       return row._dimH == null ? '' : formatNumber(row._dimH);
        if (col.key === 'dimL')       return row._dimL == null ? '' : formatNumber(row._dimL);
        if (col.key === 'sizeUom')    return row._sizeUomCode || '';
        if (col.key === 'part_num')   return row._fbPartNum || row.part_num || '';
        if (col.key === '_qtyMin')    return row._qtyMin == null ? '' : formatNumber(row._qtyMin);
        if (col.key === '_defaultLocation') {
            var dl = defaultLocFor(row, getSelectedLgId());
            return dl && dl.locName ? dl.locName : '';
        }
        if (col.key === '_qtySold') {
            var us = usageMap[row.part_id];
            return us ? formatNumber(us.sold) : '';
        }
        if (col.key === '_daysOfStock') {
            var dos = daysOfStockFor(row);
            return dos === null ? '' : String(dos);
        }
        if (col.key === '_lgSplit')   return lgSplitRows(row).map(function(s) {
            return s.lgName + ': ' + formatNumber(s.suggested); }).join('; ');
        if (col.key === '_availElsewhere') return (row._donorLgs || []).map(function(s) {
            return s.lgName + ': ' + formatNumber(s.atp); }).join('; ');
        if (col.key === '_capacitypct') {
            if (row._state === 'norop') return 'No ROP/OUL';
            if (row._state === 'fb10' || row._capacitypct > 100) return 'Overstocked';
            return row._capacitypct + '%';
        }
        if (col.key === 'qty_suggested') {
            var key = row.vendor_id + '_' + row.part_id;
            return String(qtyOverrides[key] !== undefined ? qtyOverrides[key] : (parseFloat(row.qty_suggested) || 0));
        }
        if (col.key === 'lead_time') {
            var lt = parseInt(row.lead_time);
            return (!lt || lt === 0) ? '' : lt + 'd';
        }
        if (col.key === 'reorder_level' || col.key === 'target_level') {
            var n = parseFloat(row[col.key]);
            return (!n || n === 0) ? '' : formatNumber(row[col.key]);
        }
        if (col.money) return formatCurrencyVal(safeCost(row[col.key]));
        if (col.qty)   return formatNumber(row[col.key]);
        return row[col.key] == null ? '' : String(row[col.key]);
    }

    // ============================================
    // Export / Print
    // ============================================
    function exportToCSV() {
        var vis = _columns.filter(function(c) { return c.vis; });
        var groups = buildGroupedData(getFilteredData());
        if (!groups.length) { showStatus('Nothing to export.', 'warning'); return; }

        function esc(v) {
            var s = (v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v);
            return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
        }

        var lines = [];
        lines.push(['Vendor'].concat(vis.map(function(c) { return c.label; })).map(esc).join(','));
        groups.forEach(function(g) {
            g.parts.forEach(function(row) {
                lines.push([g.vendorName].concat(vis.map(function(c) {
                    return _exportCellText(c, row);
                })).map(esc).join(','));
            });
            var load = calcVendorLoad(g.vendorId);
            lines.push([g.vendorName + ' — TOTAL'].concat(vis.map(function(c) {
                if (c.key === 'cubeLine')   return fmtM3(load.volM3);
                if (c.key === 'weightLine') return fmtKg(load.weightKg);
                if (c.key === 'last_cost')  return formatCurrencyVal(load.poValue);
                return '';
            })).map(esc).join(','));
        });

        var blob = new Blob(['﻿' + lines.join('\r\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = 'Advanced_Auto_PO_' + moment().format('YYYYMMDD_HHmm') + '.csv';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        // Revoke on a timer, not synchronously — a synchronous revoke can truncate the
        // download in JxBrowser. The native Save-As dialog may open behind the window.
        setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000);
        showStatus('CSV exported.', 'success');
    }

    // window.print() is unreliable in JxBrowser — build clean markup, open a new window,
    // and call print on THAT window.
    function printTable() {
        var vis = _columns.filter(function(c) { return c.vis; });
        var groups = buildGroupedData(getFilteredData());
        if (!groups.length) { showStatus('Nothing to print.', 'warning'); return; }

        function h(v) {
            return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
                .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>');
        }

        var html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>Advanced Auto PO</title><style>' +
            '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 0.5in; }' +
            'body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 8pt; }' +
            'h1 { font-size: 13pt; margin: 0 0 2px; }' +
            '.sub { color: #555; font-size: 8pt; margin-bottom: 10px; }' +
            'table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }' +
            'th { background: #1e3a4c; color: #fff; font-size: 7pt; padding: 4px 3px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #999; }' +
            'td { font-size: 7.5pt; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #ccc; }' +
            'tr.vgrp td { background: #e2e8f0; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8pt; }' +
            'tr.vtot td { background: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold; }' +
            '.num { text-align: right; }' +
            '</style></head><body>';
        html += '<h1>Advanced Auto PO</h1>';
        html += '<div class="sub">' + h(moment().format('DD MMM YYYY HH:mm')) + '</div>';
        html += '<table><thead><tr>' +
            vis.map(function(c) { return '<th>' + h(c.label) + '</th>'; }).join('') +
            '</tr></thead><tbody>';

        groups.forEach(function(g) {
            var load = calcVendorLoad(g.vendorId);
            html += '<tr class="vgrp"><td colspan="' + vis.length + '">' + h(g.vendorName) +
                ' — ' + load.selectedCount + '/' + load.partCount + ' selected, PO Value ' +
                h(formatCurrencyVal(load.poValue));
            if (load.binding !== 'none') {
                html += ' · ' + Math.round(load.headlinePct) + '% of ' + h(load.spec.label) +
                    ' (' + (load.binding === 'volume' ? 'cubes out' : 'weighs out') + ')';
            }
            if (load.linesNoDims) html += ' · ' + load.linesNoDims + ' line(s) missing dimensions';
            html += '</td></tr>';

            g.parts.forEach(function(row) {
                html += '<tr>' + vis.map(function(c) {
                    var cls = (c.align === 'right' || c.qty || c.money) ? ' class="num"' : '';
                    return '<td' + cls + '>' + h(_exportCellText(c, row)) + '</td>';
                }).join('') + '</tr>';
            });

            html += '<tr class="vtot">' + vis.map(function(c, i) {
                if (i === 0) return '<td>Total</td>';
                if (c.key === 'cubeLine')   return '<td class="num">' + h(fmtM3(load.volM3)) + '</td>';
                if (c.key === 'weightLine') return '<td class="num">' + h(fmtKg(load.weightKg)) + '</td>';
                if (c.key === 'last_cost')  return '<td class="num">' + h(formatCurrencyVal(load.poValue)) + '</td>';
                return '<td></td>';
            }).join('') + '</tr>';
        });

        html += '</tbody></table></body></html>';

        var w = window.open('', '_blank');
        if (!w) { showStatus('Could not open the print window — check pop-up settings.', 'error'); return; }
        w.document.open();
        w.document.write(html);
        w.document.close();
        setTimeout(function() { w.focus(); w.print(); }, 400);
    }

    // ============================================
    // Init
    // ============================================
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Show debug console if BI_SHOW_DEBUG property is set
        if (DEBUG_MODE) {
            document.getElementById('debugConsoleContainer').style.display = 'block';
        }

        debugLog('Advanced Auto PO initialised', 'success');
        debugLog('Debug mode: ' + DEBUG_MODE + ' (BI_SHOW_DEBUG=' + BI_SHOW_DEBUG_PROP + ')', 'info');
        debugLog('User: ' + (user.fullName || user.firstName + ' ' + user.lastName || 'ID ' + currentUser), 'info');

        initParameters();
        debugLog('Parameters initialized', 'success');

        initSettings();
        buildColPanel();
        loadUomEngine();

        // Settings drawer. fb-lib owns the backdrop scrim and the ESC handler; re-read the
        // inputs from state each time it opens so an unsaved edit is discarded, not kept.
        FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({
            id: 'setOverlay',
            triggerId: 'setBtn',
            onBeforeOpen: renderContainerSettings
        });
        renderContainerSettings();

        // Close the Columns popover on an outside click.
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var cw = document.getElementById('colWrap');
            var cp = document.getElementById('colPanel');
            if (cw && cp && !cw.contains(e.target)) cp.classList.add('hidden');
        });

        // Remember filter-strip state.
        ['paramDefaultVendorOnly', 'paramShowVendorPN', 'paramIncludeNoROP', 'paramIncludeMfg']
            .forEach(function(id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.addEventListener('change', persistPrefs);
            });
        var dr = document.getElementById('paramDateRange');
        if (dr) dr.addEventListener('change', persistPrefs);

        setStatusLine('Ready — configure parameters and press Load.');
    });

    </script>
